policies.n: An advance short-stay visa is required. Authorised stay is set by the visa, subject to the Schengen-wide 90/180-day maximum. Apply through the competent mission/visa centre; online form submission does not by itself establish an eVisa. Short tourism only. The Schengen limit is 90 days in any rolling 180-day period across the whole area, not 90 days per country. Passport issued within the previous 10 years and valid at least three months after intended departure; accommodation, funds and return/onward travel may be checked. ETIAS is not operational at this check; EES border registration is not an advance travel authorisation.

ETIAS is not operational at this check; EES border registration is not an advance travel authorisation. Visa exemption requires a biometric passport; non-biometric documents do not qualify. Passport recognition: As of 1 March 2012, non-biometric passports are no longer recognised

policies.label: Schengen visa needed for access
policies.n: Andorra requires no local visa for any nationality, but it can only be reached through France or Spain. Where a Schengen visa is required, obtain it before travel with at least two entries for return to Schengen, or multiple entries for repeated visits. Entering Andorra leaves Schengen; it does not reset the Schengen 90/180-day allowance. No Andorran stay length is asserted from this source. EU citizens may use a valid ID/passport; other visitors need a valid passport. Schengen access remains subject to the area-wide 90 days in any rolling 180-day period; this is not a separate allowance in each access country. Passport recognition: Non-machine-readable ORDINARY passport not recognised

policies.n: Ordinary tourist visits are limited to areas open to the public, such as St Peter’s Square. Normal tourist access passes through Italy and therefore requires the relevant Schengen visa/waiver and recognised documents. Public-area access is not EU free movement or permission to reside in Vatican City. Schengen access remains subject to the area-wide 90 days in any rolling 180-day period; this is not a separate allowance in each access country.

A Cypriot short-stay visa is required before tourist travel. Visa validity is not the permitted stay; check the issued authorisation (maximum 90/180 days). Turkish/Azerbaijani nationals do not benefit from the general recognition of Schengen visas/residence permits. Follow the competent mission’s procedure, including pre-approval where required, and use lawful Republic of Cyprus entry points. The Washington mission states electronic submission is not available.

British citizens may visit for up to 90 days in a 180-day period, counted separately from Schengen. Passport issued within 10 years, valid three months after departure; return/onward ticket and funds may be requested. Enter via lawful Republic of Cyprus ports; entry through the north can be treated as illegal. ETIAS is not operational.

An advance Cypriot short-stay visa is required under Article 3 and Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2018/1806. Duration is set by the issued visa within the 90/180-day Cyprus maximum; visa validity is not the permitted stay. Carry a passport recognised by Cyprus, issued within 10 years and valid at least three months beyond departure. Use lawful Republic of Cyprus entry points; accommodation, funds, return/onward travel and insurance evidence may be required. Where a visa is required, Cyprus issues a national visa through a consular application rather than an electronic visa. No third-country visa or residence permit is assumed. ETIAS was not operational in the inspected guidance.

Use lawful Republic of Cyprus entry points; accommodation, funds, return/onward travel and insurance evidence may be required. ETIAS was not operational in the inspected guidance.

Only Região Administrativa Especial de Macau passports qualify. Carry a passport recognised by Cyprus, issued within 10 years and valid at least three months beyond departure. Use lawful Republic of Cyprus entry points; accommodation, funds, return/onward travel and insurance evidence may be required. Where a visa is required, Cyprus issues a national visa through a consular application rather than an electronic visa. No third-country visa or residence permit is assumed. policies.label: Visa required; unrecognised-passport procedure
policies.n: Dutch government guidance explicitly accepts Somali-national visitor applications, with applications by Somalia residents handled at VFS Nairobi and a usual 45-day decision period. The EU recognition matrix does not recognise the Somali ordinary passport in the Netherlands. Under Visa Code Article 25(3), a visa issued by a state that does not recognise the travel document is valid only for that state; Article 29(2) requires a separate visa sheet. Confirm the issued territorial/document authorisation and the travel route with the Dutch mission before travel; a visa from another Schengen state is not presumed sufficient. The permitted days are those authorised, not an automatic 90 days or the processing period. The current Somali visa measure normally permits only one entry. Visa issue and admission remain individual decisions.

policies.label: Non-essential tourist entry restricted
policies.n: For ordinary tourism and non-essential transit into Finland, the Finnish MFA states that Russian holders of Schengen visas are subject to entry restrictions, in force until further notice. A tourist visa alone does not remove the restriction. Its published exceptions cover qualifying family, work, transport, business, study, treatment, property, diplomatic and other essential purposes; none is assumed here. This is the non-essential entry rule, not a ban on every Russian person or a ruling on an independently lawful intra-Schengen/residence situation. Finnish passport-recognition rules also generally require a biometric Russian passport from 1 June 2026, with specified age, existing-permit and transitional exceptions.

policies.label: Tourist entry barred at external border
policies.n: Cabinet Regulation 123 permits Russian entry across Latvia’s external border only in listed residence/long-stay-visa, family, humanitarian, transport, seafarer, diplomatic and related categories. Ordinary tourism without such an exception is not permitted even with a short-stay visa. This external-border restriction is not extended to travel already lawfully inside Schengen; the MFA FAQ distinguishes internal-Schengen travel. No existing visa/residence right is assumed. The regulation is currently in force through 31 December 2026; recheck thereafter. Russian ordinary passports generally must be biometric. Any applicable Latvian travel-declaration obligation is additional and is not entry permission.

policies.label: Visa required; Latvian applications restricted
policies.n: A visa is required. Cabinet Regulation 123 restricts Latvian acceptance of Belarusian visa applications to enumerated long-stay, qualifying family, humanitarian, transport, seafarer, diplomatic or individually authorised national-interest/international-obligation categories; ordinary standalone tourist applications are not included. This is a visa-processing restriction, not the Russian external-border entry ban: the MFA expressly says that travel restriction is not applied to Belarusian citizens. An independently valid Schengen visa can affect entry, but none is assumed and a newly obtainable tourist visa is not promised. Permitted stay is as authorised. A Latvian-issued visa exempts the holder from the declaration; otherwise applicable pre-arrival declaration must be submitted 48 hours ahead. Regulation 123 is currently in force through 31 December 2026.

Ordinary national passport required; HK/MO refer to SAR passports. Passport issued within the previous ten years and valid three months beyond planned departure.
No more than 90 days in a six-month period; return or onward flight ticket required.
Up to 90 days for tourism/business. Purpose and sufficient-funds evidence may be requested. The cited passport guidance does not specify an aggregate window.

US passport exempt under Annex 3. Decision 124/2022 permits entry and stay without a residence permit for up to one year. A new one-year period requires more than 90 days outside Albania; a short border trip does not reset the allowance.
policies.stay: Up to 1 year

policies.n: Treaty Article 1: no more than 90 calendar days during any 365-day period from first entry. The treaty also refers to Schengen counting rules for Kazakh visitors. No conversion to a per-visit reset. Entry through international checkpoints.
Tourism only, passport required; exemption runs 15 April–31 December 2026. General short-stay ceiling remains 90 days within 180 days.

Decision 858 II.A.3(c) explicitly exempts citizens who enter and stay in Schengen countries without a visa, for up to 90 days in 180. Current Latvian and German government ordinary-passport schedules identify this nationality as exempt. This is a nationality-based provision, not an assumed third-country visa/residence permit.

Visa-required Annex 4, including its explicit other-nationalities row. Decision II.A.7 permits electronic visa issuance emailed after approval, or an embassy sticker visa; applications must be made from outside Albania. Where no designated mission is listed, MFA approval of application transfer is required. Actual stay follows the issued visa, within the general C-visa 90/180 ceiling.
Belarus visa-waiver agreement suspended by Decision 236/2025, superseding the old Annex 3 entry. Advance eVisa or embassy visa under Decision 858; do not apply a legacy 30-day waiver.

Iranian citizens are specifically excluded from Decision II.A.3 substitute-visa/residence exemptions. The free-fee label in older schedules was not visa freedom. Advance electronic or consular visa; stay as issued.

Decision 470/2024 suspends the Guyana agreement for ordinary as well as diplomatic/service passports, with immediate effect. Advance electronic or consular visa under Decision 858. A blank or zero visa-fee cell is not a visa waiver; stay follows the issued visa.

Article 11(2): Hong Kong/Macao SAR passports, or Taiwan passport containing the personal identification-card number. Up to 90 days in six months under that specific provision; no assumed Schengen visa.
Specific treaty provision: 90 days, total no more than 180 days annually from first entry.
Article 13 ordinary-passport exemption: up to 90 days; no different aggregate period is stated there.
Ordinary-passport treaty exemption: 30 days within each 60-day period from first entry.
Ordinary-passport treaty exemption: 30 days within two months from first entry; months are not converted to guessed days.

2026 temporary exemption allowed a total of 60 days only during 1 June–30 September 2026; it has expired. Bahrain/Oman permanent exemptions were previously removed. An advance visa is required now; ordinary tourist arrival issuance is not established.
Article 24: Kosovo-marked travel documents require an advance visa issued on a separate form under a special procedure, not a visa sticker in the passport.

MFA ordinary-passport entry: Без виз по дипломатическим и служебным паспортам – до 90 дней. Безвизовой режим: для сотрудников, аккредитованных в Госпротоколе МИД России; по общегражданским паспортам – 30 дней из 60. Tourist scope excludes diplomatic accreditation, crew, APEC and border-resident exceptions. Aggregate period is not inferred where the table gives only a number of days.

MFA ordinary-passport entry: Без виз по дипломатическим и служебным паспортам – до 90 дней. Безвизовой режим: для сотрудников, аккредитованных в Госпротоколе МИД России; по общегражданским паспортам – до 30 дней. Tourist scope excludes diplomatic accreditation, crew, APEC and border-resident exceptions. Aggregate period is not inferred where the table gives only a number of days.

MFA ordinary-passport entry: Без виз по дипломатическим и служебным паспортам – до 90 дней. Tourist scope excludes diplomatic accreditation, crew, APEC and border-resident exceptions. Aggregate period is not inferred where the table gives only a number of days.

MFA ordinary-passport entry: Без виз по общегражданским паспортам – до 90 дней. Сотрудники, аккредитованные в Госпротоколе МИД России, находятся по визам. Tourist scope excludes diplomatic accreditation, crew, APEC and border-resident exceptions. Aggregate period is not inferred where the table gives only a number of days.

MFA ordinary-passport entry: Без виз по дипломатическим и служебным паспортам – до 30 дней. Без виз по общегражданским паспортам – до 30 дней (до 31.12.2027 г.). Могут въезжать по электронной визе на срок до 30 дней. Безвизовой режим: для сотрудников, аккредитованных в Госпротоколе МИД России; для членов поездных бригад; для членов экипажей морских и речных судов; для членов экипажей воздушных судов; для туристических групп в составе от 5 до 50 чел. (по заверенным спискам и подтверждениям российских турорганизаций о приеме) – до 15 дней; по карточкам АТЭС с обозначением «RUS». Tourist scope excludes diplomatic accreditation, crew, APEC and border-resident exceptions. Aggregate period is not inferred where the table gives only a number of days.

Без виз до 14 дней для постоянных жителей САР Гонконг КНР при наличии действительного паспорта САР Гонконг КНР. Без виз по карточкам АТЭС с обозначением «RUS». HK/MO require permanent-resident status and the corresponding SAR passport.
Без виз до 30 дней для постоянных жителей САР Макао КНР при наличии действительного паспорта САР Макао КНР. HK/MO require permanent-resident status and the corresponding SAR passport.

MFA ordinary-passport entry: Без виз по дипломатическим и служебным паспортам – до 90 дней. Безвизовой режим: по общегражданским паспортам – до 60 дней; для сотрудников, аккредитованных в Госпротоколе МИД России; по карточкам АТЭС с обозначением «RUS». Tourist scope excludes diplomatic accreditation, crew, APEC and border-resident exceptions. Aggregate period is not inferred where the table gives only a number of days.
Без виз до 14 дней.
Unified eVisa: 30-day permitted stay within 120-day validity; approved border checkpoints only. Arrival/departure days count; apply 86 to 4 days ahead; passport and insurance conditions apply.

MFA ordinary-passport entry: Без виз по дипломатическим и служебным паспортам – до 90 дней. Безвизовой режим для: сотрудников, аккредитованных в Госпротоколе МИД России; по общегражданским биометрическим паспортам – до 30 дней. Tourist scope excludes diplomatic accreditation, crew, APEC and border-resident exceptions. Aggregate period is not inferred where the table gives only a number of days.

Tourist scope excludes diplomatic accreditation, crew, APEC and border-resident exceptions. Aggregate period is not inferred where the table gives only a number of days.

Bilateral exemption explicitly listed for up to 60 days from border crossing.
Named 10-day exemption requires a flight ticket to the home country or a third country. Do not confuse the short waiver with an electronic visa or its longer validity.

Visa-free route: up to 10 days with qualifying onward/return air ticket. Separate advance eVisa is available for Hong Kong under Appendix 1 and allows up to 30 days under the eVisa law. The two methods have different stays.
policies.stay: Visa-free: 10 days; eVisa: up to 30 days

policies.n: 30 days per visit, total no more than 90 days within any 180-day period. Work/study/media and other specially authorised activities excluded. Do not extend this treaty to SAR passports.
US nationals: visa-free up to 30 days from entry, effective 1 January 2026; replaces the old age-55 limitation.
30 days from entry under Decree UP-86, effective 5 June 2023. Its amendment expressly removes Qatar from the earlier ten-day rule, resolving the outdated MFA footnote.

Current consolidated decree establishes visa freedom for 30 days from entry, effective 15 March 2024. Old eVisa-list inclusion is superseded; the current clause is used rather than a 2022 announcement.

Named electronic-visa eligibility. eVisa law: up to 30 days from first entry within 90-day issuance validity; single, double and multiple entries are distinct options and do not reset the first-entry stay window. Apply at least three working days before travel. No third-country visa is assumed.

Explicit MFA default: entry visa required outside the named exemptions. Consular issuance uses Uzbek-side invitation/confirmation; approved airport issuance depends on absence of a mission and prior confirmation, not unconditional arrival eligibility. Under-16 guardian-dependent exception is separate. The source does not resolve every newer application-method restriction.
policies.label: Visa required; application method unverified

policies.n: Visa required under the explicit default. Collection at Minsk National Airport requires an inviting party to submit original support documents at least two business days before arrival and a stamped receipt for airline check-in. Not available on flights from Russia. Embassy issuance is an alternative. Stay follows the issued visa; no generic 90 days is assigned.

State Migration Service entry visa and approved invitation required. Embassy tourist instructions require a Turkmen tourist-agency invitation, insurance, flight ticket and hotel reservation; they expressly permit any visa type to be collected at the border after invitation approval, or at a mission. Confirm the specified border point with the inviting agency. Registration within three working days. Stay depends on approval. eVisa launch/eligibility is not established.

Obtain approved eVisa before travel; passport and supporting documents required, final approval discretionary. New-roster duration not established by the checker; use issued permission. Accommodation registration within 48 hours.
Short visit under the listed ordinary/all-passport exemption agreement. MO means Macao SAR passport.
Temporary tourism-only waiver, up to 30 days; expires at end of 2026.
Hong Kong SAR passport; other Hong Kong travel documents not assumed.
Temporary waiver only for tourism, up to 90 days.

MFA’s express residual rule directs non-eVisa nationals to a Mongolian embassy. Niger is absent from both inspected static eligibility list and current application dropdown, and not in the exemption list. Regular tourist visa up to 30 days; issued approval controls.
Short visit under the all-passport exemption agreement.

The current ordinary-passport checker explicitly rejects eVisa and directs applicants to a Mongolian diplomatic mission. Regular tourist visa guidance permits up to 30 days; prior approval and issued terms control.
policies.label: Embassy tourist visa

policies.n: Waiver requires the official invitation specified by the bilateral facilitation agreement; do not treat as an unconditional invitation-free waiver.

VOA eligibility expressly covers this nationality or the source-defined European country group, for up to 30 days subject to Immigration approval. Carry hotel/host details, return ticket and at least USD500 equivalent funds; pay the VOA fee in foreign currency cash. Complete applicable arrival/departure declarations. Do not treat eligibility as guaranteed issuance. Special Branch portal now requires an online VOA application at least 72 hours before arrival and printed acknowledgement; final visa/fee at the border, not an alternative eVisa. Regular advance sticker visa is a separate option. Portal info/instructions conflict on departure from a country without a resident Bangladesh mission: check departure-specific eligibility; this is not an unconditional arrival entitlement.
policies.stay: VOA:up to 30 days; regular tourist visa:issued permission

policies.n: Indian ordinary visitor requires a visa; tourist fee is waived, not the visa. Complete online form then submit passport/documents for a regular visa. Stay follows issued permission; exceptional departure/mission-based VOA conditions are not assumed.

Obtain online tourist visa approval before travel. Maximum 90 days subject to approved itinerary and payment of Sustainable Development Fee; guide and approved accommodation required. No nationality restriction is stated by the Department of Tourism.
Tourist visa required but may be approved on arrival or online before travel; maximum 90 days subject to itinerary, applicable SDF, guide and approved accommodation.

No visa required, but an entry permit is required and can be obtained at the entry point or online in advance. Indian passport or voter ID; prescribed child documents/guardian conditions. Applicable SDF, guide and approved accommodation required.
policies.label: Entry permit, available on arrival

policies.n: Ordinary-passport tourist eVisa, based on the official 2026-09-10 archived eligibility table. Obtain GRANTED approval before travel; six-month passport, two blank pages, onward/return ticket and funds. Pakistani-origin restrictions apply, including parents/grandparents born or permanently resident in Pakistan; Canadian applicants with defence/security/police backgrounds must use a regular visa. Enter only through designated eVisa airports/seaports. The 30-day product runs from first arrival; one-/five-year validity is not stay, and the 180-day calendar-year ceiling is an aggregate. Regular mission visa is an alternative, with stay as issued.
policies.stay: 30-day eVisa option; longer-validity tourist visas have issued conditions and a 180-day annual aggregate

policies.n: Ordinary-passport tourist eVisa, based on the official 2026-09-10 archived eligibility table. Obtain GRANTED approval before travel; six-month passport, two blank pages, onward/return ticket and funds. Pakistani-origin restrictions apply, including parents/grandparents born or permanently resident in Pakistan; Canadian applicants with defence/security/police backgrounds must use a regular visa. Enter only through designated eVisa airports/seaports. The 30-day product runs from first arrival; one-/five-year validity is not stay, and the 180-day calendar-year ceiling is an aggregate. Regular mission visa is an alternative, with stay as issued. UAE-only conditional alternative: up to 60-day VOA at the six listed airports if an Indian eVisa or paper visa was obtained previously; not available to first-time UAE applicants or those of Pakistani origin.
policies.stay: eVisa: product/issued limits; qualifying repeat UAE visitors: VOA up to 60 days

policies.n: Advance tourist visa under the Embassy’s express ordinary-foreign-national default. Complete online application and submit passport/documents to the appropriate Indian mission; this is a regular visa process, not necessarily an eVisa. Stay follows the issued permission; eVisa eligibility is not established by this source.

Visa exemption depends on itinerary: visa required if entering India from China, Macao, Hong Kong, Pakistan or Maldives. From Nepal/Bhutan accepted national ID may suffice; from other places a national passport is required. Source does not specify tourist stay; unrestricted free movement is not asserted.

Ordinary passport; tourist VOA up to 60 days at Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Kolkata or Mumbai. Pakistani birth/origin exclusions apply to applicant, parents and grandparents. Six-month passport, funds and onward/return ticket. Genuine eVisa and regular visa alternatives have different duration conditions; see the respective approval, not the VOA cap.
policies.stay: VOA: up to 60 days; eVisa: 30-day product or longer product subject to issued limits

policies.n: Maldivian nationals are expressly excepted from the ordinary visitor visa requirement in the Embassy’s tourist FAQ. Duration and extended-stay conditions not specified by this source.

Ordinary tourist access unavailable under the published suspension of visa services and revocation effective 27 April 2025. Existing Hindu Pakistani Long Term Visas are expressly excepted; that is not a general tourist exception.
policies.label: Tourist visa issuance suspended

policies.n: Tourist visa on arrival; no visa pre-approval. MRZ passport with at least one month validity (extended-validity passports not accepted), confirmed return travel, prepaid registered accommodation and funds or approved sponsorship. Submit free individual IMUGA Traveller Declaration within 96 hours before arrival; it is not an ETA/eVisa. Current Immigration page does not specify the stay duration; confirm issued permission.

British citizen passport. Tourist visa on arrival; no visa pre-approval. MRZ passport with at least one month validity (extended-validity passports not accepted), confirmed return travel, prepaid registered accommodation and funds or approved sponsorship. Submit free individual IMUGA Traveller Declaration within 96 hours before arrival; it is not an ETA/eVisa.
Entry will not be granted on Israeli passports, effective 2025-04-15. This source states a passport-based restriction, not a blanket ban on every Israeli dual national travelling on another passport.

Tourist visa on arrival at designated airports/entry points or advance mission visa. Online pre-filled arrival application is not itself an eVisa grant. Gratis/fee waivers do not remove the visa requirement. Total tourist stay including extensions cannot exceed 150 days per visa year.
policies.stay: Choose 15, 30 or 90 days

policies.n: Obtain prior visa/mission-issued travel authorisation; not eligible for ordinary unapproved visa on arrival. Embassy London calls its advance document ETA but requires physical passport/document submission, so this is not classified as a universally online eVisa. Afghanistan has a special DOI-recommended gratis arrival route, not assumed.
policies.stay: Tourist options: 15, 30 or 90 days, as approved

policies.n: No visa required for Indian nationals. Carry a valid national passport or another document specifically accepted by Nepal; Aadhaar is not accepted. Source does not specify a tourist day limit; unrestricted residence/free movement is not asserted.

Advance online tourist visa. Listed in NADRA’s 192-country roster (capture 2026-08-28) and DGIP’s tourist List A (capture 2026-08-06). DGIP allows up to three months stay; actual approval controls. Apply from home country or legal permanent residence, with itinerary/hotel or sponsor documents and applicable sponsor biometrics. This is not visa-free entry or unconditional VOA; current free-VPA availability is not established.
policies.stay: Up to 3 months, subject to the visa issued

policies.n: Online Tourist Visit application with required notarised sponsor/guarantor letter and sponsor CNIC/POR details. Use a valid national passport, not a substitute travel document. Apply through mission of nationality or legal residence; the stated processing time is not a stay allowance.

DGIP expressly requires all DPRK-national visa cases to be referred to Pakistan MFA under the sanctions regime. NADRA lists the nationality online, but that does not remove special prior approval; stay follows approval.
policies.label: MFA-referred visa approval

policies.n: Ordinary nationals expressly covered by the abolition schedule. Calendar-month period is not converted to a guessed day count.
policies.stay: 3 months

policies.n: Ordinary nationals expressly covered by the abolition schedule. Calendar-month period is not converted to a guessed day count.

policies.n: Tourist ETA approval is required before arrival, even where the ETA fee is waived. The standard tourist ETA permits 30 days with double entry. The second entry receives only the remaining balance of the original 30-day period. Passport valid at least six months, confirmed return ticket and funds. Fee waivers do not remove the ETA requirement; obtain approval before travel. Genuine alternative: overseas mission-issued endorsed tourist visa up to 3 months, subject to DI&E concurrence. This is distinct from 30-day ETA and not a conversion of calendar months to 90 days.
policies.stay: Tourist ETA:30 days; mission-issued short-visit visa:up to 3 months

policies.n: Use the Sri Lankan sponsor-mediated application at DI&E Head Office in Battaramulla described in the official ETA root-page alerts. Sponsor request,sworn affidavit,certified sponsor identity,applicant passport and accommodation required; AF/CM/CI/GH/NG/SY also require police clearance. Obtain the approved ETA/landing permission before travel; this is not the generic independent onlineETA route. Stay follows the issued permission.
policies.label: Sponsor-mediated prior approval

policies.n: HKSAR passport holders must apply online for ETA before visiting; the Sri Lankan Embassy notification provides up to 30-day entry visa upon arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport. ETA and the arrival stamp are sequential requirements, not interchangeable alternatives. Six-month passport,return ticket and funds required.
policies.label: Prior ETA; entry visa at BIA

policies.n: Tourist ETA approval is required before arrival, even where the ETA fee is waived. The portal states a reciprocal 90-day tourist visa for Maldivian nationals; check the issued approval and rules for children. Passport valid at least six months, confirmed return ticket and funds. Fee waivers do not remove the ETA requirement; obtain approval before travel. The homepage says all Maldivians receive 90 days, while the fee table gives children under 12 only 30 free days; confirm child-specific approval.

Tourist ETA approval is required before arrival, even where the ETA fee is waived. The standard tourist ETA permits 30 days with double entry. policies.stay: Tourist ETA:30 days; mission-issued short-visit visa:up to 3 months

Ordinary national passport (HK/MO means SAR passport; GB means British citizen). Submit the free SG Arrival Card within three days including arrival day; it is not a visa. Individually issued passport with at least six months validity, sufficient funds and onward travel required. Authorised stay is the e-Pass period issued on arrival, not visa validity. No fixed stay allowance is asserted. Obtain entry visa before travel through the ICA/local-contact, authorised-agent or mission procedure; electronic application/issuance may be available. This classification does not assert that an eVisa is unavailable.

Ordinary national passport (HK/MO means SAR passport; GB means British citizen). Submit the free SG Arrival Card within three days including arrival day; it is not a visa. Individually issued passport with at least six months validity, sufficient funds and onward travel required. Authorised stay is the e-Pass period issued on arrival, not visa validity. No fixed stay allowance is asserted.
Tourism/social visits only; minimum six-month passport validity, confirmed return travel, hotel booking and MDAC before arrival required.
British citizen passport: tourism normally up to 90 days; passport valid at least six months and MDAC required unless specifically exempt. Sabah/Sarawak have separate immigration controls.

Ordinary PRC passport valid at least six months. Maximum 30 days per entry, non-extendable; maximum cumulative 90 days within 180 days. Complete MDAC before travel; carry return/onward and accommodation evidence. Bilateral agreement effective 17 July 2025; not the Indian temporary exemption.
Visa-free for a stay of less than one month under the expressly stated ASEAN rule. No conversion of a calendar month into 30 days. MDAC requirements apply unless exempt.

policies.n: Ordinary Swiss/Liechtenstein passport: up to90 days for leisure; passport six months, onward/return ticket and MDAC within three days required. Includes Sabah and Sarawak according to the embassy.

Explicitly named on Immigration’s no-visa list. Tourist admission duration is not specified by this source and is determined by the issued visit pass. MDAC applies unless exempt; Singapore citizens are exempt from MDAC. Visa exemption is not work or residence permission.

Listed as visa-required; official mission directs visa-required nationalities to eVisa. Entry by air only under the Immigration country-table asterisk. No third-country visa/residence exemption assumed. Authorised tourist stay must be checked on approval/visit pass.
Listed as visa-required; official mission directs visa-required nationalities to eVisa. Authorised tourist stay must be checked on approval/visit pass. MDAC required unless exempt.

Afghan ordinary-passport tourists must obtain a visa approval letter first, then use the eVisa Tourists with VAL category. The ordinary eVisa for Tourist category is limited to Afghan diplomatic/official passports. No stay length is inferred from the three-month single-entry visa validity.

Tourism waiver effective 15 September 2026. Sufficient funds of 20,000 baht per person/40,000 per family; submit TDAC within three days before arrival (not a visa). Extension up to a further 30 days is discretionary. GB refers to British citizen passport.
Ordinary-passport bilateral exemption on current September 2026 schedule; HK/MO means SAR passport. Submit TDAC within three days before arrival.
Ordinary-passport bilateral exemption, separately listed from the 30-day unilateral tourist scheme. Submit TDAC within three days before arrival.

Outside the current ordinary-passport exemption/VOA schedule, obtain an appropriate visa before travel. Ordinary-passport waiver under Resolution 44/NQ-CP. GB means British citizen; British National (Overseas) is excluded. General entry conditions apply.
Tourism Stimulus Program under Resolution 229/NQ-CP; passport valid at least six months and general entry conditions apply. No organised-tour condition is stated in this successor policy.

Ordinary-passport bilateral exemption. This does not extend to working or residence. Indonesia’s 14-day figure in the same table is for diplomatic/official passports, not ordinary tourists.
Ordinary-passport bilateral exemption, total stay not exceeding 90 days in a calendar year; supersedes the old Belarus 45-day unilateral listing.
Ordinary-passport bilateral exemption; cumulative stay must not exceed 90 days within 180 days.

Tourist visa on arrival is described by Cambodia’s mission serving the US and Canada; valid passport with six months validity and passport photo. Three-month advance visa validity is not a three-month stay. eVisa nationality/port details were not fully retrieved.
Ordinary-passport exemption explicitly distinguished from diplomatic/service-only exemptions. Passport validity requirements apply. Complete LDIF at participating checkpoints.

Ordinary-passport tourist exemption only when entering and departing at Yangon, Mandalay or Nay Pyi Taw international airports.

policies.n: HKSAR passport: temporary visa exemption15 June–15 October2026, explicitly confirmed by Hong Kong Immigration citing the Cambodian consulate. Complete Cambodia e-Arrival before entry; confirm intended checkpoint. This14-day pilot is not a30-day tourist eVisa.

PRC ordinary passport or Macao SAR passport: government notice explicitly describes visa exemption, maximum14 days per entry, during15 June–15 October2026. Complete E-Arrival Card before entry; no advance visa or visa fee. Detailed destination checkpoint/stamping implementation could not be independently retrieved. Ordinary tourist visas are a separate regime.

Australian ordinary passport: tourist VOA or pre-approved eVisa,30-day stay from arrival. Passport6 months; air arrivals submit e-Arrival within7 days. Use eligible/open checkpoints; Cambodia–Thailand land crossings reported closed at check date.

French ordinary passport: tourist visa on arrival or approved eVisa before travel. Initial stay duration not stated by this source; one-month extension is separate. Passport6 months beyond requested visa validity; air-arrival e-Arrival required. Confirm eligible/open ports; Thailand land crossings reported closed.

HKSAR ordinary passport: Hong Kong Immigration explicitly confirms tourist VOA30 at Lao international airports/international border checkpoints. Lao eVisa fee selector also accepts HKSAR for30 days; use the designated eVisa ports when choosing that alternative. Do not apply the diplomatic/service-only14-day waiver to ordinary SAR passports.

MOFA explicitly lists a visa requirement for this nationality. Obtain the appropriate entry approval before travel; tourist applications may be sponsor/agent-mediated. This generic requirement does not establish that electronic issuance is unavailable. No third-country visa or residence permit is assumed; stay is determined by the issued permit.
Maximum 90 days in any rolling 180-day period, counting previous UAE stays; not 90 days on each entry. Ordinary national passport.

US regular passport: visa issued on arrival. Total maximum 90 days, continuous or intermittent, within 180 days from first entry; non-renewable under this facility. Six-month passport validity and confirmed onward/return ticket.

British citizens: free visitor visa issued on arrival. Maximum aggregate 90 days within the 180-day period beginning with first entry, not a fresh 90 days on each visit. Passport must have six months validity.
MOFA lists this GCC nationality as visa-free. No visitor duration is specified by this source; the source alone is not evidence of unrestricted residence rights.
GCC nationals are explicitly exempt from the entry-visa requirement and may enter with their national ID card. The retrieved source does not state a visitor stay limit.

British citizens may obtain a visa on arrival or apply online in advance. The standard automatically issued period is two weeks; other visit-visa products have different limits. Evidence of onward/return travel may be required. The two-week standard is not certified as the stay for every alternative eVisa product.
policies.stay: Standard automatically issued visa: 2 weeks; other eVisa/visit products have separate limits

policies.n: Singapore ordinary-passport holders are eligible for visa on arrival and advance eVisa. Duration and product-specific conditions must be checked on the issued visa.

British citizens require a visa arranged well before travel, through an organised tour or an Iranian sponsor. The retrieved advice does not prove unrestricted direct eVisa eligibility. Iranian dual nationals must use an Iranian passport. Israeli or Israel-border stamps may cause refusal.

Canadian ordinary-passport holders require a tourist visa. Electronic application/issuance eligibility is not established by the generic requirement. Passport must be valid six months beyond planned departure; Israel-related stamps may cause refusal.
Tourism only, once every six months; the 15-day stay is non-extendable. Passport must have at least six months validity from departure to Iran.
Serbian ordinary passports: tourist stay up to 15 days within six months. Other purposes and emergency travel documents require a visa.
Turkish ordinary passports are exempt for 90 days. The source does not state a rolling-period limit.

PIBA lists an ordinary-passport visa requirement. Obtain the appropriate B/2 permission before travel. This table does not establish that an electronic visa is unavailable; nationality/residence-specific application methods require confirmation. No generic stay duration is asserted.

Advance ETA-IL required for ordinary visa-exempt tourist travel. Up to 90 days per visit; authorisation valid up to two years or passport expiry, whichever is earlier. Admission remains subject to border permission.

ETA-IL required for otherwise visa-exempt German citizens; up to 90 days per visit, not the two-year authorisation validity. Berlin exempts citizens born after 1928 and requires visas before 1928; confirm the 1928 boundary. German citizens born in Iran, Iraq, Lebanon or Syria need consular review; dual nationals of those states face an entry restriction.

Advance ETA-IL required for ordinary visa-exempt tourist travel. Up to 90 days per visit; authorisation valid up to two years or passport expiry, whichever is earlier. Admission remains subject to border permission. Applies to the SAR passport, not other travel documents.

A B/2 tourist visa is required. The published eVisa-B2 pilot is available to Indian and Sri Lankan passport holders residing in India or Sri Lanka; residence elsewhere is not assumed eligible. Consular attendance may still be required. Permitted stay is determined by admission.

Requires a biometric Moldovan ordinary passport and advance ETA-IL. Non-biometric Moldovan passports require a visa. ETA validity up to two years/passport expiry does not extend the 90-day visit limit.

Ordinary passports on the MOI eligible list may obtain a single-entry tourist visa online or on arrival at Kuwait International Airport. Entry validity is 30 days from issue, distinct from up to 90 days stay after entry. Passport six months, confirmed travel ticket, hotel reservation and no security restriction. Other visa products, including multiple-entry visas, have different limits.

British citizens may obtain the single-entry tourist visa online or on arrival at Kuwait International Airport; up to 90 days stay is distinct from 30-day entry validity. British citizens born in AF, IR, IQ, LB, PK, SD, SY or YE must obtain an embassy visa before travel and are not eligible for arrival issuance. Six-month passport validity and onward/return ticket and accommodation required.
Cost-free tourist visa issued on arrival for one month; extension to three months requires approval, not automatic initial admission. Notify General Security of the current address and changes.
policies.stay: 1 month initially; extension to 3 months subject to approval

policies.n: Cost-free tourist visa issued on arrival for one month; extension to three months requires approval, not automatic initial admission. Notify General Security of the current address and changes. The published rule for female nationals aged 17–45 additionally requires a non-refundable return air ticket and hotel booking or clear residence address; prior artist/masseuse status can trigger advance approval.
policies.stay: 1 month initially; extension to 3 months subject to approval

policies.n: Cost-free tourist visa issued on arrival for one month; extension to three months requires approval, not automatic initial admission. Notify General Security of the current address and changes. SAR passport only.
policies.stay: 1 month initially; extension to 3 months subject to approval

policies.n: Tourist visa exemption explicitly stated for GCC citizens; initial permission six months. Family/employee accompaniment provisions have separate conditions.

policies.n: Tourist exemption requires a Jordanian passport containing a national number; initial permission three months. Temporary/non-national-number passports require separate clearance.
policies.stay: 3 months

policies.n: Tourist arrival visa for one month, extendable to three months by approval. Requires round-trip air ticket, hotel reservation or residence address with telephone number, and USD 2,000 or a bank-certified cheque of that amount.
policies.stay: 1 month initially; extension to 3 months subject to approval

policies.n: Iranian tourists must obtain a consular visa or prior General Security approval. Do not retain an unconditional visa-on-arrival or visa-free rule from older nationality lists.
Obtain prior General Security entry approval. Afghan nationals may enter exclusively through Beirut Rafic Hariri International Airport.

The published General Security rules require an embassy visa or prior General Security authorisation for this ordinary-passport tourist route. Work/diplomatic exceptions are not ordinary-tourist waivers. No generic stay or exclusion of electronic processing is established.

First-group tourist waiver: passport valid at least six months, return ticket, confirmed hotel reservation, health insurance and sufficient funds. Maximum 14 days, not extendable or convertible to a residence visa. Hong Kong/Macao entries cover the corresponding SAR passport.
GCC citizens are explicitly exempt from entry visas. This page gives no short-visit duration for GCC nationals.

With no qualifying foreign residence or visa, apply in advance for a Hayya A1 tourist entry visa. Hotel reservation is required during the application; pay the visa fee after approval. Stay must be checked on the issued permission.

Official checker returns visa-free entry based on this passport nationality alone. Passport must be valid at least three months from arrival and a confirmed hotel booking is required. The current checker does not state a nationality-specific stay/rolling limit; no 30/90-day allowance is assumed.
Official baseline checker offers visa-free entry or advance Hayya A1. Passport must be valid at least three months from arrival. No nationality-specific stay/rolling limit is stated.
GCC citizens do not require a visa. The official page does not state a visitor-duration limit for this category.

Official baseline checker offers visa-free entry or advance Hayya A1. Passport must be valid at least three months from arrival. No nationality-specific stay/rolling limit is stated. Corresponding SAR passport only.
Visa on arrival requires an eligible hotel stay booked through Discover Qatar before travel and QAR 100 visa fee at the airport; advance Hayya A1 is an alternative. Stay duration is not stated.
Official baseline checker permits arrival visa for QAR 100 or advance Hayya A1. No foreign residence or third-country visa is assumed and no stay length is stated.
Book a visa-on-arrival eligible hotel through Discover Qatar before travel. Obtain arrival entry visa or apply in advance for Hayya A1. No nationality-specific stay duration is stated.

The official nationality checker explicitly returns visa on arrival; confirmed round-trip ticket and passport valid at least three months from arrival. No nationality-specific stay duration is stated.

US citizens: multiple-entry visa on arrival valid up to two years or passport expiry, whichever is earlier; each stay is up to 90 days. Passport minimum three months and confirmed hotel booking. Two-year visa validity is not continuous-stay permission.

British citizens: advance ETA permits multiple entries but an aggregate 180 days across its 730-day validity, not 180 days per visit. Tourist eVisa/arrival visa alternatives permit 90 days total across a 365-day visa. Passport six months. Hajj needs a separate visa; tourist permission does not authorise it.
policies.stay: ETA: 180 days total across 730-day validity; tourist visa: 90 days total across 365-day validity

policies.n: With no qualifying foreign visa/residence, the official checker directs this nationality to an embassy/consulate or authorised visa office. Requires six-month passport, return ticket, Saudi address, itinerary, residence/employment evidence and financial solvency. Under-18 travellers require specified adult family accompaniment. Published tourist stay is up to 90 days; one-year visa validity is not permission for a year-long stay.

The official nationality checker offers tourist eVisa or visa on arrival at an airport/entry point. It reports a maximum 90 consecutive days, distinct from one-year multiple-entry or three-month single-entry visa validity. Do not assume re-entry resets an aggregate allowance; follow the issued visa. Passport requires at least six months beyond entry. Minors travelling without a guardian must verify their home-country and travel-document requirements.
GCC nationals do not need a visa and may enter Saudi Arabia using a national ID card or passport. This tourist-entry source does not state a visitor duration.

No qualifying foreign status assumed. Tourist eVisa is available only through a qualified agency integrated package: licensed hotel at least four stars, confirmed return flights and insurance; minimum SAR4000 per adult for first two days plus SAR1000 each extra day. Package 2–88 days, up to nine adult tourists with up to five child companions; travel at least 48 hours after purchase; Makkah and Madinah excluded. Three-month visa validity is not a stay limit. Ordinary consular tourist visa remains an alternative.
policies.label: Agency package eVisa or consular visa

policies.n: Irish nationality is mapped to advance electronic visa waiver: single entry up to 180 days. Apply outside Saudi Arabia within the stated 90-day pre-travel window and at least 48 hours before travel; print approval. Tourist eVisa/arrival visa alternatives have a separate maximum 90-day stay. This is distinct from the UK multiple-entry 730-day ETA.
policies.stay: Electronic waiver: up to 180 days for one entry; tourist visa alternatives: up to 90 days

policies.n: The official nationality checker offers tourist eVisa or visa on arrival at an airport/entry point. It reports a maximum 90 consecutive days, distinct from one-year multiple-entry or three-month single-entry visa validity. Do not assume re-entry resets an aggregate allowance; follow the issued visa. Passport requires at least six months beyond entry. Minors travelling without a guardian must verify their home-country and travel-document requirements. Corresponding SAR passport only.

Russian passport holders need no visa or prior application. Maximum aggregate 90 days within a calendar year, continuous or across multiple visits, not a rolling 180-day rule. Valid Russian passport required; the specific exemption text takes precedence over duplicated generic visa-validity boilerplate.

The official nationality checker offers tourist eVisa or visa on arrival at an airport/entry point. It reports a maximum 90 consecutive days, distinct from one-year multiple-entry or three-month single-entry visa validity. Do not assume re-entry resets an aggregate allowance; follow the issued visa. US citizens may enter with a valid passport regardless of remaining validity under this source. Minors travelling without a guardian must verify their home-country and travel-document requirements.

British citizens must obtain a visa before travel; FCDO directs applicants to the Syrian eVisa website. Passport at least three months on arrival. Israeli or Iranian dual citizenship prevents entry under the express restriction; Israeli travel evidence may lead to refusal.

FCDO explicitly states that holders of Israeli or Iranian citizenship cannot enter Syria. This nationality-wide statement is separate from British-only visa advice; do not treat it as a generic visa-required route.

Canadian ordinary passports require a tourist visa in advance. The Canadian page directs non-Arab applicants to a Syrian mission; current electronic availability for CA remains unconfirmed. Register with immigration before day 15 for longer stays; passport validity six months beyond planned departure.

An advance Yemeni visa is required under the embassy nationality list/US-passport instructions. Washington currently does not issue tourist visas: confirm a functioning competent-authority channel before travel. This mission-specific suspension is not a universal nationality entry ban. Immigration invitation, six-month passport and onward/return travel are required; stay is unspecified. The official Aden eVisa portal provides an agency-mediated tourist approval process. The urgent-tourist option issues the final sticker at the border after prior authority approval; these are sequential steps, not independent eVisa/VOA alternatives.

British citizens require a visa before travel and a passport valid at least six months on arrival. For visits longer than 14 days, register the passport with Yemeni immigration. No tourist stay length is specified. The official Aden eVisa portal provides an agency-mediated tourist approval process. The urgent-tourist option issues the final sticker at the border after prior authority approval; these are sequential steps, not independent eVisa/VOA alternatives.

Serbian ordinary-passport holders require a visa. No stay length or unrestricted electronic/arrival method is established. The official Aden eVisa portal provides an agency-mediated tourist approval process. The urgent-tourist option issues the final sticker at the border after prior authority approval; these are sequential steps, not independent eVisa/VOA alternatives.
Turkish ordinary-passport holders must obtain a 30-day eVisa before travel. The 90-day waiver in the same source concerns official passports, not this route.

Indian ordinary passports: advance eVisa facility is listed by MEA. Arrival issuance requires qualifying UAE/UK/US/Saudi/Schengen visa or US Green Card, none assumed here. Its conditional two-week and three-month arrival products are not an unconditional eVisa stay allowance.
Australian passports may obtain a visa on arrival or advance eVisa. The source does not establish that their products share a duration; check the selected/issued visa.
Canadian ordinary passports require a tourist visa and may obtain it online. Passport validity six months beyond expected departure. No stay or unconditional arrival option is asserted.

Serbian ordinary passports: apply online through the official eVisa portal; the cited advice includes sponsor delivery of the original visa at the border. A Bahraini consular visa is another route. Stay unspecified.

HKSAR passports: arrival visa allows up to 14 days. Advance eVisa is a genuine alternative, but the source does not state its product-specific stay. Do not apply the arrival 14-day period to every eVisa.
policies.stay: Arrival visa: up to 14 days; advance eVisa: duration depends on the issued product

policies.n: Armenia MFA lists a bilateral visa-free regime with Iran for all passport types, including ordinary passports. This source does not quantify the permitted stay in Iran; Armenian inbound stay limits are not applied in reverse.

Ordinary passports in the consulate’s express nationality group must obtain a federal Iraq electronic entry visa before travel; direct visa on arrival is suspended under the cited Baghdad-airport immigration instruction. No stay duration is given. A Kurdistan-only permission is not interchangeable with federal Iraq permission.

Turkish ordinary passports: ages 15–50 require a visa; travellers under 15 or over 50 are exempt for 30 days. These are age-conditioned regimes, not alternative methods available to every holder. General adult tourist application method and stay remain unspecified; do not use business/worker eVisa instructions as tourist proof.

Restricted nationality: obtain Ministry of Interior approval and electronic visa before travel. Tourist application is submitted through a qualified Jordanian tourism office; further documents or interview may be requested. Six-month passport; print issued approval. This is not visa on arrival or an automatic approval. Current stay is not specified.

Ordinary passport in the non-restricted category: the official embassy PDFs expressly permit visa on arrival, with advance MOI eVisa as an alternative. Passport at least six months. Arrival issuance depends on crossing: Queen Alia airport/Sheikh Hussein are documented; King Hussein/Allenby requires advance approval and its conditions must be read. Stay for each method is unspecified; no 30/90-day assumption. Jordan Pass is only a conditional fee waiver.
Turkish ordinary passports: visa-free for no more than 90 days within 180 days. This bilateral rule is separate from non-restricted nationality arrival-visa rules.

Australian ordinary-passport tourists without Syrian identity documents need a visa and can apply through the official Syrian eVisa portal. Local territorial permits and prior-Israel-travel restrictions can still apply. No stay specified.
India MEA explicitly lists Syria as providing an eVisa facility for ordinary Indian passport holders. No duration is supplied; approval and current entry restrictions still require confirmation.
Türkiye MFA states Turkish nationals are visa-exempt; ordinary-passport travellers pay a fee at the border. Payment of that fee is not itself a visa requirement. No stay duration is specified.

Turkish ordinary passports require Yemeni permission; official-passport exemptions do not apply. The Aden electronic tourist approval workflow is agency-mediated and final territorial/port permission must be confirmed. No stay length is established. The official Aden eVisa portal provides an agency-mediated tourist approval process. The urgent-tourist option issues the final sticker at the border after prior authority approval; these are sequential steps, not independent eVisa/VOA alternatives.

Turkish ordinary passports: 30 days per visit and no more than 90 days in 180 days under the nationality-specific MFA rule. This is distinct from Oman’s general 14-day visitor facility and is not extended to other first-group nationalities.

HKSAR passport: eVisa or arrival tourist visa. Hong Kong Immigration lists single-entry VOA as 30-day stay/90-day validity and multiple-entry as 90-day stay/one-year validity; current Saudi Tourism text instead says up to 90 consecutive days for either product. No single duration can safely represent these alternatives. HK authority names six arrival ports: Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Medinah airports; King Fahad Bridge and Al Bathaa land ports. Check issued permission.

Apply and receive approval outside Australia. Genuine temporary visitor; health and character requirements apply; no Australian employment. Home Affairs advises applicants with criminal convictions to use subclass 600 instead. Each family member needs a separate application. The 12-month travel validity is not a 12-month stay. Free online eVisitor (651); ETA (601) via AustralianETA app is a genuine alternative with an AUD20 service charge. eVisitor requires citizenship and a valid citizen passport from the eligible country; non-citizen passports, certificates of identity and other travel documents are excluded.

policies.n: New Zealand citizen with valid NZ passport may obtain Special Category visa (444) on arrival, allowing visit, work and study while it remains in force. Must not be a behaviour-concern or health-concern non-citizen. Visa ceases on departure; a new SCV is needed on re-entry. This is conditional Trans-Tasman access, not automatic citizenship or permanent residence. SCV is a visa grant, not unconditional free movement. Holding another Australian temporary visa, a permanent visa, or a no-further-stay condition can change the application route; disclose prior removals, relevant convictions and tuberculosis.
policies.stay: Indefinite while SCV remains in force
policies.label: Special Category visa (444), on arrival

policies.n: Visitor visa (600), Tourist stream outside Australia: apply online through ImmiAccount and obtain approval before travel; apply and receive decision outside Australia. Pacific/Timor-Leste fee concessions from 1 July 2026 do not waive the visa.

Classified as a conditional border-issued visa, not unconditional free movement. Australian temporary residents do not qualify.

policies.n: Visitor Visa approval required before ordinary air travel. Applications must be online from 1 October 2026; approval is an eVisa. Health, character, genuine intentions, funds or acceptable sponsor, onward travel and NZTD required. Multiple-entry grants allow a total of 6 months in each 12 months; single-entry grants up to 9 months in 18 months. The actual grant governs. Chinese/Pacific travel from Australia with a qualifying Australian visa and cruise arrival concessions are not assumed.

policies.n: EU agreement for EU citizens excluding Ireland; Brussels Embassy also expressly includes Schengen-area citizens. Maximum 90 days in any 180-day period. Valid passport, genuine non-paid visit and normal entry conditions. No work right.

policies.n: Official Immigration describes tourist visa issued on arrival for exempt-country passports. Maximum 120 days, not extendable; no employment, commercial or business activities or status change. Genuine visit, funds, return/onward ticket, health/character criteria; minors need parent/guardian consent.

policies.n: Non-exempt nationality explicitly listed by Immigration: advance approval required; Tourist visa page links the official eVisa application. Maximum 120 days with no extension or status change. Return/onward travel, funds, genuine visit, health/character conditions and parental consent for minors apply.

policies.n: Short tourist visits, maximum 90 days in any 180 days under the EU waiver (EU26) or Serbian bilateral rule (RS). Valid passport and immigration admission conditions apply; paid activity is outside the EU waiver.
