policies.n: Visitor permit issued by immigration under section 9 and Regulation 2; fee exempt under Schedule 1, not exempt from permit. Subject to support, onward travel/admission and arrival-card requirements; no employment, business, study or proselytising. Extensions require a separate decision.
policies.label: Fee-exempt visitor permit on arrival

policies.n: Visitor permit under section 9 and Regulation 2, maximum 30 days; published permit fee AUD100 unless waived by Minister. Subject to support, onward travel/admission and arrival-card requirements; no employment, business, study or proselytising. Extension is a separate decision.
policies.label: Visitor permit on arrival

policies.n: Free visitor permit on arrival for foreign nationals. Passport valid at least 6 months after intended departure; return/onward ticket and right to enter next country; accommodation details and documented funds. No deportation record, disqualifying criminal history, health threat or alert-list entry. Visitor admission is not work/residence or regional free movement.
policies.label: Free visitor permit on arrival

policies.n: Citizen travelling on an ICAO-standard passport/travel document. Passport must remain valid for at least six months on departure from Kiribati. Maximum aggregate 90 days in any 12-month period under 2023 exemption order; not 90 days per repeat entry. Normal entry permission and exclusion rules apply. HK/MO mean SAR passports.
policies.label: 2023 visa waiver; 90 days in 12 months

policies.n: Section 8 of Immigration Act 2019 requires a visa before travel unless a waiver applies. This ordinary-passport nationality is outside the published 2023 exemption schedule. Obtain visitor visa and entry permission; duration as granted. The source proves prior-visa requirement, not that eVisa/online submission is unavailable; application method needs confirmation from Immigration.
policies.label: Prior visitor visa required

policies.n: Obtain Visitor visa and printed approval before travel. Government tourism accepts emailed application documents including passport, photograph, return itinerary, hotel and employment/support evidence. This is a pre-approved visa, not visa on arrival; online/eVisa method beyond email application is not established.
policies.stay: As granted; published fee bands up to 1, 2 or 3 months
policies.label: Pre-approved visitor visa

policies.n: UAE nationals holding regular passports exempt from pre-entry visa, up to 90 days on each visit under MoU effective 19 November 2017. Normal admission requirements remain.
policies.label: Bilateral visa exemption

policies.n: EU citizen with valid ordinary passport, maximum 90 days in any 180 days. Paid activity excluded from waiver. Onward travel, valid travel document and immigration admissibility required.
policies.label: EU short-stay waiver

policies.n: Section 103(1) permits citizens/nationals of US, Marshall Islands and Palau an entry permit for the visit up to 365 days. This is a visitor-permit entitlement, not unrestricted permanent movement; habitual-residence and employment rules remain. Present citizenship/travel documentation and CIQ form; onward travel or accepted substitute evidence required.
policies.label: Compact/regional visitor admission

policies.n: No entry permit required for a visit of 30 days or less under section 103(1). Valid passport/travel document at least 120 days beyond entry, CIQ form and return/onward travel or accepted proof of departure. An additional permit may allow up to 60 more days; not an automatic 90-day initial stay.
policies.label: 30-day visitor exemption

policies.n: Visa-exempt under the immigration nationality schedule with no period restriction. Not represented as unrestricted free movement because work/residence conditions require separate review.
policies.stay: No period restriction stated in nationality schedule
policies.label: Compact/regional visa exemption

policies.n: The current Immigration-linked nationality schedule explicitly names these countries (including Ireland and UK) as visa-exempt for 90 days in any 180-day period. Ordinary passport, valid at least 6 months beyond departure, onward/return ticket and destination visa if required. No employment, extension or status change.
policies.label: Visa exemption; 90 days in 180

policies.n: Taiwan ordinary passport expressly exempt for 90 days from arrival. Passport valid 6 months beyond departure, return/onward ticket and onward visa if required. No extension, status change, work or study.
policies.label: Taiwan visa exemption

policies.n: Explicitly listed for 90-day visa on arrival, fee waived. Passport valid 6 months beyond departure; return/onward ticket, visas for onward journey, sufficient support and no statutory exclusion. No extension, change of status, employment, study or research.
policies.label: Fee-waived visa on arrival

policies.n: Not within the published exemption/VOA schedule: obtain V-1 visitor visa before travel while outside the Republic. Applications accepted in person/by representative, mail or email; eVisa availability is not established by the public page. Passport, return/onward travel, accommodation, health/police and support evidence required; actual approval governs the stay up to 90 days.
policies.label: Prior visitor visa (V-1)

policies.n: Passport valid at least 6 months on entry, funds and return/onward ticket unless exempt. Submit Palau Entry Form within the 72 hours before departure and present QR code at check-in/arrival; this declaration is not an ETA approval. Sign the Palau Pledge. Bureau explicitly grants citizens of Schengen contracting states 90 days in any 180 days without visa; no paid activity inferred.
policies.label: Schengen-nationality visa waiver

policies.n: Passport valid at least 6 months on entry, funds and return/onward ticket unless exempt. Submit Palau Entry Form within the 72 hours before departure and present QR code at check-in/arrival; this declaration is not an ETA approval. Sign the Palau Pledge. Russian citizens exempt for 30 days under bilateral agreement in force 27 December 2018.
policies.label: Bilateral visa waiver

policies.n: Passport valid at least 6 months on entry, funds and return/onward ticket unless exempt. Submit Palau Entry Form within the 72 hours before departure and present QR code at check-in/arrival; this declaration is not an ETA approval. Sign the Palau Pledge. Taiwanese nationals exempt under reciprocal arrangement effective 1 December 2018, ordinary passports included; no work, study or residence. Bureau source does not specify stay length, so no 30/90-day value is invented.
policies.label: Taiwan bilateral waiver

policies.n: Passport valid at least 6 months on entry, funds and return/onward ticket unless exempt. Submit Palau Entry Form within the 72 hours before departure and present QR code at check-in/arrival; this declaration is not an ETA approval. Sign the Palau Pledge. Tourist visa may be issued on arrival. Two additional 30-day extensions may be requested at least seven days before expiry; each is a separate approval. Initial stay is 30 days, not 90. No employment on tourist visa.
policies.label: Tourist visa on arrival

policies.n: Non-immigrant tourist visa can be issued at an airport or port of arrival, or obtained at a Malagasy mission. No remunerated work. Embassy describes the short-stay category as up to 90 days but does not establish a universal initial 90-day arrival grant; actual grant controls. Tourist checklist requires return travel and passport validity more than 6 months after return, with two free pages. Online method and the 15-day fee/visa distinction remain unconfirmed for this group.
policies.stay: As granted; non-immigrant category up to 90 days
policies.label: Arrival tourist visa; consular alternative

policies.n: British citizen tourist: UK FCDO expressly says up to 15 days without a visa, with EUR10 arrival administration fee and onward/return ticket. Longer visits require a 30- or 60-day single-entry visa on arrival, extendable to total 90 days. Passport valid 6 months after arrival with two blank pages. Madagascar Embassy offers an advance consular visa alternative. No common 15-day duration applies to the longer-stay visa alternatives.
policies.label: 15-day visit; arrival visas for longer stays
policies.stay: Visa-free: up to 15 days; arrival visa: 30 or 60 days; consular visa: as granted

policies.n: Valid travel documents, genuine tourist purpose and admission decision required. The immigration officer determines the actual stay; maximum six months of tourism in a calendar year is case-by-case, not an automatic per-entry allowance. Nationality is expressly marked No visa required; no generic 90-day duration added. HK and MO denote SAR passports.
policies.label: Visa exemption

policies.n: Valid travel documents, genuine tourist purpose and admission decision required. The immigration officer determines the actual stay; maximum six months of tourism in a calendar year is case-by-case, not an automatic per-entry allowance. Country table expressly specifies sixty days on arrival.
policies.label: 60-day visa on arrival

policies.n: Valid travel documents, genuine tourist purpose and admission decision required. The immigration officer determines the actual stay; maximum six months of tourism in a calendar year is case-by-case, not an automatic per-entry allowance. Country table expressly specifies two weeks on arrival; literal non-day period retained.
policies.stay: 2 weeks
policies.label: Two-week visa on arrival

policies.n: Valid travel documents, genuine tourist purpose and admission decision required. The immigration officer determines the actual stay; maximum six months of tourism in a calendar year is case-by-case, not an automatic per-entry allowance. Obtain visa before travel. Guyana requirement is an explicit note on the main requirements page. No eVisa unavailability is inferred from the prior-visa classification.
policies.label: Visa required before travel

policies.n: Obtain Seychelles Travel Authorisation before departure; visitor permit is then issued on arrival, initially up to three months. These are sequential steps, not alternative ETA/VOA routes. Recognised passport valid for intended stay and return, onward/return ticket, confirmed accommodation and at least USD150/day. No prohibited-immigrant status or existing residence-entitling permit. Maritime TA applies to tourist sea arrivals too. Extensions are separate, not a 12-month initial grant.
policies.stay: Initial visitor permit up to 3 months
policies.label: Travel Authorisation + visitor permit

policies.n: Visitor Visa approval required before ordinary air travel. Applications must be online from 1 October 2026; approval is an eVisa. Health, character, genuine intentions, funds or acceptable sponsor, onward travel and NZTD required. Multiple-entry grants allow a total of 6 months in each 12 months; single-entry grants up to 9 months in 18 months. The actual grant governs. Chinese/Pacific travel from Australia with a qualifying Australian visa and cruise arrival concessions are not assumed. Conditional pilot only: actual entry into Australia and direct departure from an Australian airport, an Australian visa in subclass 600, 462, 400, 651, 417, 500, 485, 407, 590, 482, 491, 188, 494, 457, 160, 162, 161, 476, 163, 165, 164, 820, 309, 870, 461, 300, 173, 445, 884, 410, 405 valid at airline check-in, and a valid NZeTA. This permits up to three months per visit. Australian airport transit alone is insufficient. Passport-only primary rule remains Visitor eVisa; no conditional ETA added to a. The announced pilot began 3 November 2025 and continues while evaluated; no until date inferred.
policies.stay: As granted: up to 6 months in 12, or 9 months in 18
policies.label: Visitor eVisa

policies.n: Passport valid at least six months on entry; genuine tourist, return/onward travel and sufficient funds. Complete mandatory PNG Digital Arrival Card before boarding-pass issuance; the card does not replace the visa. No paid work. Current ICA VOA schedule applies to these ordinary nationalities. The Embassy specifically states 60-day Easy Visitor admission for listed Pacific states; other grants depend on class. Online permits have their own nationality lists and durations. Chinese ordinary group-tour exceptions are not assumed.
policies.stay: As granted; Pacific Easy Visitor VOA stated as 60 days
policies.label: Visa on arrival

policies.n: Passport valid at least six months on entry; genuine tourist, return/onward travel and sufficient funds. Complete mandatory PNG Digital Arrival Card before boarding-pass issuance; the card does not replace the visa. No paid work. Currently selectable and eligible for Easy Visitor Permit (60 Day) in the public checker. Apply and obtain grant before travel. Single entry. Do not infer VOA from eVisa eligibility.
policies.label: Easy Visitor Permit (60 Day)

policies.n: Passport valid at least six months on entry; genuine tourist, return/onward travel and sufficient funds. Complete mandatory PNG Digital Arrival Card before boarding-pass issuance; the card does not replace the visa. No paid work. Currently selectable and eligible for Tourist - Own Itinerary in the public checker. Product description states single-entry stay of sixty days from arrival. Apply and receive approval before travel.
policies.label: Tourist - Own Itinerary eVisa

policies.n: Passport valid at least six months on entry; genuine tourist, return/onward travel and sufficient funds. Complete mandatory PNG Digital Arrival Card before boarding-pass issuance; the card does not replace the visa. No paid work. Currently eligible for Easy Visitor Permit (30 Day) in the public checker; single entry, no extension. No longer stay inferred from another visa class.
policies.label: Easy Visitor Permit (30 Day)

policies.n: Chinese citizens: current Embassy advice of 24 September 2026 confirms visa-free family visits, tourism and business inspection not exceeding 30 days; no long-term residence or work. SI policy additionally mentions an accumulated 90-day limit without a clear reference period; do not assume 90 days per visit or a reset through re-entry.
policies.label: Chinese visitor visa waiver

policies.n: MSG ordinary passports FJ/PG/VU: pre-entry online application and approval, passport bio page, return/onward ticket and support. Visa service fee is waived, but online lodgement is charged; not unrestricted regional movement. Live portal and Immigration product say three months per entry within one-year validity; parent Ministry page says sixty days, so the actual grant must settle this duration discrepancy. Work prohibited.
policies.stay: As granted; published MSG descriptions differ: 3 months or 60 days
policies.label: MSG visitor eVisa

policies.n: Current Immigration policy expressly replaces the old concessional VOA arrangement with electronic visa applications. This nationality appears in the public Tourist eligibility list. Obtain grant before travel; passport, return ticket, genuine-tourist purpose and sufficient funds required; no work/business. Portal describes three months per entry, with one-year multiple-entry validity. Delivery policy annual 180-day wording conflicts with older 2013 annual 90-day rule; annual cap is not asserted as settled here.
policies.stay: Up to 3 months per entry, subject to grant
policies.label: Pre-entry Tourist eVisa

policies.n: European ordinary passport explicitly covered by the Embassy visa-free 90-day list and/or government-linked 90-day table (including Cyprus, Croatia and Portugal). Valid passport and return/onward arrangements required. No work right. Ninety days is expressly stated by the source; it is not a conversion from three months. Full treaty rolling-period wording was not retrieved.
policies.label: European short-stay visa waiver

policies.n: Full Embassy list and current Ministry-linked handbook expressly give listed ordinary visitors a free 31-day visitor visa on arrival. Valid passport at least six months, return/onward ticket to an admissible country, and support required. HK/MO mean SAR passports; Korea read as Republic of Korea consistently with earlier consular list. Employment/business/study require appropriate permission. Older one-month/30-day summaries are not treated as literal equivalents to this explicit 31-day source.
policies.label: 31-day visitor visa on arrival

policies.n: Nationality falls under the Embassy explicit NOT-listed rule: obtain a letter of authority/entry approval before travelling, then apply at arrival for visitor visa. This is a mandatory prior approval, not an unconditional VOA. Immigration checklist requires signed application, photo, passport copy, concrete purpose, funds and itinerary. Application is through Immigration or a mission; email/mail process is not asserted to be an eVisa. Actual permit determines stay.
policies.label: Advance entry authority required

policies.n: Ordinary tourist visa on arrival supported by the Comoros Mission on-the-spot service and Justice Ministry general foreign-entry statute. Article 2 tourist category is maximum 45 days, with valid national passport or substitute travel document and ticket to leave at stay end. No remunerated activity under Article 8. Three-month short-stay and long-stay visas are separate categories, not a 90-day tourist entitlement. Published treaty exceptions and individual entry refusal grounds still apply.
policies.label: Tourist visa on arrival; statutory 45-day maximum

policies.n: Ordinary tourist visa on arrival supported by the Comoros Mission on-the-spot service and Justice Ministry general foreign-entry statute. Article 2 tourist category is maximum 45 days, with valid national passport or substitute travel document and ticket to leave at stay end. No remunerated activity under Article 8. Three-month short-stay and long-stay visas are separate categories, not a 90-day tourist entitlement. Published treaty exceptions and individual entry refusal grounds still apply. UK advice additionally requires passport six months valid on arrival.
policies.label: Tourist visa on arrival; statutory 45-day maximum

policies.n: Ordinary tourist visa on arrival supported by the Comoros Mission on-the-spot service and Justice Ministry general foreign-entry statute. Article 2 tourist category is maximum 45 days, with valid national passport or substitute travel document and ticket to leave at stay end. No remunerated activity under Article 8. Three-month short-stay and long-stay visas are separate categories, not a 90-day tourist entitlement. Published treaty exceptions and individual entry refusal grounds still apply. French advice additionally requires return ticket, EUR30/day means and stay address.
policies.label: Tourist visa on arrival; statutory 45-day maximum

policies.n: Ordinary tourist visa on arrival supported by the Comoros Mission on-the-spot service and Justice Ministry general foreign-entry statute. Article 2 tourist category is maximum 45 days, with valid national passport or substitute travel document and ticket to leave at stay end. No remunerated activity under Article 8. Three-month short-stay and long-stay visas are separate categories, not a 90-day tourist entitlement. Published treaty exceptions and individual entry refusal grounds still apply. Canadian advice additionally requires passport six months beyond intended departure and onward/return ticket.
policies.label: Tourist visa on arrival; statutory 45-day maximum

policies.n: Effective 30 March 2026, Executive Order 499 requires a visa issued before travel OR BCBP written pre-clearance before boarding; visa issuance at port is prohibited for these passports. Submit pre-clearance at least five days before travel by designated official email; include arrival form, passport bio page, non-refundable return ticket, accommodation and funds. Pre-clearance-based stay is ticket-based, maximum 30 days and non-extendable; a separately granted formal visa/permit can authorise longer. No shared duration is assigned to these distinct methods.
policies.stay: Pre-clearance: return-ticket period, maximum 30 days; formal visa: as granted
policies.label: Advance visa or written pre-clearance

policies.n: BCBP confirms exemption from immigration visa/renewal for US/FSM/Marshall Islands citizens for the duration of visit; no onward ticket requirement, but valid passport and Palau Entry Form remain required. This short-tourism rule is visa-free, not unrestricted free movement. Residence/domicile, employment, labour permits and investment laws must be checked separately. Compact section142 recognises conditional US occupational/residence access but reserves Palau regulation. Section1338 addresses worker-status requirements even for people lawfully present without a visa. RPPL11-26 full text was not independently recovered.
policies.stay: Duration of visit under visa exemption; no unconditional work/residence grant asserted
policies.label: Regional/Compact visitor visa exemption

policies.n: Spanish ordinary passport requires visitor visa before travel. Published Spain–Nauru waiver is diplomatic-passport-only and must not be extended to ordinary passports. Confirm grant duration and current application process with Nauru Immigration; source does not establish eVisa unavailability.
policies.label: Prior visitor visa required

policies.n: Russian ordinary international passport: bilateral visa-free stay up to 14 days. Work, study or residence beyond this period requires the appropriate visa. This is the explicit treaty duration; no 90-day claim adopted.
policies.label: Bilateral 14-day visa waiver

policies.n: Ordinary-passport exemption explicitly listed; duration not stated. Diplomatic/service-only agreements are not extended to ordinary passports.
HKSAR passport only.

Full British citizen passport. Apply before travel. A conditional southern-Algeria tourist visa-on-arrival arrangement requires a confirmed booking with an approved local agency and eligible airports; it is not an unrestricted arrival visa. No stay length inferred.
Consular tourist visa procedure explicitly covers Irish passport holders. Check consulate jurisdiction for residence; other visa methods not conclusively established.

Tourism only. Maximum 30 days per entry and 90 days per year; the source does not define a rolling look-back or calendar-year reset, so neither is assumed. Border document and vaccination formalities remain applicable.
HKSAR passport. Maximum 90 days per year; tourism. No rolling-window definition inferred.
African ordinary passport; 90-day visa-free visit. This is a visitor exemption, not unrestricted residence or employment.
HKSAR passport only.
Singapore passport; passport should remain valid six months on expected departure; yellow-fever certificate required.
Advance online application. The 30/90-day FAQ figures describe validity, so a fixed stay is not inferred. Do not treat collection on arrival as an independent walk-up VOA.
HKSAR passport only.
Passport validity six months on expected departure; yellow-fever certificate required.

Advance online approval with QR code, followed by biometrics/visa printing. Air arrival at Yaounde/Douala; for land/sea obtain the physical visa before entry. No independent walk-up VOA. Visa validity bands are not a fixed tourist stay.

Obtain visa before arrival under the rule effective 2026-01-01. EASE registration is not a substitute. No third-country residence permit or Cape Verdean ancestry/status exemption assumed. Stay duration and online issuance eligibility not established.

Visa-exempt tourist visit with EASE pre-registration and TSA airport-security fee where applicable. Register five days before travel. Registration may be completed on arrival under the portal FAQ; it is not a separate visa alternative. Ordinary passport; HKSAR for HK. South Africa waiver requires evidence of tourism/business.
policies.label: Visa-free with EASE registration

policies.n: Ordinary passport; visa-exempt short visit with EASE pre-registration and applicable TSA. Angola and Mozambique tourist limit is 90 days under the PDF footnotes, not the 180-day official/business concession.
policies.label: Visa-free with EASE registration

policies.n: Ordinary Guinea-Bissau passport expressly included in the 180-day row. EASE pre-registration and applicable TSA remain required.
policies.label: Visa-free with EASE registration

policies.n: Full British citizen passport. Apply through the Central African Republic embassy; other visa methods not established.
Visa required; passport valid six months after planned departure. An online embassy form still requires mailing passport and documents; it is not proof of an eVisa.
Nationality explicitly named on official eVisa exemption list; duration not stated.

Apply for advance eVisa; official default requires a visa and permits all non-exempt foreigners to apply online. Portal recommends applying at least seven days before entry, no more than 90 days in advance. Stay not specified; 90-day application window is not stay length.
Obtain a consular visa in advance; embassy expressly says no visas at ports of entry. Two-year US tourist visa validity is not two years of permitted stay. Other electronic methods not established.
Full British citizen passport. Obtain visa before travel. Other visa methods and permitted stay not established.
ECOWAS nationality exemption identified in FCDO general-nationality wording. Short visit only; duration/document-specific free-movement rights not established.

Advance approved pre-enrolment required; collect biometric visa at Abidjan airport. Print approval and payment receipt; passport valid six months, return booking, invitation/accommodation and yellow-fever certificate. Three-month visa/approval validity is not an inferred stay. No independent walk-up VOA.

Full British citizen passport. Visa required; FCDO recommends consular issuance. An official eVisa service exists but could not be retrieved; this does not establish its unavailability or nationality eligibility.
French passport; apply through DGDI eVisa service in advance. No stay duration inferred; portal availability could not be confirmed from this environment.
Short tourism visit under explicit EU/ECOWAS group exemption. Maximum stated trip 90 days; actual border stamp controls permission. No unrestricted residence/employment inferred.
Full British citizen passport. FCDO specifically states initial passport stamp allows 28 days; extensions are separate. This is distinct from the embassy’s general 90-day exemption description.

Live checker: eVisa or embassy visa required. eVisa must be approved before travel; immigration officer sets actual stay up to 60 days. Single-entry eVisa validity of 90 days is separate from stay. Passport/document eligibility and supporting documents remain subject to assessment.

Obtain free ETA before travel via the official portal. Caribbean visa-waiver country - ETA required. Maximum stay 90 days from entry per ETA applicant guide. Fee-free is not authorisation-free; yellow-fever documentation required.

Obtain free ETA before travel via the official portal. African Union citizen - ETA replaces Visa on Arrival. Maximum stay 90 days from entry per ETA applicant guide. Fee-free is not authorisation-free; yellow-fever documentation required.

Live checker expressly requires neither visa nor ETA for ECOWAS/AES citizens; travel on a valid passport. No application/fee. Its validity_days=90 field is not treated as a separately proven stay allowance.

Obtain free ETA before travel via the official portal. Asian visa-waiver country - ETA required. Maximum stay 90 days from entry per ETA applicant guide. Fee-free is not authorisation-free; yellow-fever documentation required.

Apply online and obtain Entry Visa Letter before departure; biometric capture and visa issuance at the arrival counter are completion of this process, not a separate walk-up VOA. Passport valid more than six months, return ticket, accommodation, sufficient funds and yellow-fever certificate. Portal validity figures are not treated as stay.
Passport issuing authority explicitly selected as visa-waived in the Border Police checker. No waiver stay duration stated.
Full British citizen passport. Visa required; contact Guinea-Bissau embassy. Unconditional VOA/eVisa eligibility is not established.

Visa required. Conditional Bissau-airport issuance requires advance notification by a local correspondent, emergency circumstances or absence of an embassy/consulate in the departure country. It is not an unrestricted VOA; residence/departure circumstances are not assumed.
Must be an ECOWAS citizen carrying an ECOWAS passport. A generic nationality claim or other travel document does not establish this exemption. Stay not specified.

British visitor applying from the UK must obtain embassy visa. LIS online Visa on Arrival is restricted to travelers without a Liberian embassy in their country and to Roberts International Airport; prior paid approval and QR confirmation are mandatory. No residence elsewhere assumed; method may differ there.
Named nationality or current ECOWAS member; valid passport or identity card per embassy. This short-visit exemption does not prove unrestricted residence/work. Stay unspecified.
HKSAR passport; stay determined by competent authorities on arrival (schedule Remark 6).
Full British citizen passport. Application/payment fully online through Malian MFA; approved entry permit issued electronically. No stay duration inferred.
Ordinary-passport agreement listed without diplomatic/service limitation; duration unspecified. Diplomatic/service-only agreements for other countries are not ordinary-passport waivers.

Full British citizen passport. Advance eVisa required since 2025-01-05; no walk-up visa on arrival. Print approval. Pay fees on arrival in exact euros or US dollars; payment/biometrics at border do not constitute an independent VOA.
Full British citizen passport. Apply to Niger embassy in Geneva. Source does not establish eVisa availability or stay.
HKSAR passport only.
Prior visa required; France MFA expressly says none issued on arrival at the airport. Duration determined on application; eVisa availability not established.
Full British citizen passport. Show return/onward travel and accommodation. Passport valid six months after arrival.
policies.stay: 3 months

policies.n: French passport; passport valid more than six months.
policies.stay: less than 3 months

policies.n: Singapore passport; passport validity six months on expected departure.
Ordinary EU passport from a Schengen-participating EU state, or US passport. This policy does not assume a third-country visa.
policies.stay: 2 weeks

policies.n: Full British citizen passport. Short tourism visit; 20-euro entry fee is not a visa. No third-country visa assumed.

Advance eVisa application and approval. Each visit up to 30 days; 90-day single-entry or 365-day multiple-entry validity is not stay duration. Other arrival alternatives are not established by this checker.
Official nationality checker explicitly displays a visa-free benefit. Stay duration is not specified by the checker; no 30/90-day assumption.
Full British citizen passport. Tourist visa on arrival or advance eVisa. Single-entry validity 90 days and multiple-entry validity 365 days each allow a maximum 30-day visit.

Explicitly listed nationality exemption, including BF/ML/NE. Complete online immigration/health formalities before border arrival, particularly by air. Exemption duration not stated; no unrestricted residence/work inferred.

Advance eVisa required for ordinary passports in the eligible/bilateral-default lists. Tourist options are 1–15, 16–30 or 31–90 days; fee and entries depend on chosen duration. Apply at least six working days ahead. Passport validity at least three months beyond requested visa; air travelers need flight booking. Online arrival/departure registration also required.

Visa-free under the AES confederal declaration signed 2024-12-14 and published 2024-12-16. Current ECOWAS nationality; national entry/document and admissibility rules remain applicable. No visitor duration specified and no unrestricted work/residence entitlement inferred. This rule concerns entry into the AES, not reciprocal entry into ECOWAS.

Visa-free under the AES confederal declaration signed 2024-12-14 and published 2024-12-16. Current ECOWAS nationality; national entry/document and admissibility rules remain applicable. No visitor duration specified and no unrestricted work/residence entitlement inferred. This rule concerns entry into the AES, not reciprocal entry into ECOWAS.

Visa-free under the AES confederal declaration signed 2024-12-14 and published 2024-12-16. Current ECOWAS nationality; national entry/document and admissibility rules remain applicable. No visitor duration specified and no unrestricted work/residence entitlement inferred. This rule concerns entry into the AES, not reciprocal entry into ECOWAS.

Apply and obtain the eVisa before travel. Official maximum short stay is 90 days; actual permitted duration is fixed from the application, not automatically 90 days. Health insurance and supporting purpose/accommodation documents are required. Visa validity and granted stay must both be observed.

Nationality expressly covered by January 2026 ordinary eVisa instructions. Obtain approval and download QR code before travel; payment receipt alone is not a visa. Washington DC residents must attend the mission for sticker/biometrics; other applicants may complete at mission or eligible border. Verify route-specific port availability; no unapproved walk-up VOA. Six-month visa validity is not assigned as stay. Passport valid at least six months, return itinerary, yellow-fever certificate, accommodation and funds required.

Canadian ordinary passport: online pre-enrolment/application and payment through evisacam.cm. Observe the responsible mission’s residence-based biometric/sticker procedure and obtain approval before departure. Passport valid six months. Six-month visa validity not converted into guaranteed stay; diplomatic fee waivers do not exempt ordinary passports.
Canadian ordinary tourist passport requires a visa. Method and stay not established; this does not assert eVisa unavailability.

French ordinary passport: visa before departure, no visa on arrival. Submit/pay online, then supply physical passport to the mission for issuance. Online application is not evidence of a standalone eVisa. Embassy’s 15/91-day visa periods do not establish one tourist stay length.

Canadian ordinary passport: obtain visa before departure through the mission for the country of residence. Canada says no visas at ports of entry. No stay inferred; electronic issuance outside this consular process remains unverified.

DGM public FAQ permits advance electronic tourist/visit approval, followed by VAP issuance at the border; not a walk-up VOA or two independent visa methods. Approval must be used within three months; VAP is described as seven-day validity, extendable. No separate per-visit stay inferred. FAQ content is dated 2020/2021 but remains active on the service linked by current DGM; confirm current execution before travel.
policies.label: Advance eVisa / visa-volant approval

policies.n: Canadian ordinary passport: tourist visa required before departure. Canadian guidance directs residents to Ottawa and says no port issuance; DGM FAQ separately describes advance eVisa/VAP processing. Country-specific implementation is unresolved, so this generic requirement does not mean eVisa unavailable. No walk-up VOA or fixed stay assumed.

Ordinary passport explicitly named in the government’s dated 2018 exemption schedule, still publicly available; no exemption expiry or waiver stay length specified. This positive waiver evidence is not used to infer requirements for omitted countries. Current admission/document checks remain applicable.
Singapore passport; valid six months on expected departure and yellow-fever certificate required.

Obtain online pre-enrolment approval and receipt before boarding; biometric visa collected at Felix-Houphouet-Boigny airport, Abidjan. Passport six months, accommodation/invitation, return booking and yellow-fever documentation. Approval validity is not stay; no unrestricted VOA.

Full British citizen passport. Advance eVisa approval; currently enabled eVisa border is Malabo International Airport only. Passport valid six months, printed approval, return flight, hotel/invitation and yellow-fever certificate. Arrival sticker is completion of advance processing, not independent VOA. Portal duration strings conflict, so stay unspecified.

Ordinary passport; visa requirement independently confirmed by origin government, with universal regular-passport eVisa application eligibility on official service. Advance approval; Malabo International Airport only. Six-month passport, return flight and accommodation required. Canadian tourism guidance also requires police clearance. Conflicting portal stay/validity strings prevent a fixed stay assignment.
Canadian tourist passport requires visa. eVisa availability for this origin remains unverified; generic requirement does not assert consular-only issuance.

Serbian ordinary passport; advance eVisa available for arrival at Libreville Leon Mba International Airport only, with consular alternative. Six-month eVisa validity is not six months of stay. Yellow-fever vaccination certificate required.
Canadian ordinary tourist passport requires a visa. No unconditional eVisa/VOA availability or exclusion established; stay unspecified.
Portuguese ordinary passport requires entry authorization. Consult Guinea-Bissau embassy; authorization method and stay not specified. CPLP membership alone is not visa-free entry.

Advance ANRPTS eVisa required under procedure effective 2025-01-05. Apply before departure; embassy no longer issues the visa. Pay/biometric formalities at the border are not an independent VOA. Several duration options exist; no single stay assigned without the granted visa.
Canadian ordinary passport: visa before travel; passport six months beyond expected departure. Electronic availability/exclusion and stay not established.
Serbian ordinary passport requires visa. No inference that eVisa is unavailable; stay unspecified.

Current ECOWAS nationality; Nigeria explicitly exempts from entry visa/permit. Complete separate online landing and exit cards; landing card within 24–48 hours before arrival per NIS FAQ. No unrestricted residence/work or visitor stay inferred. BF/ML/NE are not automatically included.
Saint Kitts and Nevis nationality waiver effective 2025-08-04, announced by government 2025-09-01. Stay not specified. Separate Nigerian landing/exit declarations still apply.

Advance F5A tourist visa; eVisa or embassy process available. Single entry, stay 30 days, non-extendable and no employment. Ninety-day issuance validity is separate. Return ticket, accommodation and 180-day bank statement required; landing/exit cards are separate. No walk-up VOA.

Ordinary nationality expressly named on Senegal Embassy Canada’s published short-stay exemption list; maximum 90 days. Passport valid six months and return/onward/accommodation evidence as applicable. BF/ML/NE named individually; not an inference from ECOWAS membership.

Serbian ordinary passport requires visa; diplomatic/official waiver is excluded. Embassy procedure documented. SMF has an online preapproval service, but Serbian eligibility/method implementation not conclusively established; no claim eVisa unavailable.
Visitor entry permit; no employment or volunteering. Hong Kong/Macao entries apply to SAR passports. Aggregate visitor allowance is three months per calendar year, not a new three months each entry.
policies.stay: Up to 3 months per calendar year

policies.n: Visa required under regime effective 1 April 2025. Online eVisa or in-person arrival visa; no fixed stay proved by fact sheet. In-person applications: Ariamsvlei, Hosea Kutako, Impalila, Katima Mulilo, Lüderitz Harbour, Mohembo, Noordoewer, Ngoma, Oranjemund Border, Oshikango, Trans-Kalahari, Walvis Bay Airport/Harbour. Other listed ports accept preissued eVisa only; Dobe not operational under this fact sheet. Passport 6 months/3 blank pages; insurance, accommodation/itinerary, funds and onward travel evidence as applicable; printed eVisa if obtained online.
Ordinary-passport visitor exemption. Diplomatic/service exemptions and fee waivers are separate.
Each visit is limited to 30 days, with a total of 90 days per calendar year. Ordinary passport; no employment right.
Ordinary-passport visitor exemption. Diplomatic/service exemptions and fee waivers are separate.
Ordinary-passport waiver is an aggregate calendar-year allowance, not 90 days on each visit.
policies.stay: 90 days per calendar year

policies.n: Applies to the named SAR ordinary passport; no employment right.

Visa required before travel under the explicit default and ordinary-passport exemption schedule. No visa on arrival. Availability of an electronic application channel for this nationality is not settled by these sources; duration depends on permission issued.

Named visa-exempt nationality. Return air ticket required for air arrivals; land/water arrivals require funds for stay and departure. Aggregate annual visitor limit; initial grant may require free extension.
policies.stay: Up to 90 days in any 12 months; initial grant may be shorter

policies.n: Visa on arrival at any port or advance eVisa. Passport 6 months and 3 blank pages; host/accommodation details; return ticket for air arrivals, funds for land/water. Annual visitor allowance is not necessarily granted on first entry.
policies.stay: Up to 90 days in any 12 months; initial grant may be shorter

policies.n: Advance clearance required: apply online and obtain approval letter before travel; bring approval and receipt. No unapproved visa on arrival. Annual visitor allowance is not necessarily granted on first entry.
policies.stay: Up to 90 days in any 12 months; initial grant may be shorter

policies.n: Category A; no visa required. Entry declaration can be completed online. No stay length established by category list; HK means HKSAR passport.

Category B; may obtain and pay for visa on arrival. Entry declaration can be prefilled online. Single/double/multiple entry visa validity is not equated to authorised stay. MO means Macao SAR passport.
Category C; apply and pay through official eVisa platform and obtain approval before travel. Apply at least three weeks ahead. No fixed stay proved; visa validity is separate.
Explicitly listed ordinary-passport visa exemption; duration not established by nationality table. Six-month passport, three unused pages and entry biometrics; child documentation requirements apply.

Named visa-required nationality; Embassy directs online application at evisa.gov.bw. Tourist single/multiple visa options exist, but their fee/validity periods are not assigned as a fixed stay. Passport six months/three pages, itinerary/accommodation, financial/employment evidence and biometrics.

Advance entry permission required through Ministry of Home Affairs, manually or by email; not an unconditional visa on arrival and not proof of a working eVisa portal. Approved 72-hour arrival letter only permits entry at Maseru Port of Entry or Moshoeshoe I International Airport. South African transit/re-entry requirements apply; later stay permission must be checked.
Explicit To Lesotho column; starred nationalities exempt for at most 14 days. Unstarred stay is not specified in the table.
Explicit To Lesotho column; starred nationalities exempt for at most 14 days. Unstarred stay is not specified in the table.
Full British citizen passport. Must also meet South African transit/entry requirements; passport at least 90 days after arrival and four blank pages.
Full British citizen passport; passport three months after arrival and two blank pages; entry stamp required. Extension is separate.
Taiwan passport exemption for tourism, business or seminars.
Ordinary-passport tourism/business waiver; diplomatic-only rows not extended to ordinary passports.
All-passport tourism/business waiver explicitly grants 90 days.
Tourist/business eTA; apply online, pay fee, download and print approved preliminary authorisation for boarding and arrival. This is not an unconditional visa waiver.
Official portal explicitly excludes this nationality from eVisa applications and directs applicants to the nearest embassy. No stay length established.

Nationality expressly included in the official eVisa panel. Apply, pay and print approved preliminary eVisa before boarding; tourism for 90 days or less is an application category, not proof of the individual stay grant. Follow the permission issued.
Category One: obtain eVisa or prior authorisation before departure. No arrival-visa entitlement without advance clearance. Visa entry validity does not establish duration of stay.

Category Two: visa on arrival permitted at designated ports from 24 February 2026, with advance eVisa encouraged. This supersedes any assumption of the former broad visa waiver. Visa validity and fees do not establish stay.

Explicitly named Category Three ordinary-passport exemption. Permitted stay is determined by immigration officer on arrival; no numerical duration proved. HK is Hong Kong SAR. No blanket SADC/COMESA waiver inferred.
Explicitly named East African nationality exempt from eTA for up to 180 days; this is a visitor exemption, not unrestricted residence/work permission.
Explicit 2025 eTA exemption list, up to 90 days. Ordinary short tourist visit; no unrestricted residence/work right.
Explicit African-nationality eTA exemption list, up to 60 days. Ordinary short tourist visit.

Approved eTA required before departure under explicit all-visitors default. Passport six months and one blank page, travel itinerary and accommodation evidence. eTA permission to travel is not a stay grant; duration not inferred.
Named ordinary-passport exemption; Hong Kong means SAR passport. No stay period established by this nationality list; no unrestricted work/residence rights inferred.

Obtain online visa approval before travel. Single-entry tourist visa can be granted up to three months; approval letter validity of 90 days is separate. Passport six months, itinerary/accommodation, and biometric capture at border.
policies.stay: Up to 3 months, as granted

policies.n: EAC visitor pass issued on arrival free of charge. Genuine acceptable travel document valid six months; work is not permitted and this is not unrestricted free movement.
policies.stay: Up to 6 months

policies.n: Special bilateral group receives free visa on arrival described as 90 days valid. Validity is not treated as independently established per-visit stay. Genuine acceptable passport six months; no employment.

All-country visa-on-arrival policy at Kigali International Airport and all land borders; online application also available. Genuine acceptable travel document valid six months; sufficient funds; no employment. AU/Commonwealth/La Francophonie eligible nationals receive fee waiver for a 30-day visit; fee waiver is not visa exemption. V1 offers 30-day single-entry or 90-day multiple-entry validity, with stay according to permission.

Full British citizen passport. Mandatory advance online airport-entry/transit application and validation certificate; visa issued on arrival, not an alternative to registration. Six-month passport with blank page; one-month visa, single or multiple entry.
policies.stay: 1 month

policies.n: Full British citizen machine-readable passport, six months after arrival; apply for single-entry tourist eVisa before arrival. No employment including voluntary work. Check entry point permitted by issued visa.

Full British citizen passport; prior visa through Eritrean embassy, passport six months/two consecutive blank pages. Embassy form, photos and employment confirmation required. No fixed stay stated; eVisa/arrival alternatives not established.

Advance single-entry tourist eVisa; passport six months, reservation, accommodation and host/organisation invitation with contacts. Print approved eVisa. Stay is as specified on issued visa. FCDO says British citizens can obtain VOA, but official FAQ contradicts this; arrival option is not conclusively verified.

Official FAQ explicitly opens eVisa applications to everyone except non-ordinary/courtesy categories. Advance single-entry tourist eVisa: six-month passport, transport reservation, accommodation and host/organisation invitation with contacts; print approval. Stay is the period written on visa, not an assumed 30 days.

Federal Somalia ICA requires E-Visa/ETAS approval online before travel from 1 September 2025; carry approved authorisation. No fixed stay stated. Rule concerns federal entry process; do not assume it is accepted by Somaliland authorities.

Full British citizen passport. Mogadishu requires advance eVisa; Hargeisa may require federal eVisa for boarding but separately requires one-month arrival visa, as federal eVisa is not accepted for entry there. Other ports require local confirmation. Six-month passport and possible invitation letter. Sequential Hargeisa requirements are not encoded as alternative methods.
Full British citizen passport. Advance online visa or embassy application. Passport six months/two blank pages; registration for stays of five days or more. Stay duration not established.

Full British citizen passport. Prior sponsor-obtained entry permit and embassy visa; passport six months; register within three days. Passport with Israeli visa/stamp not accepted. Travel permit required outside Red Sea State; single-entry visitors may need exit visa. No fixed stay or electronic alternative established.

Expressly eligible for tourist eVisa; apply before travel and present printout, six-month passport, itinerary and accommodation. Single/multiple entry options exist; stay is not specified by FAQ. This evidence verifies eVisa eligibility and does not establish all arrival-visa alternatives.
Named ordinary passport exemption; Hong Kong specifically limited to 30 days.
Named ordinary passport exemption explicitly limited to 90 days.
Visa-exempt nationality but prior AEVM electronic travel authorisation required via Accès Maroc. No stay length established by list.
Explicitly listed visa-exempt ordinary nationality; duration not specified in this list. MO refers to Macao administrative region. No work or residence right implied.
New Zealand explicitly named in French-language list, resolving mistranslated English entry. Stay length not specified.
Dominican Republic ordinary-passport exemption for 60 days. Source mentions renewal for the same period during one year; renewal is not automatic and is not encoded as a one-year initial stay.
Full British citizen passport; Crown Dependency-issued passport exception requires separate confirmation. Passport valid throughout stay, entry stamp, accommodation and onward/return ticket evidence.

Tourism only, individual or group; provide hotel voucher with funds actually paid to hotel and return flight corresponding to stay, at boarding and entry. Airbnb-type accommodation may be rejected. Business/study/work/family visit requires prior visa. Duration not stated.

The official public nationality checker explicitly says this nationality does not require a visa. Permitted stay is assigned at entry; no days inferred. Current checker takes precedence over inconsistent undated mission category lists.

Visa required according to the public nationality checker, with an active Single Entry online application option. Obtain eVisa before departure. Current Category One and Two PDFs still conflict about arrival-visa eligibility; advance eVisa is the supported common method. No fixed stay proved; six/twelve-month multiple-entry labels are validity, not stay.

Nationality explicitly named on the current central Immigration visa-exemption list. Hong Kong/Macao entries are SAR-specific. Visitor permission and duration are determined at entry; this does not establish unrestricted residence or work rights.

Current central referral list: apply online and obtain approval before travel; no unapproved visa on arrival. Apply at least two months ahead, provide invitation/host details, and do not commit to flights/accommodation before approval. Six-month passport, unused page and return ticket required at entry. Stay according to issued permission.

Nationality expressly listed for both eVisa and visa on arrival at official entry points. Online application recommended. Tourist Ordinary Visa; six-month passport, unused visa page and return ticket. A 90-day visa validity is not a fixed stay; follow the granted permission.

US tourists must obtain a Multiple Entry Visa even for one visit. Both online and official-port arrival methods are available for the same category. One-year visa validity; maximum consecutive stay is 90 days on each visit. Six-month passport, unused page and return ticket.

Ordinary visitor nationality expressly named in Eswatini Embassy Brussels visa-exempt list. Complete immigration formalities on arrival. Duration not specified by that list; no regional/free-movement rights assumed.

Explicit destination-embassy default requires a visa for non-Eritreans without original Eritrean national ID. Obtain entry visa in advance from a competent mission. US workflow uses an online form followed by mailing the original passport, not an eVisa. Six-month passport and financial evidence; no guaranteed stay inferred from typical one-month validity. Other arrival/electronic channels not established.
Kenyan and Djiboutian nationals are expressly excepted from the embassy visa requirement. No source-established duration; ordinary passport only, no assumed residence/work right.

Eritrean nationals and persons of Eritrean origin require prior entry authorisation and special application form; no visa on arrival. Consult competent mission; electronic application alone is not established as satisfying this special clearance. No stay duration proved.

Government missions explicitly open the eVisa procedure to all nationalities; obtain tourist approval before travel. Evidence supports arrival via Addis Ababa Bole; other ports are not established. Passport six months, photo. Eritrean origin triggers additional prior authorisation even on another passport. No fixed stay inferred from 30/90-day visa-validity options.
Official public nationality-rule table explicitly marks FULL visa exemption. No exemption stay limit established. Port/territorial acceptance must be checked; waiver is not residence/work permission.

Official public nationality-rule row explicitly enables online application and email delivery, with no nationality-level exemption. Regular passport and TOURISM purpose are supported. Obtain approval before travel and pass the portal age/gender eligibility check. No fixed stay established; regional/port recognition is not guaranteed by online approval.

Core EAC member nationals: free entry visa available at any entry point for up to six months; no work right. This is a free visa, not a fee-based universal tourist waiver. Airport pre-entry registration remains relevant. Burundi-Rwanda land border closed according to current French advice; air transport not affected.
policies.stay: Up to 6 months

policies.n: French ordinary passport. Submit online entry application and carry validation certificate; visa issued at airport for USD90. Online request and arrival issue are sequential, not alternative methods.
policies.stay: Up to 1 month

policies.n: Ordinary Turkish passport requires a visa. Diplomatic exemption is separate. This source does not conclusively specify electronic/arrival channel or stay length; visa-required does not establish eVisa unavailable.

Ordinary Turkish passport requires a visa. Diplomatic exemption is separate. This source does not conclusively specify electronic/arrival channel or stay length; visa-required does not establish eVisa unavailable.
Ordinary Turkish passport: Türkiye MFA explicitly permits visa issuance on arrival at all Sudan border posts. No fixed stay established. Confirm currently operating port and local formalities.
Ordinary Turkish passport holders may obtain an Egyptian visa at border posts. No fixed stay stated; diplomatic/service 90-day exemption not applied to ordinary passports.
Ordinary Turkish passport explicitly exempt for stays up to 90 days.

French ordinary passport: obtain visa before departure; Juba arrival issuance is not reliable entitlement. Registration required for stays longer than three days; yellow-fever certificate. Electronic availability and stay length not settled by this source.

French ordinary passport requires advance visa; passport six months. Register within three days and again in each locality; Israeli visa/stamp restriction remains noted. Current mission processing and travel permits require confirmation. Electronic channel and stay unspecified.

Ordinary Saint Kitts and Nevis passport: reciprocal waiver up to 90 days reported by its government following February 2022 agreement. Current port operations/admission and local registration remain separate.
Regular Canadian passport; passport valid six months beyond expected departure. Current government tourist limit is 90 days; no four-month stay inferred from secondary sources.

German ordinary passport: tourist/private/business visa exemption up to 120 days. Passport six months on entry; retain visitor card for departure; funds may be requested, and sea arrivals should carry accommodation and return-ticket evidence.

Official public checker: ordinary-passport tourism, residence in the passport country, no supporting foreign visa and no special event. Adult test profile is recorded in the request cache; other residence/age circumstances need their own eligibility check. The rendered result expressly requires a Moroccan visa. Specific issuance channel and permitted stay are not established by this result. This does not establish that eVisa is unavailable for other qualifying profiles, including eligible foreign residence or supporting visas.

policies.n: Territory-dependent permission, not a Palestinian visa requirement. For a full British citizen passport, access via Israel ordinarily requires ETA-IL and Israeli admission; crossing Israel/Palestine requires passport and Israeli immigration slip. Follow any Palestinian-Authority-only/Judea-and-Samaria-only stamp or express advance-COGAT-authorisation restriction. Gaza requires the relevant entry/exit permission; Erez is reported closed and Rafah may close, so this is not a confirmed open tourist route. British nationals on the Palestinian Population Register or with a Palestinian ID need a Palestinian passport/travel document to leave the West Bank/Gaza; resident dual nationals have Allenby/Rafah exit-and-same-route-return restrictions. Israel-associated and specified other dual nationalities have separate document/preapproval rules. No country-wide stay is established.
policies.label: Territory- and route-dependent entry permission

policies.n: Territory-dependent permission, not a Palestinian visa requirement. For a regular Canadian passport, the source distinguishes Israeli visa-exempt/ETA-IL admission from West Bank short-visit permits. Keep the Israeli entry card, and obtain the appropriate Israeli-authority permit for the actual West Bank purpose before travel. Gaza is not covered by a routine Israeli admission entitlement: Erez is reported closed and Rafah extremely restricted. Palestinian population-register status changes the permitted airport/crossing route even when using a Canadian passport; registered Palestinians may not enter through Ben Gurion under the stated guidance, and dual-national treatment requires individual confirmation. Passport validity at least 90 days after entry. No Palestinian-wide duration or open-crossing guarantee is established.
policies.label: Territory- and route-dependent entry permission

policies.n: UAE MFA explicitly lists Visa On Arrival for normal UAE passports; no stay or entry-port entitlement is specified. The same current page separately states that UAE citizens are banned from travelling to Niger. This is an origin-country travel restriction, not proof that Niger bans UAE nationality or that the trip is presently permitted by UAE authorities.

Australian government instructions require a visa before travel. Electronic issuance eligibility and stay length are not established; this is not a finding that eVisa is unavailable. A yellow-fever vaccination certificate is required. Travel warnings and crossing closures are not converted into a nationality-wide admission ban.

French ordinary passports require a biometric visa. For the electronic route, complete online enrolment/payment and obtain the required approval before travel, followed by biometric visa issuance at Abidjan international airport. These are sequential steps, not a separate walk-up VOA alternative. Consular application is also described, but its duration is not inferred. Passport validity more than six months and yellow-fever vaccination apply. The source states one-to-three-month visa validity, not a verified stay allowance.

policies.n: The January 2026 official bilateral account expressly includes ordinary passports in the visa-exemption regimes between Timor-Leste and Laos. It does not supply an ordinary-tourist duration, aggregate limit or effective date; no 30-day stay, automatic ASEAN entitlement or diplomatic-only extrapolation is made.

UAE ordinary passports: current origin-government Jordan guidance expressly grants visa-free tourism for 90 days. Passport valid at least six months. Rules for accompanying foreign domestic workers are separate; no GCC-wide extrapolation.

Applies to Macao SAR ordinary passports (travelPermit=0), not Macao travel permits or mainland Chinese passports. The current official origin checker explicitly says visa-free, 30 days. No 120-day Vanuatu general tourist category is substituted for this specific rule.

HKSAR ordinary passport: visa-free visit up to 30 days, expressly identified as a waiver in Hong Kong Immigration’s bilateral announcement and retained in its current concession list. Not a generic PRC, BN(O), Hong Kong identity-document or visa-on-arrival classification.

Special Hong Kong/Macao resident entry/exit permit, not an ordinary foreigner visa waiver. Requires SAR permanent residence, permanent resident ID and SAR passport valid more than three months. The statutory Hong Kong resident definition permits no other travel document except HKSAR/BNO; the Macao definition permits only a Macao passport or a Portuguese passport obtained in Macao before the end of Portuguese rule. Mainland-born applicants must supply a certificate of non-registration in Mainland China, Home Return Permit, or notarized household-registration cancellation as specified by NIA. Apply online, pay and download/colour-print the approved permit; counter/overseas-representation application is separately available. Single-entry six-month and renewable/multiple one-/three-year validity are not stays. The stated three-month extension requires separate application.
policies.stay: Up to 3 months, counted from the day after entry
policies.label: Hong Kong/Macao resident electronic entry permit

policies.n: Taiwan ordinary-passport tourism: visa-free, with only 30 days granted at a time under the nationality-specific BOCA guidance. Extension is separately sought from Zambia Immigration; the stated 90-day maximum is not an automatic initial grant.

The currently published revised Passports (Visa) (Exemption) Order names Slovak Republic in Schedule 3, resolving the ministry directory’s contradictory Slovak/Slovakia labels. Slovak MFA’s entry section updated 20 April 2026 confirms up to 90 days visa-free for tourism/visits. Own passport valid at least six months after planned departure and pre-entry registration apply. The e-Arrival registration is not an independent visa alternative.

Regular Canadian passport: tourist stays up to 90 days within a 180-day period. Ukrainian dual-national/document rules and lawful entry-point restrictions remain applicable; this does not authorize travel through occupied territory.

Mongolian passport: official invitation required for the visa exemption. Current origin-government table gives up to 90 days but does not specify an aggregate rolling limit. Lawful entry-point and territorial permissions remain separate.

policies.n: Visa required for ordinary short tourism under the embassy explicit foreign-national default. Issuance method depends on consular jurisdiction and the LIS embassy-country criterion; nationality alone does not establish the online-arrival branch. LIS says to apply directly at the embassy if one exists in your country, without clearly distinguishing nationality from residence. If LIS confirms eligibility for its online-arrival process, obtain the approved QR confirmation before travel, enter at Roberts International Airport (ROB), then complete biometrics and collect the visa sticker. Approval is valid for entry within three months, not a three-month stay. The officer sets visit permission (portal describes 30 or 90 days); no common duration is assigned. No foreign residence or approval is assumed; this does not claim eVisa/arrival issuance is unavailable.
policies.label: Visa required; issuance method conditional

policies.n: Ordinary national passport: explicitly named in CAAB AIP GEN 1.3-1 visa-exempt list for stays up to 90 days. The October 2026 amendment checklist retains this page. Nationality-based exemption, not a visa-fee waiver or diplomatic-passport concession. Entry declarations and ordinary admission checks remain applicable.

CAAB AIP GEN 1.3-1 explicitly refuses admission and transit to nationals of Israel. The October 2026 amendment checklist retains this provision. This records the stated nationality restriction, rather than inferring a ban from a missing application option.
policies.label: Admission and transit refused

policies.n: Ordinary passport: the current-retained CAAB AIP states a visa-required default outside its named exemptions. Obtain an advance mission-issued sticker visa unless an actual conditional arrival-permission branch applies. Special Branch permits justified VOA applications by citizens arriving from countries without a Bangladesh embassy, and also describes arrivals from another country without a Bangladesh embassy; departure/residence is not assumed. Eligible applicants must follow online VOA pre-application/acknowledgement and final border issuance. The AIP additionally describes discretionary international-airport tourist/business landing permission up to 15 days with return air tickets, while the current police VOA product allows up to 30 days. These are not a uniform stay or unconditional walk-up entitlement; d=0 preserves the unresolved product-specific grant. Washington expressly says an eVisa has not yet been introduced; an online form is not itself a visa. Ancestry/NVR, diplomatic status and foreign residence are not assumed.
policies.label: Visa required; conditional arrival permissions

policies.n: Vatican City ordinary passport is expressly named in the CAAB AIP visa-exempt list for up to 90 days. Amendment 04/2026 retains this page. This specific exemption replaces the earlier generic Europe-based VOA classification; it is not a fee exemption.

Serbian ordinary passport: federal Iraqi visa required; the MFA identifies Embassy Belgrade processing. No short-tourist stay duration is established here, and electronic-channel availability is not determined. A Kurdistan Regional Government permit is region-only and cannot authorize travel to other parts of Iraq. Regional guarantor arrangements and registration requirements are separate.
policies.label: Federal visa required; KRI permission separate

policies.n: Tourism exemption up to 30 days under the government-adopted expansion of Resolution 134/2018. Complete applicable EASE pre-registration and airport-security-tax requirements; these do not constitute an eVisa and do not grant residence or work permission.

Mongolian passport: all-passport visa-waiver agreement in force from 17 January 2024; up to 90 days according to the current Mongolia MFA outbound schedule. No rolling/annual aggregate specified by that table.

Use the active Bosnia nationality record (official ISO code BA, id150) for an ordinary tourist eVisa; the duplicate legacy Herzegovina alias is inactive. Official flags permit online application and email delivery, and the public eligibility check permits proceeding. Obtain approval before travel and satisfy individual age/gender screening. No fixed permitted stay is established; acceptance at every Libyan region/port is not established.

EU citizen holding a valid ordinary passport: treaty visa exemption up to 90 days in any 180-day period, excluding paid activity. EEAS currently confirms the agreement applies. This is the treaty-specific entitlement; omission from the separate 2023 domestic exemption list is not evidence of treaty termination. Normal entry-permission and travel-document checks remain applicable.

Listed for online visa application by NPRA. The G212 multiple-entry electronic service requires a passport valid more than six months, accommodation/address in Bahrain, return air ticket, and bank statements for the preceding three months showing regular income of at least USD1000; approval is required before using the electronic permission. These conditions must actually be met. The three-month product duration is not treated as a continuous stay allowance. Arrival-visa eligibility and its separate conditions were not established for this route. No third-country visa or residence is assumed.
policies.label: eVisa application, subject to NPRA conditions

policies.n: Macao SAR passport only. Single-entry arrival/eVisa stay up to two weeks; three-month multiple-entry arrival/eVisa product allows up to one month, with a possible two-week extension; one-year multiple-entry product is electronic only and allows up to 90 days. NPRA approval and applicable conditions remain required.
policies.stay: Single entry: two weeks; three-month multiple entry: one month; one-year eVisa: up to 90 days

policies.n: Applies to an ordinary Macao SAR passport, not the separately selectable Macao travel permit.
Macao SAR passport holders have an electronic visa application channel linked by DSI to NADRA. Obtain approval before travel. The DSI result gives no stay length; no arrival entitlement is asserted.

Macao SAR passport: obtain eTA before travel; one-month visa-exempt stay. ETA is single-trip travel permission, valid for travel within 90 days of issue, not a 90-day stay. Day-trip boat and airside transit exceptions are route-specific.
policies.stay: 1 month

policies.n: Macao SAR passport. DSI expressly reports a 30-day arrival-visa concession and separately links electronic visa access. Electronic stay duration and port restrictions are not specified in this source; confirm issued permission and intended port rather than assuming 30 days for both methods.
policies.stay: Arrival visa: 30 days; eVisa: stay unspecified

policies.n: French ordinary-passport visitors need a visa obtained through the DPRK delegation before travel. Current tour/entry permission must be confirmed. No numerical stay or general nationality-wide entry ban is inferred.

Singaporeans require both a visa and North Korean government authorisation, normally through an organised tour. Exact issuance method and stay are unspecified; this is not an assertion that an electronic channel is unavailable.

For ordinary tourist travel, Serbian national passports require an advance visa and organised travel. The business-travel and diplomatic/official exceptions do not establish an ordinary tourist exemption. No stay period stated.

Turkish ordinary passports require a visa. The source does not establish the tourist issuance channel or stay; electronic availability is not disproved. Current DPRK tour/entry permission remains separate.
Turkish ordinary-passport waiver for 15 days; no third-country visa or residence assumed.

Russian ordinary passports require a visa under the bilateral travel regime. Diplomatic/service exemptions do not apply. Issuance channel and stay are unspecified, with current tour/entry arrangements still separately required.
Russian ordinary passports: no more than 90 days within 180 under the 7 June 2019 agreement; not a fresh 90-day allowance on every entry.
Russian ordinary passports: unilateral visa waiver for up to 15 days.

Ordinary passports explicitly covered by Immigration Act section 15 and Sixth Schedule. Statutory visa waiver up to 90 days, subject to admissibility; obtain eTA before travel and complete the required entry information. Ninety-day single-trip eTA validity is a separate clock. Day-trip boat/airside transit exceptions must be checked against the itinerary.
Canadian ordinary passport: tourist visa exemption with eTA before travel. ETA validity 90 days is not a stay grant; no Canadian stay period was stated in this source.
Singapore ordinary passport: visa-exempt visit up to 90 days, with eTA before travel. ETA travel-validity and permitted stay are separate.
Turkish ordinary passports: visa exemption limited to 90 days within 180; eTA before travel is additional, not an alternative to the waiver or a new stay allowance.
Russian ordinary passports:90 days within 180 under the bilateral agreement; obtain eTA before travel. ETA90-day travel-validity does not replace the treaty stay limit.

UAE ordinary passports: tourist visits up to 90 days within 180 according to the origin-government checker. Passport valid at least six months. Other purpose-specific permissions are outside this tourist baseline.

Canadian ordinary passports: current Canadian advice requires a prior visa for 15 days or longer. The historical destination notice says up to 15; this boundary difference is disclosed rather than silently rounded.
policies.stay: Less than 15 days under current Canadian advice

policies.n: Historical evidence only: signed MNEC notice 8 May 2017, image captured 21 July 2018. Valid ordinary passports in the named country/CPLP/EU groups were exempt for up to 15 days. This is not a live confirmation that the same rule remains in force; no third-country visa/residence assumed.
policies.label: Historical visa waiver (2017 notice)

policies.n: Historical evidence only: paragraphIV of the 8 May 2017 MNEC notice grants visa issuance on arrival to PRC ordinary/common passports under the cited joint order. It does not specify a stay length. The separate 15-day Chinese diplomatic/service waiver is inapplicable.
policies.label: Historical arrival visa (2017 notice)

policies.n: Expressly named in the public Botswana visa-required schedule (Marshall Island / East Timor / Palestine). Visa requirement is established, but a nationality-specific completed electronic issuance pathway and stay are not confirmed here; vr does not mean eVisa is unavailable. Palestine is listed although the free-text checker fails to match it, so accepted-document and channel confirmation remain necessary.
policies.label: Visa required; issuance method unconfirmed

policies.n: An electronic visa is available with up to 60 calendar days of stay within 90-day visa validity; generally passport validity of at least six months and printed emailed approval required. A separate 14-day waiver applies to the age-qualified group: current National-passport table says over 55, while the 2024 MFA announcement says aged 55 and over; confirm the waiver boundary if exactly 55. Do not assume the traveller meets the age condition. The electronic route is established independently of this waiver boundary. Visa-free visitors generally register within ten working days; eVisa holders are exempt from that registration. Border-area/GBAO permission is separate. The public checker omits the age qualifier and is not used for unconditional visa freedom.
policies.label: eVisa / age-conditioned waiver
policies.stay: eVisa: up to 60 calendar days; qualifying older travellers: waiver up to 14 days

policies.n: The public nationality checker and arrival schedule explicitly identify Madagascar and Vanuatu for visa issuance at the Consular Bureau of Dushanbe International Airport. Arrange the advance application through visa.gov.tj and any required invitation confirmation before travel; no walk-up guarantee is asserted. Arrival-visa stay is unspecified. A separate 14-day visa waiver is age-qualified: current table says over 55; the archived 2024 announcement says 55 and over, so confirm eligibility at exactly 55. The eVisa flag is false for these two; this is not treated as proof that every other electronic channel is unavailable.
policies.label: Prearranged airport visa / age-qualified waiver
policies.stay: Airport-issued visa: unspecified; qualifying older travellers: waiver up to 14 days

policies.label: Historical treaty waiver (2025 capture)

policies.n: Historical official inbound ordinary-passport table, captured 3 December 2024, states visa required. Issuance method and stay are not established; electronic availability is not disproved. Current live verification remains blocked.

policies.n: Historical ordinary-passport waiver for 30 days in official inbound table captured 3 December 2024. Aggregate limits and current continuation are not independently established.

policies.n: A visa is required. Current Dubai consulate directs Somali applicants to a separate paper form, while the previously retrieved August 2026 NADRA roster includes Somalia online. policies.n: Second-group ordinary passports do not receive a nationality-only waiver. The 14-day nonextendable waiver requires residence or a valid entry visa for the United States, Canada, Australia, United Kingdom, a Schengen country or Japan; alternatively GCC residence and a profession eligible for the resident-visa facility. Passport must be valid at least six months; return ticket, confirmed hotel, health insurance and sufficient funds required. Husband/wife/children may benefit under the accompanying-family provision even with another nationality. No qualifying foreign status or family eligibility is assumed. Without a qualifying waiver, obtain the appropriate ROP visa/entry permission; the source does not establish a uniform visa product or its stay length for this group.
policies.label: Visa required unless conditional 14-day waiver applies
policies.stay: Conditional waiver: 14 days; otherwise as authorized by the applicable visa

policies.n: Ordinary passport holders under 15 or above 50 are visa-exempt for tourist visits up to 90 days in any 180-day period. Holders aged 15–50 require a visa. The MFA offers a one-month single-entry eVisa at ages 15–18 or 35–50 when holding a valid Schengen-member, US, UK or Irish visa or residence permit, subject to the additional eVisa conditions. Neither age nor foreign-document eligibility is assumed. For a required visa, authorized stay follows the issued product; the one-month eVisa period is not assigned to all visa methods.
policies.label: Age-dependent waiver or visa requirement
policies.stay: Qualifying age waiver: 90 days in any 180 days; visa branch: as issued
