Ages 15–45 may obtain the stated 30-day single-entry eVisa only with a valid Schengen, US, UK or Irish visa/residence permit and travel on Turkish Airlines, AJet, Pegasus, Egypt Air or Air Cairo. No age or qualifying foreign document is assumed. A uniform stay for the other visa branches is not stated.
policies.label: Visa required; eVisa eligibility depends on age/documents
policies.stay: Conditional age-15–45 eVisa: 30 days; other visa branches: stay not established

policies.n: MFA explicitly requires visas for ordinary Taiwan passports and offers a single-entry eVisa described as valid for one month subject to certain conditions. Those additional conditions were not fully established, so this records the visa requirement with electronic-method uncertainty, not a finding that eVisa is unavailable. The visa-validity period is not encoded as a confirmed stay.
policies.label: Visa required; conditional eVisa channel

policies.n: Ordinary short-tourist entry requires a visa under Resolution 5488 Articles 2 and 7, after reconciling its Article 3 list and Article 6 treaty exception against the current public treaty register. Diplomatic/service-only and visa-fee waivers do not exempt ordinary passports. No qualifying third-country permanent residence under the Pacific Alliance/Andean provisions is assumed. The MFA states the process is 100% virtual and the approved visa is emailed; apply to the office competent for the actual residence. Tourist visa permits 90 days initially, extendable by another 90 subject to approval; total cannot exceed 180 continuous or discontinuous days within 365 days from visa issue. Up-to-one-year visa validity is not a one-year stay.

Valid ordinary Mongolian passport; treaty effective 26 January 2026, confirmed in force by the MFA registry. Up to 90 days in any 180-day period from first entry, through authorized international border crossings. Tourism covered; remunerated activities require the appropriate visa. Any extension is subject to national law, not automatic.

Valid Belarus citizen passport expressly included in Annex 1.1. Treaty entered into force 19 December 2025 according to the MFA register. Article 1 says 90 days within a calendar year from the date of first entry; preserve that wording rather than substituting a 90/180 rule or a new allowance per visit. Use authorized international passenger crossings. Longer uninterrupted stays require a visa; exceptional extensions are individually authorized.
policies.stay: 90 days within a calendar year from the date of first entry (treaty wording)

policies.n: Advance electronic visa authorization is required before travel under the regime effective 5 January 2025. Obtain the electronic approval through ANRPTS; border biometric/payment/issuance formalities are subsequent steps, not a separate walk-up visa-on-arrival option. Use an authorized international crossing. The source does not establish a single unconditional tourist stay applicable to all approved products, so stay follows the authorization. This evidence is limited to this origin nationality.
policies.label: Advance eVisa authorization required

policies.n: Palestinian ordinary passports have an expressly documented Chinese visa process: the Representative Office fee schedule names Palestinian passports and its instructions include tourist L visas. Apply online for preliminary review, then deliver the original passport and any required biometrics to the office and collect the issued passport/visa. This is not an end-to-end eVisa. Passport valid at least six months with blank visa pages; itinerary/accommodation or qualifying invitation required. Visa officer determines validity, stay and entries; none is inferred from processing days or fee bands. Stateless or other-country-issued Palestinian travel documents are not automatically covered.
policies.label: Tourist visa; Palestinian passport process established

policies.n: Belgian Embassy Nairobi expressly accepts Somali short-stay C-visa applications within its stated citizenship/residence jurisdiction, in person through TLS. The baseline EU recognition matrix does not recognize ordinary Somali passports in Belgium: a visa/document authorization must therefore use the applicable limited-territorial/separate-sheet mechanism under Visa Code Articles 25(3) and 29(2), rather than assuming that any Schengen visa validates the passport. Confirm the issued Belgian authorization and transit itinerary; no permission for other Schengen states is assumed. The mission states standard processing of 45 days and no multiple-entry visas; 45 days is not a stay grant. Permitted stay follows the issued permission and admission remains an individual decision.
policies.label: Visa and document-specific authorization required

policies.n: Positive ASAN eligibility table preserved in the 2026-07-23 archive, not a live nationality recheck. Single-entry electronic tourist method; current Migration Service specifies up to 30 days. Apply at least three working days ahead; passport valid at least three months beyond eVisa expiry. Registration required for stays exceeding 15 days. Confirm permitted entry routing separately; this does not establish unrestricted land entry.

Historical official ASAN capture of 2026-07-23: up to three visa-free entries during 2026-02-15 through 2027-02-15, with up to 30 days per entry; fourth and subsequent entries require a valid visa. The same table positively lists electronic-visa eligibility. No unlimited-entry waiver or unrestricted land-entry permission is asserted.

policies.n: Historical official ASAN capture of 2026-07-23: up to three visa-free entries during 2026-07-01 through 2027-07-01, with up to 30 days per entry; fourth and subsequent entries require a valid visa. policies.n: Chinese ordinary passport: up to 30 days per visit and 90 days cumulatively in any 180-day period under agreement effective 2025-07-16. Not automatically extended to SAR documents.

Origin governments establish a visa requirement for these nationalities; the NIS April 2026 SLA expressly makes F5A available to foreign nationals outside the exemptions and describes online application and emailed visa certificate. Tourist stay 30 days, single entry, non-extendable; visa validity 90 days is separate. Separate landing/exit declarations required. France also describes physical OIS processing; the electronic method is supported by the newer destination SLA, not the online form alone.

BOCA confirms Nigerian Trade Office issuance for Taiwanese nationals and recommends the formal paper visa carrying the correct nationality. It also discusses the May 2025 electronic portal and unpredictable processing, but does not establish a reliable Taiwan-specific electronic decision. Visa requirement and consular option retained; electronic eligibility/stay uncertain. Separate landing/exit declarations required.

policies.n: German nationals require advance permission. German official advice explicitly permits online short-stay visa applications up to seven days and consular applications through Berlin. Electronic approval precedes arrival; no walk-up visa assertion. Consular stay duration unspecified.
policies.stay: Electronic short stay: up to 7 days; consular stay unspecified

policies.n: Turkish ordinary passports require a visa; the 90-in-180 exemption in this source applies only to diplomatic passports. Electronic versus consular availability and tourist stay not established by this origin source.

policies.n: Air-arrival tourist baseline: Madrid’s government-hosted tourism page explicitly requires a tourist visa when the country is not on the exemption list; its tourist-visa service applies to nationals of non-waiver countries. Applied together with the central MFA air-arrival nationality table, separately established Serbian treaty and HKSAR exemption, holding special-document/recognition cases out. Visa required before travel. Nationality-specific electronic issuance and approved stay are not established; vr does not mean eVisa is unavailable. No Spanish residence or land/sea waiver assumed.
policies.label: Visa required; electronic method uncertain

policies.n: Venezuelan MFA confirms approval and entry into force of the ordinary-passport waiver on its 2025-04-01 notice. No treaty-specific stay was established. The 90-day field on the Serbian page is headed Visa regime for entering Serbia and is not inverted into an inbound Venezuelan duration. Use air-arrival scope pending treaty text for other ports.

Islamabad mission expressly issues visas to Pakistani nationals. Single entry, one-month stay; print online form and present passport/documents, then collect passport and visa. Passport must have six months validity. Form submission is not electronic issuance; this does not disprove other channels.
policies.stay: One month

policies.n: Turkish ordinary-passport holders require a visa according to their MFA. E-Afghans residence/nationality restrictions do not establish consular refusal. Requirement retained with unspecified stay and electronic-method uncertainty.
policies.label: Visa required; method uncertain

policies.n: BOCA expressly says Taiwanese nationals can apply for Afghan eVisa through evisa.mfa.gov.af, with entry through Kabul International Airport. Up to 30 days; passport valid at least six months, photo and national-ID scan. Approval and remaining payment precede issuance. This is nationality-specific official guidance, not inferred from a dropdown.
Russian ordinary-passport exemption: up to 90 days within 180 days, under 2016 agreement. The separate three-month diplomatic/service column is not used.

Montenegro explicitly requires visas for Burkina Faso citizens and directs applications to its diplomatic/consular missions or the nearest Serbian mission if inaccessible. Qualifying third-country visas/residence can create a conditional exemption, but none is assumed. Issued stay unspecified.

The Israeli mission explicitly states Taiwanese passports qualify for a 90-day visa-free tourist visit following ETA-IL instructions. Obtain ETA-IL before travel. Longer stays or other purposes require the relevant visa; no separate Palestinian-territory permission implied.

HKSAR passports: official Ethiopia country block (option_46) expressly provides arrival-visa application at Bole International Airport, Addis Ababa. Three-month stay in that same block; not extended to land ports or other Hong Kong travel documents.
policies.stay: 3 months

The page separately advises advance tourist visa when entering during a transit stop; that itinerary is not assumed.

Section 3a preserves enumerated family, residence, employment, humanitarian, transport and other exceptions plus exceptional individual border authorization; none is assumed. This is not a ban on every Russian national or a determination of intra-Schengen movement.

Visa on arrival requires a photograph and return ticket for travellers without local long-term residence. Cambodia e-Arrival declaration is separate. eVisa entry is restricted to authorised ports; confirm the intended checkpoint.
policies.stay: Tourist eVisa: one month; tourist visa on arrival: one month, with a separately requested one-month extension possible.

The source describes an advance consular visa as usually one month but does not establish a common exact stay for both selected methods.

policies.label: Visa required; electronic eligibility conditional

policies.n: Visa required without qualifying third-country documentation. Ordinary Indian/Dominican passports with a qualifying valid US B1/B2, B2, J, B1, O, P1/P2/P3, E or H-1B visa or US Green Card may instead enter for tourism up to 90 days. The document must remain valid for the whole stay; I-797 extension and dependent visa categories do not qualify. These conditions are not assumed satisfied. Unconditional visa stay is unspecified.
policies.label: Visa required unless qualifying US-document exemption applies

policies.n: Visa required without qualifying third-country documentation. Ordinary mainland Chinese passports with a qualifying valid US B1/B2, B2, J, B1, O, P1/P2/P3, E or H-1B visa or US Green Card may instead enter for tourism up to 30 days (Houston country-specific rule). Document must remain valid for the whole stay; I-797 extension and dependent categories excluded. No qualifying US document assumed. Not extended to SAR passports.
policies.label: Visa required unless qualifying US-document exemption applies

policies.n: Los Angeles consulate explicitly names SOUTH KOREA and SOUTH AFRICA in its passport-and-nationality-only tourist waiver. This resolves the earlier ambiguous Korea row and omitted South Africa. Tourist/recreational travel only.
policies.stay: Up to three months.

policies.n: Taiwan BOCA expressly requires valid entry permission. Its tourist AVE route requires a valid Taiwan passport plus US entry within the previous two years or valid qualifying US entry permission (ESTA or listed visa categories). Those conditions are not assumed. The conditional AVE allows a three-month stay and has separate 90-day validity; baseline consular method/stay must be confirmed.
policies.label: Entry visa required; AVE conditional on US travel/document history

policies.n: Moldova MFA ordinary-passport Bosnia and Herzegovina row expressly states visa-free up to 90 days. No third-country residence/visa assumed. The source does not establish an aggregate rolling period; admission remains subject to the destination rules.

Mongolia MFA explicitly requires visas for destinations outside its ordinary-passport exemption schedule; Bosnia and Herzegovina is not exempt. This establishes the visa requirement, not the availability or non-availability of an electronic channel. Duration unspecified.
policies.label: Visa required; application method unconfirmed

policies.n: Taiwan BOCA specifically states that Tuvalu grants holders of Taiwan passports 90-day visa-free entry. Not extrapolated to EFTA or other passport types.

Taiwan passport holders must apply for and collect a South African visa in person at the South African liaison office, by prior appointment. This establishes a consular channel and passport treatment. Stay unspecified; fee relief, transit rules and other travel documents are not visa exemptions.

A Saudi tourist visa is required. Taiwan BOCA describes tourist eVisa eligibility and instructs selection of the Taiwan-related nationality option, but the retained Saudi Tourism Authority checker maps TW to a noneligible group. Preserve the agreed visa requirement; electronic eligibility remains conflicted and eVisa unavailability is not asserted. BOCA arrival visa requires qualifying US/UK/Schengen documents, which are not assumed. Duration left unspecified across uncertain products.
policies.label: Visa required; eVisa eligibility needs confirmation

policies.n: Canadian ordinary passport: obtain the electronic visa before departure. The source does not establish an authorised stay length; follow the issued visa. A landing stamp follows approval and is not an independent walk-up visa alternative.
UAE normal passport; apply in advance through the official South Sudan eVisa website. The source gives 30 days starting from the specified arrival date, not from arbitrary visa issuance.

A visa is required for Serbian ordinary passports. Tourist eVisa/arrival eligibility and stay are not established for this nationality by the retrieved evidence. The source contains an unrelated Cambodia-linked method paragraph; it is not applied to South Sudan.
policies.label: Visa required; method unconfirmed

policies.n: UAE ordinary/normal passport; origin MFA expressly lists visa-free access for 90 days, renewable. The same source prohibits UAE citizens from travelling to Burkina Faso: this is an origin-country travel restriction, not a Burkina Faso nationality entry ban. No work right is inferred.

French ordinary passport; obtain the visa before travel through the official eVisaburkina platform and print the electronic visa for arrival. Duration is not specified here. Consular processing is also described, but no common duration is assigned to different methods.

Serbian ordinary passport requires a visa. Burkina Security Ministry expressly permits every visa-subject foreigner to apply online; its 17 August 2023 launch statement corroborates the current official portal. Obtain approval before travel. No authorised stay is established by these sources.
Ordinary Canadian passport. The Canadian-government nationality-specific tourist allowance is 30 days; the SVG Tourism Authority generic visitor-permit ceiling is not substituted for it.
Singapore ordinary passport; short visits up to 90 days. Entry permission does not establish residence or employment rights.
Serbian ordinary passport; up to 30 days in a one-year period, rather than a fresh annual allowance at each entry. No employment right established.
UAE ordinary/normal passport; tourism only. The period is three calendar months, not a converted day count.
policies.stay: 3 months

policies.n: HKSAR passport, not a mainland Chinese ordinary passport or other Hong Kong travel document. The HKSAR schedule lists access and expressly leaves stay to the competent authorities on arrival. No fixed stay or work permission is inferred.
HKSAR passport only. Hong Kong Immigration explicitly lists North Macedonia for 90 days; no rolling or annual aggregate period is invented.
Macao SAR ordinary passport (travelPermit=0), not the Macao travel permit. The official DSI checker explicitly grants visa exemption for one calendar month.
policies.stay: 1 month

policies.n: Macao SAR ordinary passport (travelPermit=0). The official origin-government checker supplies an explicit 90-day exemption; mainland China is not substituted for this passport.
UAE ordinary/normal passport; tourism for three calendar months. No employment permission is inferred.
policies.stay: 3 months

policies.n: Macao SAR ordinary passport (travelPermit=0); explicit 90-day visa exemption. Not inferred from mainland China or from travel-permit rules.

HKSAR passport only. Bona fide tourism up to 21 days requires a return ticket and satisfaction of the immigration officer as to departure within that period. No third-country visa or residence assumed.

The current Dominica Tourism Authority expressly requires a visa for Haitian and Dominican Republic citizens. The general 21-day tourist clause is not applied to these named exceptions. The Dominican exception is also explicit in regulation 2(3) of SRO 7/2015. No third-country visa/residence exception is assumed; issuance channel and stay are unconfirmed.
policies.label: Visa required; method unconfirmed

policies.n: Brazilian ordinary passport: SRO 7/2015 regulation 2(2)(d) grants visits not exceeding three months. Return ticket, funds and accommodation/address requirements remain.
policies.stay: 3 months

policies.n: Cuban ordinary passport: SRO 7/2015 regulation 2(2)(f) explicitly grants no more than 28 consecutive days. This is not a work or residence right.
SRO 7/2015 regulation 2(2)(a) expressly includes Croatia and Republic of China (Taiwan) for visits not exceeding six months. Ordinary national passport; no assumed third-country permission.
policies.stay: 6 months

policies.n: Visa exemption is explicit. Duration is not resolved: the live government overview says three months, while SRO 7/2015 gives six months (and Suriname also falls within the overview CARICOM category). No unsupported common duration is selected.

Historical statutory evidence only: SRO 5/2016, captured 6 March 2022, names these citizens for six-month visa exemption. A current consolidated amendment chain was not recovered; do not present this as a current live six-month verification.
policies.stay: 6 months

policies.n: Historical evidence only: national passports expressly included in SRO 10/2015 for 90 days; public capture 6 March 2022. Current consolidated amendments were not recovered.

Conditional general tourist exemption, not a claim that 21 days is the maximum under every bilateral agreement. The traveller must be a bona fide tourist, possess a return ticket, and satisfy the immigration officer that the visit will not exceed 21 days. Current national guidance corroborates SRO 7/2015. Funds and local address are required. Longer visits outside another established exemption require a visa; no foreign visa/residence, employment or regional free-movement right is assumed.
policies.label: Conditional 21-day tourist exemption

policies.n: SME expressly names this nationality as exempt for short stays under a bilateral agreement. The authoritative bilateral stay/aggregate limit is not established in the retrieved text; the generic tourism portal 30-day/90-day annual wording is not substituted for each treaty. No employment or unrestricted residence right is inferred.

Overnight ordinary tourism requires an appropriate visa under the explicit statutory default in Law 13/19 Article 14(1)(b), reconciled with Decree 189/23 and the SME decree-plus-bilateral exemption schedule. This is not a requirement inferred solely from omission from the 98-country annex. Statutory exceptions include qualifying cruise passengers/day visitors and resident or treaty beneficiaries; none is assumed. Decree Article 4 permits advance online pre-authorisation followed by visa affixing at the border; current electronic versus consular completion remains unconfirmed for this nationality because SME instructions conflict. Do not travel on an unapproved application. Stay follows the issued authorisation; no visa-validity period is used as stay.
policies.label: Visa required for overnight tourism; channel unconfirmed

policies.n: Chinese ordinary passport: a tourist visa is required. Current Beijing instructions require the printed online form and supporting documents at the authorised IVAC; biometrics normally require attendance, with stated age/diplomatic exceptions. This verifies an ordinary consular route, not an end-to-end eVisa for all categories. Current e-Tourist eligibility is not established; no claim that eVisa is unavailable. Stay is visa-specific.

HKSAR or Macao SAR ordinary passport, respectively: a visa is required. Current Hong Kong Consulate instructions expressly describe T-1 tourism, appointment and physical passport submission, HK/Macao identity or lawful-status evidence, itinerary, return/onward travel, funds and accommodation. Passport valid for the next 180 days with two consecutive blank pages. Country/category-specific e-Tourist eligibility is unconfirmed, not declared unavailable; actual stay follows the visa.

Bangladeshi ordinary passport requires a visa; a fee waiver is not a visa waiver. The currently linked Dhaka August 2026 document lists T-1 tourist visa requirements including original passport, Bangladesh identity/residence/profession evidence and funds. This does not prove that tourist appointments or issuance are presently available to every applicant. Current issuance availability, electronic eligibility and stay remain unconfirmed.
policies.label: Visa required; tourist issuance unconfirmed

policies.n: Afghan ordinary passport requires a visa under the explicit official nationality default. Gratis-visa wording is a fee concession only. The retrieved sources do not establish current ordinary-tourist issuance or e-Tourist availability for Afghan nationals; do not assume emergency, student or medical permissions cover tourism. Stay unconfirmed.
policies.label: Visa required; tourist issuance unconfirmed

policies.n: Macao SAR ordinary passport: the origin-government checker explicitly indicates visa required with an eVisa route. However, Guinea public country data marks Macao inactive, so current electronic application eligibility is not confirmed. Preserve the visa requirement with method uncertainty; seek confirmation of an accepted channel before travel. Approval letter and border enrolment are sequential, not alternative visa methods. The portal 90-day field is labelled Validity and is not used as stay.
policies.label: Visa required; electronic channel unconfirmed

policies.n: Ordinary Rwandan passport: a visa is issued free of charge on entry under Article 1(1) of the bilateral agreement, provisionally effective from signature on 24 November 2021 and ratified/published in 2023. The treaty gives visa validity of no more than 90 days; an independently specified admitted tourist stay was not established, so d=0. Diplomatic/service visa exemption is not extended to ordinary passports. Use an authorised international crossing; normal admissibility and local law remain applicable.
policies.label: Fee-free visa on arrival

policies.n: Ordinary DE passport: visa required before travel through the competent Congolese mission. No tourist stay is specified. The existence of an online form/payment service does not establish a stand-alone eVisa; other electronic issuance options remain unverified.

Ordinary RS passport: visa required before travel through the competent Congolese mission. No tourist stay is specified. The existence of an online form/payment service does not establish a stand-alone eVisa; other electronic issuance options remain unverified.

HISTORICAL DOCUMENT: the signed 23 October 2017 Interior Ministry circular exempts holders of valid biometric ordinary passports from entry visas and exit authorisation for stays up to 90 days. Non-biometric passports are outside the stated exemption. This third-party-hosted facsimile establishes the historical implemented rule; current operation was not independently established. No unrestricted residence/work right is asserted.
policies.label: Historical biometric CEMAC waiver

policies.n: Ordinary FR passport: obtain a Syrian visa before travel through the competent mission. No admitted stay is established. Current independent eVisa eligibility for this origin is not confirmed; a consular instruction does not prove eVisa unavailable. Israeli travel evidence can cause refusal even with a visa. A national visa does not establish access to every territory or crossing. France states that issuance when entering by road from Lebanon requires proof of Lebanese residence or entry to Lebanon through Beirut airport; immigration regularisation is required for stays over fifteen days. Neither rule is a fifteen-day visa grant.

Ordinary DE passport: obtain a Syrian visa before travel through the competent mission. No admitted stay is established. Current independent eVisa eligibility for this origin is not confirmed; a consular instruction does not prove eVisa unavailable. Israeli travel evidence can cause refusal even with a visa. A national visa does not establish access to every territory or crossing. Germany requires six-month passport validity and directs applicants to the Syrian mission responsible for their residence country; Lebanon transit has separate entry rules.

Chinese ordinary passports require a Syrian visa; China MFA directs ordinary-passport applicants to the electronic-visa channel linked by the Syrian embassy in China (offline receipt discontinued from 1 May 2024). No visa exemption applies. Approval and territorial/crossing permissions remain necessary. The page describes fifteen-day visa validity and immigration registration for stays beyond fifteen days; neither is converted into a fixed tourist stay.

HISTORICAL RULE ONLY: BOCA describes the May 2024 Taiwan ordinary-passport eVisa regime but explicitly says post-8 December 2024 implementation awaits confirmation. Requires a guarantor resident in Syria whom authorities can contact, a six-month passport, approval before travel and printed approval. Former maximum stay fifteen days; one/three/six-month visa validity is separate. Israeli travel evidence can prevent entry. Not current admission verification.
policies.label: Historical sponsored tourist eVisa

policies.n: Ordinary TW passport: a visa must be arranged before travel. BOCA requires a six-month passport, itinerary, invitation/purpose and a contact in Yemen, with a prior appointment at a Yemeni mission. The Aden IPNA portal provides an agency/authority-mediated tourist approval process; nationality-specific independent eVisa eligibility and stay remain unverified. Prior approval followed by a border sticker is one process. Confirm the competent authority and entry port for mainland Yemen or Socotra; no permission for all territories is inferred.

Ordinary CN passport: a visa must be arranged before travel. China MFA expressly requires a visa; its diplomatic-passport fee waiver is not a visa exemption. The Aden IPNA portal provides an agency/authority-mediated tourist approval process; nationality-specific independent eVisa eligibility and stay remain unverified. Prior approval followed by a border sticker is one process. Confirm the competent authority and entry port for mainland Yemen or Socotra; no permission for all territories is inferred.

Ordinary-passport tourist visa exemption is expressly supported by both official sources. Permitted duration conflicts: 90 days at the central MFA versus 30 at Brussels. No maximum stay is selected; confirm the current authorised period before travel and follow the admission stamp. This duration dispute is not evidence of a visa requirement.
policies.label: Visa-free; stay period disputed

policies.n: Ordinary-passport tourist visa exemption is expressly supported by both official sources. Permitted duration conflicts: 90 days at the central MFA versus 30 at Brussels. No maximum stay is selected; confirm the current authorised period before travel and follow the admission stamp. This duration dispute is not evidence of a visa requirement.
policies.label: Visa-free; stay period disputed

policies.n: Ordinary-passport tourist visa exemption is expressly supported by both official sources. Permitted duration conflicts: 90 days at the central MFA versus 180 at Brussels. No maximum stay is selected; confirm the current authorised period before travel and follow the admission stamp. This duration dispute is not evidence of a visa requirement.
policies.label: Visa-free; stay period disputed

policies.n: Ordinary passport: visa required under the Ministry/mission full exemption schedule for the regime effective 1 April 2025. Diplomatic/official/service-only exemptions do not cover an ordinary passport. These origins are not assigned an arrival/eVisa entitlement by subtraction from the arrival list. Missions advertise online holiday-visa applications as well as consular processing, but origin-specific electronic eligibility remains unconfirmed; consult the competent mission/Ministry. No third-country residence or visa is assumed. Stay is as granted: the advertised 90-day validity from submission is not encoded as a stay.
policies.label: Visa required; issuance method unconfirmed

policies.n: Taiwan ordinary passport: apply for a single-entry tourist eVisa before travel. BOCA describes short-stay visas for 15-90 days; duration is as approved. Carry printed eVisa, passport and flight documents; immigration can request boarding passes for the full route. BOCA also mentions arrival issuance, while the destination FAQ conflicts; only the common advance eVisa option is certified.
policies.stay: 15-90 days, as specified on the approved short-stay visa

policies.n: Macao SAR ordinary passport: the DSI public travel-concession checker explicitly lists Djibouti with electronic-visa availability. Obtain advance single-entry tourist eVisa; stay is as issued. The checker does not establish a visa exemption or walk-up arrival right. Six-month passport, accommodation/invitation and transport evidence are required under the destination FAQ.

Hong Kong SAR passport is explicitly Category A (visa exempt) in the Guatemalan immigration authority chart. No general Chinese or Macao exemption is inferred. No stay length appears in the chart; applicable regional CA-4 admission time must be checked rather than assuming a new allowance at each border.

Ordinary Bolivian passport is explicitly Category B: consular visa. Obtain the required approval before travel. No third-country-document exemption is assumed. Chart supplies no stay; independent electronic issuance is not established.

Ordinary Albanian passport is explicitly Category C: consulted visa/advance immigration approval. The IGM tourist process requires a Guatemalan guarantor and supporting documents. No third-country-document exemption is assumed and no stay is invented. This is Guatemala-specific evidence, independent of unilateral El Salvador annotations.
policies.label: Consulted tourist visa

policies.n: The FSM Immigration Act and official visitor guidance establish visa/advance-permit-free short visits, including the universal stay of thirty days or less. A separate longer bilateral entitlement for these non-EU EFTA passports was not established; d=0 preserves uncertainty over the total permitted maximum rather than importing the EU 90/180 rule. Present valid passport (visitor guidance: 120 days beyond entry), completed CIQ form and onward travel or accepted substitute evidence. Longer stay/extension requires immigration permission.
policies.label: Visa-free; maximum entitlement unconfirmed

policies.n: Taiwan ordinary passport: either obtain a consular visa before travel or arrange issuance at Minsk National Airport. For Minsk issuance the inviting person/organisation must submit original visa-support documents and a copy to DAF at least two business days before arrival; carry the DAF-stamped copy for airline check-in. Not available on flights from Russia: obtain the consular visa instead. Ordinary tourism and document checks remain applicable. BOCA describes consular short-stay visas up to 90 days, but an equal arrival-visa stay was not established, so no shared duration is assigned.
policies.stay: Consular short-stay visa: up to 90 days as granted; Minsk issuance: as granted
policies.label: Pre-arranged Minsk visa or consular visa

policies.n: Libyan ordinary passport requires an Irish visa. Visitor applications may be considered when the applicant is a long-term resident of an EU Member State or another country AND has good, recent travel history to the UK, EU, Australia, New Zealand, Canada or US; alternatively applications supported by an Irish Government Department or State Agency may be considered with sponsorship evidence. Those conditions are not assumed. Outside the published accepted categories, ordinary-tourist consideration is not established under the continuing restrictions; this is not a nationality-wide entry ban. Immediate-family applications have separately listed conditions, not a general tourist waiver. No stay is established.
policies.label: Visa required; visitor applications restricted

policies.n: Cypriot ordinary passport is covered by the EU-Palau agreement: 90 days in any rolling 180-day period, regardless of transport mode. Article 2 defines EU Member States with only UK/Ireland excluded, not only Schengen countries. Paid activity is outside the waiver; other entry and short-stay requirements remain. Complete the current Palau entry declaration and meet passport, funds/onward-travel and border-admissibility conditions. This is a visitor waiver, not free movement.
policies.label: EU treaty short-stay waiver

policies.n: HKSAR passport only. Hong Kong Immigration explicitly lists the 14-day concession; the general Burundi airport-visa requirement is not substituted for this nationality-specific waiver.
Ordinary HKSAR passport only; 30-day visa-free concession reported by Hong Kong Immigration. Not a mainland-China or BN(O) rule.

Ordinary HKSAR passport only; Hong Kong Immigration names a 90-day concession. Separate mainland-China visa requirement does not itself cancel the HKSAR rule. Galapagos and port-specific entry controls remain separate.
Explicit ordinary-passport exemption in the Burundi MFA schedule. Duration is not stated. Diplomatic/service lists were not generalized.

Airport-entry visa issued on arrival only after the mandatory online application and validation certificate before travel. This is one sequential process, not independent eVisa/arrival alternatives. Applies to ordinary tourist passports without Burundi settlement/permanent residence; ordinary bilateral waivers and EAC/CEPGL fee-free categories were separately reviewed. Airport route only; no land-port eligibility inferred. Stay duration not established for this general route.

Canadian ordinary passport; advance online visa certificate required for visa issuance at Melchior Ndadaye International Airport, Bujumbura. Ottawa embassy issuance is also documented; stay duration is unspecified for each method.
Ordinary Macao SAR passport (travelPermit=0). Official DSI result explicitly sets visaFree=1 and 30 days; not inferred from a Chinese-nationality umbrella.

Ordinary Macao SAR passport (travelPermit=0). DSI explicitly reports evisa=1 and visaFree=0, linking the destination portal. Advance approval required; permitted stay is not specified. Gabon eVisa route is through Libreville airport; portal access failed during this audit, so operational availability must be confirmed.
Ordinary Macao SAR passport (travelPermit=0). DSI explicitly reports evisa=1 and visaFree=0, linking the destination portal. Advance approval required; permitted stay is not specified.

Ordinary Macao SAR passport. DSI explicitly allows arrival visa at Bujumbura International Airport with return/onward ticket. Burundi CGM additionally requires advance online application and validation certificate. Online request and border issuance are sequential; no separate eVisa alternative asserted.

EU Member State ordinary tourist passport. Portuguese MFA expressly states the visa requirement for EU citizens and offers advance DGDI eVisa approval with border issuance. Use Libreville airport for the electronic route. Stay length is unspecified; three-month residence-permission threshold is not encoded as a guaranteed tourist stay. Consular issuance is separately possible; no unconditional walk-up arrival alternative asserted.

ROC ordinary passport valid at least six months. Obtain DGDI electronic entry authorization before travel; border visa issuance is the subsequent step, not a walk-up alternative. Return/onward ticket, accommodation/invitation and yellow-fever certificate required. Use the documented Libreville electronic-arrival route. Three-month visa validity is not an established stay duration.

Ordinary CA passport; obtain Benin electronic visa before travel through the official portal. Visa validity choices are not converted into a universal stay allowance. No ordinary exemption inferred from diplomatic/service agreements.

Ordinary RS passport; obtain Benin electronic visa before travel through the official portal. Visa validity choices are not converted into a universal stay allowance. No ordinary exemption inferred from diplomatic/service agreements.

Ordinary FR passport; obtain Benin electronic visa before travel through the official portal. Visa validity choices are not converted into a universal stay allowance. No ordinary exemption inferred from diplomatic/service agreements.

Ordinary TW passport; obtain Benin electronic visa before travel through the official portal. Visa validity choices are not converted into a universal stay allowance. No ordinary exemption inferred from diplomatic/service agreements.

Andean citizen tourist entry without visa on valid national identity document/passport. Ministry implementation notice specifies initial 90 days, extendable by 90, maximum 180 continuous or discontinuous days in the same year. Residency/work rights require the separate Andean residence process. General South American statutory 180-day wording does not remove the documented initial-grant/extension distinction.

ROC ordinary passport: advance electronic tourist visa required. BOCA explicitly describes 90-day multiple-entry tourist class and email issuance. Passport six months; criminal-record and financial documents need legalization; a video or consular interview may be required. This is not a mainland-China inference.

Ordinary RS tourist passport. Visa exemption up to 90 days. Source does not independently specify the aggregate clock; the general Ecuador tourist allowance is subject to annual controls and separately requested extension. Additional Galapagos and land/river-entry requirements remain separate.

Ordinary SG tourist passport. Visa exemption up to 90 days. Source does not independently specify the aggregate clock; the general Ecuador tourist allowance is subject to annual controls and separately requested extension. Additional Galapagos and land/river-entry requirements remain separate.

French ordinary tourist passport is explicitly visa-exempt. French advice describes 90 days in rolling twelve months, while Ecuador Law Article 56 counts a year from first entry. The numerical day field is withheld to preserve that aggregate-clock discrepancy. Separately requested extensions, Galapagos and land/river-entry requirements remain distinct.
policies.stay: 90-day allowance; rolling-twelve-month versus first-entry-year aggregate clock differs between sources

policies.n: Ordinary ES tourist passport. Visa exemption up to 90 days. Source does not independently specify the aggregate clock; the general Ecuador tourist allowance is subject to annual controls and separately requested extension. Additional Galapagos and land/river-entry requirements remain separate.

Nationality explicitly requires a visa under the current Ecuador MFA schedule. Tourist eVisa processing is supported by the Ministry worldwide 100%-online rollout, later CESDI implementation, and statutory authority for electronic issuance. Individual approval, documents and any requested interview remain required. No third-country visa/residence assumed. Stay is left unspecified here rather than conflating validity or initial-grant and extension rules.

Nationality explicitly requires a visa under the current Ecuador MFA schedule. Tourist eVisa processing is supported by the Ministry worldwide 100%-online rollout, later CESDI implementation, and statutory authority for electronic issuance. Individual approval, documents and any requested interview remain required. No third-country visa/residence assumed. Stay is left unspecified here rather than conflating validity or initial-grant and extension rules. The Ministry additionally requires Haitian tourist registration before entry.

Visa required: ICA explicitly requires a visa for all foreign visitors. APPLICATION METHOD UNRESOLVED: current ordinary-tourist checker lists exclude this nationality, while the visitor booklet says online applications and the descriptive page offers paper forms. No eVisa, walk-up arrival visa, consular-only availability or admission ban is asserted. Obtain ICA confirmation of the usable channel before travel. Stay duration is not established for this unresolved channel. Mandatory PNG Digital Arrival Card is a separate requirement, not a replacement visa.
policies.label: Visa required — application channel unresolved

policies.n: Official checker explicitly sets NeedVisa=true for this ordinary nationality. Standard short-stay electronic branch is disabled; C5 flag is enabled. Law defines C5 separately with a non-resident-work limitation and distinct validity/stay rules. Eligibility for that specific channel is not assumed, and no 30-day or one-year allowance is assigned. Visa requirement is verified; complete tourist application-channel eligibility remains unresolved, not eVisa-unavailable.
policies.label: Visa required — C5 eligibility needs confirmation

policies.n: Austrian ordinary passport; visa-free for up to 14 days. Passport valid six months after departure, return/onward ticket and sufficient funds. South African routing requirements are separate.

ROC ordinary passport valid six months; tourist visa required. BOCA states the eVisa application service is suspended and directs applicants to the Lesotho Ministry visa-applications email process. Current issuance/collection mechanics and stay remain unverified; no claim of unrestricted arrival visa. South African transit/entry permission is separate.
policies.label: Visa required — manual application instructions

policies.n: ROC ordinary passport; BOCA documents applying for a Chad visa through its US/French/Indian missions. Online eligibility for this particular document remains unverified; this does not establish eVisa unavailable. Stay unspecified.

ROC ordinary passport valid six months. Apply for a visa with a Kyrgyz travel-agency or other invitation through a Kyrgyz mission, including documented nearby Japan/Korea/Malaysia options. Return/onward ticket required; visa grant determines stay. Online method is not independently established for this document.

Visa required for the ordinary nationality-only tourist baseline. INM explicitly names Albania in the live text and Brazil in the linked required-country image. Qualifying third-country visa/permanent-residence exemptions are not assumed. Electronic authorization/eVisa availability is not conclusively established for this nationality; vr does not mean consular-only. Stay is granted at entry within the 180-day ceiling.
policies.stay: As granted on entry, up to 180 days
policies.label: Visa required — electronic method not confirmed

policies.n: Ordinary Serbian passport: obtain a visa before travel through the competent Guinea-Bissau mission. Serbian MFA explicitly says no eVisa or border visa for this route. Passport validity six months; stay not specified.
Ordinary Turkish passport: visa required in advance; Turkish MFA states that border issuance is not available. No duration or electronic-application eligibility is established.

Ordinary Spanish passport, including minors: visa required. Obtain it from the competent mission before travel; Spain reports an inoperative electronic site and unclear/unstable border-issuance conditions. No unrestricted arrival entitlement or duration asserted.

Ordinary tourist passport: visa required; obtain the visa through the competent Algerian mission. Diplomatic/service exemptions are not ordinary-passport waivers. Stay and nationality-specific electronic eligibility are not established here; no general eVisa-unavailability claim is made.

Ordinary tourist passport: visa required; obtain the visa through the competent Algerian mission. Diplomatic/service exemptions are not ordinary-passport waivers. Stay and nationality-specific electronic eligibility are not established here; no general eVisa-unavailability claim is made.

Ordinary tourist passport: visa required; obtain the visa through the competent Algerian mission. Diplomatic/service exemptions are not ordinary-passport waivers. Stay and nationality-specific electronic eligibility are not established here; no general eVisa-unavailability claim is made.

Ordinary tourist passport: visa required; obtain the visa through the competent Algerian mission. Diplomatic/service exemptions are not ordinary-passport waivers. Stay and nationality-specific electronic eligibility are not established here; no general eVisa-unavailability claim is made.

A consular tourist visa is required for independent travel. A separate southern-Algeria organised-group route uses an approved travel agency, advance QR boarding authorisation, and visa issuance/payment on arrival. Do not assume participation or authorisation. The source’s thirty days describes arrival-visa validity, not a confirmed stay.
policies.label: Visa required; pre-authorised southern-tour option

policies.n: Ordinary German passport: obtain a consular visa before travel. An approved agency invitation with route and duration is mandatory for southern travel; a limited arrival-visa exception exists at selected southern tourism airports for agency-booked journeys and must be confirmed in advance. No general walk-up visa, electronic eligibility, or uniform stay is asserted.
policies.label: Visa required; limited southern-tour option

policies.n: Ordinary short visit under the Immigration Department’s Visa Policy 2025, effective 19 May 2025 and currently linked by the embassy. Nationality is expressly listed or covered by the explicit Schengen group (Liechtenstein). The source does not establish an initial stay duration; d=0. This is visitor visa exemption, not unrestricted residence or employment.

Independent ordinary tourist travel: the embassy’s explicit residual rule requires a visa for countries outside the exemption schedule. Obtain the visa from a competent Gambian mission. The 2025 policy separately exempts tourists on chartered flights and tour operators, but does not specify all operational conditions; do not assume this itinerary-dependent exemption. Arrival visas apply only to certain passport holders whose eligibility is not established here. Stay and electronic eligibility unspecified.
policies.label: Visa required; charter-tour exception conditional

policies.n: Ordinary tourist passport: obtain prior clearance from the competent Egyptian authorities and then the visa through the mission with jurisdiction over actual residence. London/Washington procedures are residence-limited; UK/US residence is not assumed. No clearance, visa issuance, duration, or eVisa eligibility is presumed. Palestinian VIP passports and non-tourist Rafah arrangements are outside this ordinary-tourism rule.
policies.label: Visa and prior clearance required

policies.n: Ordinary Bangladeshi passport: Washington expressly requires a visa before entry. Apply through the Egyptian mission competent for actual residence; US residence is not assumed. Duration and other electronic eligibility not established.

The consulate explicitly identifies this nationality as visa-requiring. The older FAQ’s broader clearance roster differs from the newer visa pages; the requirement is preserved without asserting universal prior clearance or excluding an electronic/arrival channel. Use the mission competent for actual residence to establish the applicable method, any sponsor/group/third-country-document conditions, and stay. None of those personal conditions is assumed.
policies.label: Visa required; method/clearance eligibility uncertain

policies.n: A tourist visa is required; London’s Chinese-national instructions establish a consular pathway with employer/university letter and return tickets. Nationality-specific electronic, sponsored-group and arrival methods are not comprehensively established here and are not claimed unavailable. Apply through the mission competent for actual residence. Stay unspecified.
policies.label: Visa required; method eligibility uncertain

policies.n: Malaysian nationals may visit without a visa for up to two weeks. For longer stays the usual visa requirements apply.

Ordinary independent visits outside the Jeju concession require a Korean visa; electronic eligibility depends on the visa category and is not established here. Conditional exception: direct international arrival at Jeju airport or seaport for tourism/transit, staying only in Jeju, is visa-exempt for up to 30 days. Mainland transfer is not covered. Separate document-and-itinerary-dependent transit concessions exist (qualifying foreign visas/residence or a recognised escorted Incheon transit tour); none is assumed. Regular visa stay varies.
policies.label: Visa required / Jeju-only 30-day exemption
policies.stay: Jeju-only exemption: up to 30 days; regular visa stay not established

policies.n: Ordinary short tourist visit requires a Korean visa. This nationality is expressly excluded from Jeju’s direct-arrival visa exemption and from the specified third-country-visa/Incheon transit concessions. K-ETA is not a substitute for a required visa. Visa duration and nationality/category-specific eVisa eligibility remain unverified; no eVisa-unavailability or entry-ban claim is made.

Arrival visa/pass at Kigali International Airport and all land borders. DRC is expressly named for a 90-day-valid free visa, while the EAC clause grants a free arrival pass/entry visa for a six-month stay. The common arrival method is established; d=0 preserves the unresolved applicable duration and distinction between validity and stay. Fee-free does not mean visa-free.
policies.label: Arrival visa/pass; duration needs confirmation

policies.n: Rwanda’s all-country arrival-visa rule covers ordinary Somali visitors at Kigali International Airport and all land borders. The source also provides a free six-month EAC pass/entry visa but does not name Somalia in its implementation detail; do not assume the six-month concession. Duration remains unspecified, and a free arrival permission is not encoded as visa-free.
policies.label: Arrival visa/pass; EAC duration unconfirmed

policies.n: HKSAR ordinary passport accepted for arrival access, independently listed by Hong Kong Immigration. Rwanda DGIE establishes the visa-on-arrival method at Kigali International Airport and all land borders. The HKSAR schedule states one month; it is not converted to 30 days. Fee concessions are separate from visa exemption.
policies.stay: One month

policies.n: Tourist visa required. NTB expressly directs Iranian nationals to a Nepalese mission before departure; London’s on-arrival exception list omits Iran, so arrival eligibility remains conflicting rather than being claimed unavailable. Use the competent mission for actual residence; the London procedure requires physical passport submission despite the ETA name. Choose the applicable tourist visa duration; six-month entry validity is not a stay.
policies.label: Visa required; arrival eligibility unresolved
policies.stay: Tourist visa choices: 15, 30 or 90 days

policies.n: Russian ordinary tourist: Estonia does not ordinarily accept tourist visa applications and prohibits tourist entry across its external border on a short-stay Schengen visa, even one issued by another state. The government FAQ permits entry from within Schengen after lawful Schengen admission; an appropriate valid visa/permission and accepted biometric passport remain necessary. Non-biometric Russian foreign passports are not recognised from 31 March 2025. Specified close-family, residence, D-visa, EU-family and humanitarian exceptions are not assumed. No nationality-wide ban is asserted.
policies.label: Tourism restricted at external border; internal-Schengen exception

policies.n: Ordinary short tourist visitor: entry visa or advance online visa authorisation required under amended section 10. Decree 2023/147 requires online application/payment; competent or nearest mission processes it. Residence in the mission city can require consular enrolment/sticker collection; outside it, approved electronic authorisation may be followed by border biometrics and visa printing at an equipped authorised checkpoint. Obtain approval before travel; this is one sequential process, not a separate walk-up arrival visa. Passport at least six months, return/onward arrangements, accommodation and sufficient means. Six-month short-stay visa validity is not an established permitted stay. Treaty/document exceptions are separately unresolved.
policies.label: Advance online visa approval

policies.n: Visa required under the embassy’s explicit rule for nationalities outside its ordinary exemption list. Passport at least six months; mission application requires travel and accommodation/invitation evidence. The precise electronic, consular or airport issuance method and permitted stay are not established by this source. This rule does not claim eVisa or visa on arrival is unavailable.
policies.label: Visa required; issuance method unconfirmed

policies.n: Tourist visa required for a regular Canadian passport. Permitted stay and electronic/arrival eligibility are not established; no claim that an electronic method is unavailable.

German citizens require an entry visa. Berlin tourist procedure requires tourism-agency invitation or sponsor approval from Sudanese authorities before mission issuance. Permitted stay is unspecified; an online form is not proof of end-to-end eVisa issuance.

Serbian national passport requires a visa; MFA describes competent-mission issuance following a Sudanese host’s prior authority request. Current stay and alternative electronic/arrival eligibility are not established.
Ordinary Serbian passport exemption for stays up to 30 days.
French tourist exemption; passport valid at least six months, return ticket and hotel reservation. Paid activity needs separate permission.
policies.stay: 3 months

policies.n: MEA explicitly lists ordinary Indian passports for visa-free entry for 90 days. No third-country visa/residence condition is attached to this row.
Free tourist visa issued on arrival to Canadian ordinary-passport holders. Maximum 90 days, continuous or divided among visits, within 180 days from first entry; not 90 fresh days on every entry.
Singapore passport exemption for up to 90 days within a 180-day period. The source warns that passports bearing only a single name are not accepted. No assumption of unlimited repeat 90-day stays.
Serbian ordinary national passports are visa-exempt for stays up to 90 days under the bilateral agreement. The source does not specify a rolling/aggregate 180-day period; no such period is inferred.

Kosovo ordinary passports are explicitly exempt from entry visa requirements; current MOFA inbound list corroborates the exemption. UAE-bound stay duration is unspecified. The treaty notice’s 90 days per visit refers to UAE citizens entering Kosovo and is not reversed.

Taiwan is expressly visa-required in the regular-passport column of the UAE mission’s public table. Tourist visas are arranged through UAE visa agents/hotels or a sponsor, with a copy obtained before travel. No unrestricted personal eVisa or stay length is proved.
policies.label: Advance visa via sponsor or agent

policies.n: The nationality-specific diplomatic/official/service concessions do not cover ordinary tourist passports. Obtain a consular visa or prior General Security approval under article 11. No ordinary-passport waiver or unrestricted arrival entitlement is asserted. Permitted stay and any electronic channel remain unconfirmed.

Visa requirement established, but arrival versus prior-approval scope remains uncertain: article 8 describes an airport visa for one month, extendable to three, with non-refundable round-trip ticket, accommodation/contact and USD 2,000 cash or certified cheque; article 10 addresses female nationals and prior General Security tourism approval. Do not assume eligibility for walk-up issuance. A pre-issued consular visa/prior approval is the documented route to clarify with the authority; d=0 does not transfer the airport duration to every method.
policies.label: Visa required; arrival eligibility needs confirmation

policies.n: HKSAR passports of all ages must obtain Kenya eTA before travel. This is specific to HKSAR passports, not BN(O) or Hong Kong identity documents. The cited Kenya remark gives no permitted stay.

Short tourist visa exemption is established. French guidance says less than three months; Barbados’s current France row contains conflicting three-in-six-month and six-month limits. Maximum allowance remains unresolved, so no numerical day count or six-month entitlement is asserted.
policies.label: Visa-free short visit; maximum stay disputed

policies.n: Taiwan ordinary passports only; not diplomatic/official. Fourteen-day stay is non-extendable and cannot be converted to another visa category. Passport valid six months beyond intended stay, accommodation, financial capacity, return/onward ticket and no derogatory Immigration record required. Complete free eTravel arrival declaration within 72 hours before arrival. For more than fourteen days or permit-requiring activities, obtain the relevant visa beforehand. MECO states no expiry date.
French ordinary passports: visa not required for a visit of up to three calendar months. Passport must have at least three months validity on entry. Months are not converted to 90 days.
policies.stay: 3 months

policies.n: Individual Serbian visitors require a visa from a Tunisian mission before travel. An organised tourist group may instead receive a visa on arrival with a prepaid hotel voucher and confirmed return air ticket matching the stay. Group participation is not assumed. No initial stay is conclusively specified; the page’s three-month extension discussion is not used as the initial allowance.
policies.label: Advance visa; organised-group arrival exception

policies.n: Taiwan ordinary-passport holders require a visa; BOCA identifies the Tunisian Embassy in Tokyo as an application mission. Stay unspecified. This establishes the visa requirement, not that any electronic channel is unavailable.

HISTORICAL ONLY: Berlin embassy capture of 12 December 2023 expressly names this nationality (or EU membership excluding Cyprus) as visa-exempt. This is not live confirmation of the 2026 rule. The page gives a general three-calendar-month tourist ceiling, but nationality-specific duration differences are not independently reconciled; d=0 intentionally.
policies.label: Historical visa waiver — 2023 evidence

policies.n: HISTORICAL ONLY: 12 December 2023 Berlin capture provides a visa waiver when entering as part of a package tour; otherwise its explicit visa-procedure default applies. Package-tour participation is not assumed. Current implementation and stay duration are not verified.
policies.label: Historical package-tour waiver; visa otherwise

policies.n: HISTORICAL ONLY: 12 December 2023 Berlin capture explicitly subjects third-country nationals not in its two exemption lists to visa procedures. Recorded only as archived evidence, not a current 2026 visa-required determination. Stay and current electronic-method eligibility are unknown.
policies.label: Historical visa requirement — 2023 evidence

policies.n: Ordinary Indian passport visa waiver suspended from 22 November 2025. Visa required for entry or transit. BOCA reports a general requirement for foreign visa applicants to use a registered Iranian agency and agency-arranged itinerary. This is a requirement-only rule: current final eVisa, arrival and consular eligibility remain unverified, and no claim that eVisa is unavailable is made.
policies.label: Visa required; final issuance method unconfirmed

policies.n: Australian ordinary-passport holders must obtain a visa before travel. BOCA reports a general requirement for foreign visa applicants to use a registered Iranian agency and agency-arranged itinerary. Final electronic-versus-consular issuance is not settled; no consular-only inference or numerical stay. Israeli stamps/visas can cause refusal.
policies.label: Advance visa; final issuance method unconfirmed

policies.n: German ordinary-passport visitors require a visa and may apply for an online eVisa before entry; carry the electronic visa printout. Stay is unspecified here. Reliable operation of visa on arrival is not established. BOCA also reports a rule for all foreign visa applicants requiring a registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary; independent direct application is not assumed.

French ordinary passports: private short visits may obtain a 30-day visa at certain Iranian airports only after online preregistration, carrying its printed confirmation. The source does not enumerate eligible airports, so this is not an all-port entitlement. BOCA reports that all foreign visa applicants must use a registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary; retain that condition as well. Mission application in advance is recommended and requires in-person fingerprints. No walk-up/no-preapproval entitlement is asserted.
policies.label: Airport visa; agency and preregistration required

policies.n: Malaysian national passports: visa-exempt for stays not exceeding 30 days; longer stays or other purposes require a visa. Origin-government evidence applies only to Malaysians.

Taiwan ordinary-passport visitors need an Iranian registered travel agency to apply and arrange their itinerary. Prior online application is followed by physical visa issuance at the selected mission or Iranian international airport; carry printed approval/application documents. Airport fee payable in euro cash. Tourist stay is at most 90 days, but actual grant controls. This is not a direct final eVisa or unrestricted walk-up arrival visa.
policies.label: Pre-approved visa; Iranian agency required

policies.n: HISTORICAL ONLY: Hong Kong consulate snapshot of 13 November 2025 records an ordinary-passport tourism waiver from 4 February 2024, one entry every six months, maximum 15 days, nonextendible. Other purposes and longer stays require visas. This is not current live verification. India is expressly excluded from these additions because a later official withdrawal is verified.
policies.label: Historical tourist waiver — November 2025 evidence

policies.n: Serbian ordinary passports require a visa. Serbia MFA and the live no-third-country-status tourist checker reject direct eVisa/arrival eligibility; the static Kuwait nationality list still includes Serbia. Preserve the common visa requirement with acquisition-channel uncertainty pending consular reconciliation. No stay duration is established.
policies.label: Visa required; channel conflict

policies.n: Chinese ordinary passports: published tourist guidance describes a visa requirement, but direct eVisa/arrival eligibility conflicts with the current no-third-country-status checker, which returns false for both, and the runtime arrival list. Requirement retained; precise application channel and duration remain unconfirmed. Do not infer an entry ban or universal electronic-visa unavailability from this branch.
policies.label: Visa required; channel conflict

policies.n: Ordinary visitors are expressly named in the Eswatini Tourism Authority and Kuala Lumpur High Commission visa-exempt schedules. Duration is not conclusively specified: the mission’s 60-day residence-permit threshold and visa validity periods are not initial visitor stay grants. Palestine means the explicitly named Occupied Palestinian Territory ordinary passport, not any other refugee/travel document.

Visa required under the explicit non-listed-nationality defaults in the Tourism Authority and Kuala Lumpur High Commission schedules, after retaining identified conflicts separately. Obtain permission in advance through an Eswatini mission; tourism authority says direct government issuance on arrival is not yet available. Electronic issuance eligibility and initial stay duration are not established; visa-validity fees do not set a stay.
policies.label: Advance visa required; stay unspecified

policies.n: Tourist visa exemption expressly stated by Malaysia’s Santiago mission. Source says usual stay is less than 30 days, not an inclusive 30-day maximum. Complete MDAC within three days before arrival.
policies.stay: Less than 30 days

policies.n: Ordinary-passport tourism/social visit exemption expressly confirmed for this nationality. The stated initial period is not a visa validity or extension. MDAC is a separate arrival declaration; no permission to work or settle is implied.

Ordinary-passport tourism/social visit exemption expressly confirmed for this nationality. The stated initial period is not a visa validity or extension. MDAC is a separate arrival declaration; no permission to work or settle is implied.

Named unstarred Without Visa / On Arrival column establishes exemption. Calendar months are retained without converting them to days. Extension and visa-with-reference columns are separate; the starred visa-required footnote does not apply to this unstarred nationality row.
policies.stay: 3 months

policies.n: Named unstarred Without Visa / On Arrival column establishes exemption. Calendar months are retained without converting them to days. Extension and visa-with-reference columns are separate; the starred visa-required footnote does not apply to this unstarred nationality row.
policies.stay: 3 months

policies.n: Named unstarred Without Visa / On Arrival column establishes exemption. Calendar months are retained without converting them to days. Extension and visa-with-reference columns are separate; the starred visa-required footnote does not apply to this unstarred nationality row.
policies.stay: 1 month

policies.n: Singaporean ordinary-passport visitors require advance eVisa through Togo Voyage, at least five working days before arrival. Initial stay unspecified by this source. Passport six months valid on expected departure.

Taiwan passport holders apply for Togo eVisa/entry approval at least five working days before arrival. Present Ministry-issued approval and supporting documents at the border; border completion is not a separate unrestricted VOA alternative. Initial stay unspecified.

Ordinary visitors fall under Togo Voyage’s explicit foreign-national visa default; they are not in the inspected ordinary exemption schedule. Visa applications are normally online in advance; these nationalities are omitted from the published electronic-eligibility enumeration, so individual electronic processing eligibility remains uncertain. No inference of visa unavailability or entry refusal. Stay unspecified.
policies.label: Visa required; electronic eligibility unconfirmed

policies.n: Taiwan ordinary-passport tourists must apply online for Uganda eVisa before travel and carry emailed approval. No walk-up arrival visa. The separate East Africa Tourist Visa’s 90-day validity is not copied onto the ordinary Uganda tourist stay.

Taiwan ordinary-passport tourists require prior permission. Either obtain a visa at an Uzbek mission, or obtain an agency/company invitation approved and stamped by Uzbek MFA, with visa permission number, before travel for issuance only at Tashkent airport. Passport valid at least six months, return/onward ticket, photos required. This is a pre-cleared visa, not unrestricted VOA; stay depends on grant.
policies.label: Advance visa or pre-cleared Tashkent issuance

policies.n: Vietnam ordinary passports: tourism waiver up to30 days for travellers who have reached55. Under16: accompanied by legal representative and holding a biometric travel document, waiver for accompanying person’s visa validity, at most90 days. Other travellers need a visa under the express default. Vietnam is now expressly in the joint eVisa/simplified-consular list, but this disjunctive heading does not prove a specific issuance method; neither age nor accompanying status is assumed.
policies.label: Age-conditioned waiver; visa otherwise

policies.n: Taiwan ordinary-passport holders must obtain a Serbian visa in advance from a Serbian mission. BOCA expressly says EU/US visas or residence permits do not substitute for the Serbian visa for these passports. Duration and electronic delivery eligibility unconfirmed; no eVisa-unavailable claim.

For ordinary short tourism without assumed foreign visa or residence status, Kuwait’s embassy states that foreign nationals unable to use eVisa or arrival issuance must obtain a visa before travel through a local sponsor; a hotel is an expressly mentioned tourism sponsor. The MOI tourist checker returned no arrival/online/eVisa eligibility for this no-foreign-status profile. This establishes the visa requirement, not guaranteed sponsor acceptance, visa issuance or admission. Current practical issuance channel and stay remain unconfirmed; electronic processing through another eligible product is not ruled out.
policies.label: Advance visa required; issuance availability unconfirmed

policies.n: Taiwan BOCA describes a required entry visa but states that Kuwait has not published an ordinary-tourism application method for Taiwan nationals. A four-star-or-higher hotel may arrange a short-visit visa; its described 30-day stay is not assigned to an unconfirmed tourism product. Issuance, electronic eligibility and admission remain subject to Kuwaiti authority approval.
policies.label: Entry visa required; tourist application method unconfirmed

policies.n: UAE normal passports are visa-exempt. The original valid passport or original Emirates ID must be presented; a mobile digital ID is not sufficient. No tourist stay duration is stated.
Qatari regular passports are visa-exempt. This does not extend to sponsored companions holding other nationalities; the embassy gives separate prior-visa rules for them. Stay duration is not stated.

The UAE foreign ministry lists its normal passport as visa-free for Yemen, while separately prohibiting UAE nationals from travelling there. The origin-country prohibition remains applicable and is not a Yemeni nationality-wide entry ban. This visa classification does not establish an open tourist route, permission for any particular Yemeni territory or crossing, or a stay duration.
policies.label: Visa exemption listed; UAE travel prohibition applies

policies.n: The currently linked Eswatini High Commission nationality schedule explicitly marks Macao as visa-required; its holiday-visit instructions describe advance application. This is the Macao SAR passport rule, not a mainland-China substitution. Stay and eligibility for electronic issuance are not established.

Serbia’s foreign ministry expressly confirms visa-free entry for national passports. Passport validity of six months from planned entry and two blank pages are stated. Ordinary-passport stay is unspecified; the separate diplomatic/official 90-in-180 rule is not applied.

The joint embassy announcement establishes the mutual waiver for valid passports, effective 24 December 2020, for stays not exceeding 90 days. Work and study are excluded. The older London schedule predates this agreement.

UAE normal-passport visitors require a visa. Current UAE guidance identifies application through the Eswatini Embassy in Abu Dhabi and a 30-day stay per entry, consistent with the ministry schedule’s required marking. Multi-entry validity periods of three to twelve months are not stays. Electronic issuance eligibility is not established.

Qatar Tourism explicitly names this nationality in its Tourist Visas list and directs tourist-visa applications to Hayya. This records the documented electronic tourist-visa route, subject to approval; no foreign residence or supporting visa is assumed. The independent page wizard omits this nationality, so a wizard result and any arrival alternative are not asserted. No stay duration is established.
policies.label: Hayya tourist eVisa route

policies.n: Taiwan ordinary-passport tourists may obtain an eVisa after securing an invitation bearing a Kazakhstan Interior Ministry migration approval number. Print the eVisa and enter through Almaty or Astana international airport. An unapproved invitation is insufficient. BOCA also describes consular tourist applications; its event-specific pre-cleared arrival procedure is not presented as a general tourist option.

Taiwan passport holders may apply for Namibia’s online Holiday Visa. After approval and payment, the electronic result is emailed. Stay and extension are finally determined by border immigration and may differ from the online approval; no fixed stay is assigned. Availability has been reported since 22 September 2023, not newly introduced in this audit.

Somali nationals remain subject to the Schengen visa requirement, but the published CH/LI document-recognition matrix does not recognise the ordinary Somali passport. A visa alone does not establish that this document is acceptable. Any substitute-document or limited-territorial authorization, its practical availability for tourism and the permitted transit itinerary must be separately established with the competent authorities. No routine issuance, recognised ordinary-passport pathway or nationality-wide entry prohibition is asserted.
policies.label: Visa required; ordinary passport not recognised

policies.n: German ordinary passports only; permission is territory- and route-dependent. Germany’s Foreign Office identifies CoGAT as the competent authority: a journey exclusively to the West Bank generally needs prior CoGAT permission and entry via Jordan at Allenby, rather than Ben Gurion. That procedure expressly excludes an Israel stay combined with a short West Bank visit; Israeli admission and its entry card do not grant Gaza access. For the Israel-routing branch, the German visa waiver applies to persons born after 1 January 1928 and ETA-IL is required; prior deportation, overstay or refusal requires case review and a visa. German nationals also holding LB/SY/IQ/IR nationality or born there need separate advance permission. German holders of Palestinian IDs generally need a Palestinian passport, use Allenby, and need a separate permit for Israel/Jerusalem; German Gaza-origin Palestinian-ID holders cannot enter Israel or the West Bank under the cited guidance. Gaza access and currently closed Rafah routing remain separately unresolved. No country-wide tourist permission, common stay or waiver is asserted.
policies.label: Territory- and route-dependent permission

policies.n: The Turkish MFA explicitly requires a visa for ordinary Turkish passports. Permitted stay and electronic or arrival issuance eligibility are not established; this does not mean an eVisa is unavailable.
Ordinary Turkish passports: visa-free visits up to 30 days according to the Turkish MFA. This origin-specific period is not generalized to other passports.

Tourist visa exemption for ordinary Turkish passports is explicit. Türkiye describes 90 days in each 180 days; Ecuador Law Article 56 instead gives a general 90-day allowance in the year from first entry, subject to specific international agreements. The applicable Turkish treaty or period reconciliation was not established, so no numeric stay is asserted.

Italian ordinary tourists require a visa. Italy identifies the CAR Embassy in Paris; its short-stay service requires the printed form, original passport, photos and supporting documents to be sent to the embassy. Its online form is not electronic visa issuance. Stay and other issuance methods remain unspecified.

Japanese tourists may enter without a visa for up to 90 days; passport must have six months remaining on entry. The embassy page is headed 12 June 2023, not a new 2026 enactment, and does not define an annual or rolling reset. It requires an apostilled Spanish translation of a five-year criminal-record certificate for land entry from Peru or Colombia. The tourism authority additionally describes a requested SIMIEC check as an alternative; operational availability is not guaranteed.

Australian tourists may stay visa-free up to 90 days. A further 90 days requires a paid extension requested before expiry and is not an automatic initial stay. For land entry from Peru or Colombia, the tourism authority describes an apostilled five-year criminal-record certificate or a requested SIMIEC check; availability of a border check is not guaranteed. Galapagos has separate transit-card and insurance requirements.

German tourists: up to 90 visa-free days in the year counted from the first entry, not the calendar year or a fresh allowance on each entry. An extension requires a separate application. Passport must remain valid six months on entry. For land entry from Peru or Colombia, the tourism authority describes an apostilled five-year criminal-record certificate or a requested SIMIEC check; availability of a border check is not guaranteed. Galapagos has separate transit-card and insurance requirements.
