Italian tourists: up to 90 days in the year counted from first entry, not the calendar year or a per-visit reset. Passport valid at least six months on entry; obtain the immigration entry stamp. For land entry from Peru or Colombia, the tourism authority describes an apostilled five-year criminal-record certificate or a requested SIMIEC check; availability of a border check is not guaranteed. Galapagos has separate transit-card and insurance requirements.

Portuguese tourists: visa-free visits up to 90 days, with a passport valid at least six months on entry. This source does not establish a fresh 90-day allowance on every entry. For land entry from Peru or Colombia, the tourism authority describes an apostilled five-year criminal-record certificate or a requested SIMIEC check; availability of a border check is not guaranteed. Galapagos has separate transit-card and insurance requirements.

Austrian tourists: visa-free up to 90 days, passport valid six months on entry, return/onward ticket and an entry stamp required. The actual stamp can grant less than 90 days; inspect it and seek any extension before expiry. For land entry from Peru or Colombia, the tourism authority describes an apostilled five-year criminal-record certificate or a requested SIMIEC check; availability of a border check is not guaranteed. Galapagos has separate transit-card and insurance requirements.

Japanese passport holders visiting for up to 90 days do not need a visa: Japan MOFA records an explicit reply from Trinidad and Tobago MFA despite Japan being omitted from the online list. Passport valid six months on entry, outbound air ticket, sufficient funds and accommodation required. Complete online immigration/customs declarations within three days before arrival and departure; the stated start date is 17 March 2026.

Austrian ordinary-passport visits up to 90 days are visa-free. Austrian advice requires passport validity at least six months at departure, evidence of return/onward travel and sufficient funds. The period is origin-specific, not a general rule for every European passport.

Italian advice explicitly exempts visits shorter than 90 days. The exact less-than boundary is retained rather than encoded as an inclusive 90-day permission. Passport must have at least six months remaining; a longer stay needs separate authority.

Australian tourists are instructed to obtain an eVisa at least 14 business days before travel. The visa is emailed on approval; processing lead time is not permitted stay. DFAT also describes a discretionary paid waiver at the airport if arriving without a visa, with the period decided by the officer; this is not guaranteed walk-up admission. Cruise entry under 24 hours is separately exempt. Complete online arrival/departure declarations within 72 hours of travel.

Ordinary-passport visa requirement is established by Immigration Regulation 13(11) and the compulsory Second Schedule; Venezuela was added effective 17 June 2019. The 2024 Venezuelan service/diplomatic exemption is not an ordinary-tourist waiver. No ordinary-tourist stay is established. A current eVisa service exists, but this requirement-only record does not certify each nationality’s product-specific electronic eligibility or exclude electronic issuance.

Taiwan BOCA explicitly instructs ROC passport travellers to obtain a visa before departure. This establishes the requirement only. Its mission-application instructions do not reconcile the newer federal electronic process or current document/issuance restrictions; no functioning tourist channel, eVisa eligibility, duration or routine issuance is asserted. Federal Somalia and Somaliland entry regimes are separate.
policies.label: Visa required; issuance unresolved

policies.n: For ordinary ROC passports travelling by air, the consular tourist-visa default requires permission, and Taiwan BOCA states that business and tourist visas are generally not issued to holders of its passports. This is a restrictive requirement-only record: a currently usable ordinary-tourist channel and stay are not established, and routine issuance is not implied. It is not an absolute nationality-wide entry ban.
policies.label: Visa required; issuance restricted

policies.n: Belgian ordinary-passport visitors require a visa. Apply in the country of residence, or a neighbouring country where no DRC mission is present in the residence country. Belgian residents of Belgium are directed to Brussels or Antwerp. The permitted stay and nationality-specific electronic issuance route are not established; this visa requirement does not mean eVisa is unavailable.

Japanese ordinary-passport tourists require a visa. Tokyo describes original-passport consular processing, including a passport valid over six months, itinerary, accommodation and yellow-fever certificate. Six months is visa validity, not a universal stay. The permitted stay and nationality-specific electronic issuance route are not established; this visa requirement does not mean eVisa is unavailable.
Dutch ordinary-passport visitors require a visa. The permitted stay and nationality-specific electronic issuance route are not established; this visa requirement does not mean eVisa is unavailable.

Spanish visitors require a visa obtained in Spain or their country of residence. The DRC embassy in Brazzaville cannot issue visas to foreigners not resident in the Republic of Congo. The permitted stay and nationality-specific electronic issuance route are not established; this visa requirement does not mean eVisa is unavailable.

Russian ordinary passports require a visa. The March 2025 diplomatic/service waiver does not cover ordinary tourists. The permitted stay and nationality-specific electronic issuance route are not established; this visa requirement does not mean eVisa is unavailable.

Australian DFAT requires a visa before travel and advises that Australian travellers cannot obtain one on arrival. Nationality-specific electronic eligibility and the permitted stay are not established here; eVisa unavailability is not inferred.

Dutch ordinary-passport visitors require a visa; Dutch guidance directs applicants to the Iranian embassy in The Hague. Taiwan BOCA expressly reports that all foreign visa applicants must use a legally registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary. This does not apply a visa duty to independently exempt passports. No residence, preapproval, arrival eligibility or qualifying itinerary is assumed. Issuance method and permitted stay remain uncertain.

Belgian visitors require a visa. Belgian guidance also mentions a tourist airport-issuance procedure at Tehran Imam Khomeini, but its complete current eligibility/preapproval conditions are not established, so no arrival entitlement is asserted. Taiwan BOCA expressly reports that all foreign visa applicants must use a legally registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary. This does not apply a visa duty to independently exempt passports. No residence, preapproval, arrival eligibility or qualifying itinerary is assumed. Stay and final issuance method remain uncertain.

Danish ordinary-passport visitors require a visa and online application. MFA guidance reports a maximum stay of 90 days, with issuance online, at a mission or at an airport depending on the case; this does not establish interchangeable methods or an automatic 90-day grant. Taiwan BOCA expressly reports that all foreign visa applicants must use a legally registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary. This does not apply a visa duty to independently exempt passports. No residence, preapproval, arrival eligibility or qualifying itinerary is assumed. Final method and granted duration must be confirmed.

Slovenian MFA explicitly requires a visa and identifies the Iranian electronic visa. It says airport issuance is suspended until further notice; no airport alternative is assigned. Taiwan BOCA expressly reports that all foreign visa applicants must use a legally registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary. This does not apply a visa duty to independently exempt passports. No residence, preapproval, arrival eligibility or qualifying itinerary is assumed. No source-established fixed stay is assigned.

Estonian ordinary-passport visitors require a visa. Taiwan BOCA expressly reports that all foreign visa applicants must use a legally registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary. This does not apply a visa duty to independently exempt passports. No residence, preapproval, arrival eligibility or qualifying itinerary is assumed. The electronic/consular/airport issuance branch and permitted stay remain uncertain.

Macao SAR passport, not the Macao travel permit: DSI expressly reports visa-free entry for up to 21 days. Mainland Chinese and Hong Kong documents are not inferred from this record. The foreign visa-applicant agency rule is not assumed to require visas for already exempt visitors.

Russian ordinary-passport visitors require a visa unless they qualify for the bilateral organised-tourist-group exemption. The Russian MFA reports that exemption as up to 15 days, at most 90 in 180; an agency-arranged itinerary alone is not proof of the treaty group qualification. Group approval/list and other implementing requirements remain to be established for a personal waiver decision. Taiwan BOCA expressly reports that all foreign visa applicants must use a legally registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary. This does not apply a visa duty to independently exempt passports. No residence, preapproval, arrival eligibility or qualifying itinerary is assumed. The visa branch has no verified fixed stay or issuance method.
policies.label: Visa required; qualifying tour-group exception

policies.n: Ordinary national passport: visa required under the Immigration (Passports) Order default, read with the current MFA and embassy exemption schedules. Diplomatic/service-only waivers do not extend to this passport. A pre-approved arrival process may be available depending on residence and ability to apply at a Guyana mission; no such condition is assumed. Online application, prior approval and border issuance are sequential, not interchangeable visa methods. The nationality-specific issuance channel and granted stay remain uncertain; eVisa unavailability is not inferred.

Visa required for an ordinary passport without qualifying foreign documentation. Current mission schedules provide a 90-day exemption for holders of a valid US, Canadian or Schengen visa or a US permanent resident card; no such document is assumed. The non-exempt visa branch has no verified fixed stay or unconditional electronic/arrival entitlement.
policies.label: Visa required; foreign-document exemption

policies.n: Spanish ordinary-passport exemption is established by the currently published statutory Schedule and corroborated by two embassy schedules. The central MFA table mentions diplomatic passports but supplies no express revocation of the statutory ordinary exemption. No fixed ordinary visitor stay is established across these sources; confirm the granted period rather than assuming 90 days.

Turkish ordinary-passport visitors require a visa. The separate diplomatic/service/special passport waiver does not apply to ordinary passports. Nationality-specific electronic/arrival eligibility and the permitted stay remain uncertain.

Serbian ordinary-passport holders require a visa, expressly confirmed in the outbound entry section of Serbia MFA advice. The nearby table labelled entry into Serbia is not inverted. Nationality-specific electronic/arrival eligibility and stay remain uncertain.

Macao SAR ordinary passport requires a visa. DSI explicitly identifies a 30-day tourist arrival visa and electronic processing, with invitation, host/hotel contacts, two photographs and funds. Guyana limits its pre-approved arrival procedure by mission access/residence: obtain and print approval before travel where eligible; it is not a walk-up visa or an independent electronic alternative. No residence or approval is assumed. Consular eligibility and stay outside that branch are not established.
policies.label: Visa required; pre-approved arrival branch

policies.n: Ordinary passports are subject to the current Visa Regime Decree Article 4 default; these nationalities are not in its ordinary-passport exemptions. No diplomatic/service treaty benefit is assumed. Article 7 separately permits up to 30 days with a valid Schengen, Australian, Japanese, Canadian, New Zealand, Irish, US or UK visa or residence permit, or an APEC business travel card, never beyond that document’s expiry. No qualifying foreign document is assumed. The ordinary visa branch’s granted stay and electronic availability remain uncertain.
policies.label: Visa required; foreign-document exception

policies.n: Somali nationals are subject to the EU visa requirement. The Commission’s 2 October 2026 recognition matrix marks the ordinary Somali passport as not recognised by Benelux, including Luxembourg. This is a visa/document-authorisation requirement only: it does not establish a routinely issuable tourist visa, acceptance of the ordinary passport, a substitute-document approval, or lawful Schengen transit. Any exceptional territorial/separate-sheet permission and itinerary require an individual authority decision; the practical tourist route and stay remain unresolved.
policies.label: Visa required; passport not recognised

policies.n: German ordinary passport: obtain an entry visa before travel; the Foreign Office expressly identifies online eVisa application and the Berlin embassy channel. Stay is not specified. Passport must be valid at least six months and have six free pages according to this nationality-specific advice.

Dutch passport: visa required, with online application through the South Sudan government. Stay is not specified; passport must be valid at least six months on arrival. The same passport and visa requirements apply to children.

Czech passport: obtain a tourist eVisa in advance or a passport visa from the South Sudan embassy in Berlin; airport applications are not available under this advice. Print the approved electronic visa. The stated up-to-six-month period is visa validity, not a proved stay allowance.
Moldovan ordinary passport: visa required; the MFA identifies eVisa as the application method. The inspected row does not specify a tourist stay.

Mongolian ordinary passport: a visa is required under the MFA’s explicit residual rule. Electronic eligibility and tourist stay are not established by this table; this is not a claim that eVisa is unavailable.

Macao SAR passport: the DSI country-specific policy records no visa-free or arrival concession and identifies the South Sudan government eVisa channel. Obtain approval before travel; no stay is specified. This passport-specific record is not a mainland-China rule.

Federal Iraq: an entry visa is required under Article 3 of Law 76/2017 for ordinary foreign visitors outside its exemptions. Article 1 excludes Iraqis and their children carrying foreign passports and certain treaty/border/transport cases; those conditions are not assumed. The current London mission directs applications to evisa.iq, but this record does not establish this nationality’s electronic eligibility, issuance or product-specific stay. The statutory tourist product has a 30-day stay and 60-day entry validity; neither is assigned to an unconfirmed product. Kurdistan has a separate permission regime: its visa is not federal permission. KRI exempts documented Iraqi birthplace and may otherwise require a nationality-dependent guarantor. A visa requirement is not guaranteed tourist issuance or admission.
policies.label: Federal visa required; KRI permission separate

policies.n: Moldovan ordinary passport: the MFA expressly requires a visa and identifies the federal Iraq eVisa method. Stay is not specified. A Kurdistan-only permit does not authorize travel elsewhere in Iraq; regional rules and federal exemptions for Iraqis and their children holding foreign passports are separate.

Macao SAR passport: DSI identifies the federal evisa.iq channel and no ordinary visa-free/arrival concession; federal law requires a visa outside its exceptions. Tourist stay is not established. A Kurdistan-only permission is separate and is not authorization to enter other regions of Iraq; Iraqi parentage/birthplace exceptions require proof and are not assumed.

UAE ordinary passport: federal electronic visa, initial stay 30 days with a possible further 30-day extension for an additional fee. UAE MFA separately prohibits UAE citizens from travelling to Iraq; this outbound restriction is not an Iraqi nationality-wide admission ban. KRI-only permission is distinct from federal permission.

Moldovan ordinary passport: visa required without an applicable exemption. The MFA identifies eVisa; SMF conditions its advance entry-authorisation/border-visa procedure on coming from an area without Sao Tome consular representation. That residence/routing condition is not assumed. Portugal MFA separately documents a waiver for holders of a valid US or Schengen visa for up to two weeks; no such visa is assumed. SMF also exempts foreign spouses and accompanying descendants of Sao Tome citizens with the specified passport and civil-status proof. Seven working days is processing time, not stay; the visa branch’s stay is unspecified.
policies.label: Visa required; document and routing branches

policies.n: Mongolian ordinary passport: visa required under the MFA’s explicit residual rule. Current electronic/consular eligibility and stay remain unspecified; no third-country visa, residence or Sao Tome family exemption is assumed.

Macao SAR passport: DSI records no ordinary visa-free or walk-up arrival concession and identifies eVisaST. SMF’s advance entry-authorisation/border-visa branch depends on coming from an area without a Sao Tome mission. Portugal MFA separately documents a waiver for valid US/Schengen visa holders for up to two weeks; SMF documents a foreign-spouse/accompanying-descendant exemption with passport and civil-status proof. None of these routing, document or family conditions is assumed. Visa-branch stay is unspecified; seven working days is a response period.
policies.label: Visa required; document and routing branches

policies.n: Czech ordinary passport: visa-free for a stay not exceeding 15 days without gainful activity. Longer stays or paid activity require the appropriate visa.

Taiwan ordinary passport: BOCA expressly permits visa on arrival for up to 90 days. Carry a passport valid at least six months, return ticket, accommodation/contact details, at least two passport photos, yellow-fever vaccination certificate and proof of funds. This is Taiwan-specific evidence and does not establish eVisa eligibility.

Nicaraguan ordinary passport: the central guidelines’ explicit ordinary-tourist visa requirement applies outside the published exemption categories. Nicaragua is absent from the electronic/arrival nationality roster, so the usable issuance method remains unconfirmed; this does not mean eVisa is unavailable. No stay is assigned from the separate 90-day visa-validity field.

Belarusian ordinary passport: visa required. Czech missions do not ordinarily accept tourism applications under the published restrictions; specified close EU-family, qualifying scholarship and other exceptional applications are separate and are not assumed. This requirement-only record does not assert ordinary tourist issuance, nor establish admission through any particular Schengen border or with another state’s visa.
policies.label: Visa required; Czech tourist issuance restricted

policies.n: Russian ordinary passport: visa required and Czech tourism applications are ordinarily inadmissible outside the published exceptional categories. Non-biometric Russian passports are not recognised except for under-15 holders and applicants/holders of permission issued in Czechia’s interest. A valid visa alone is not permission to travel: external-border restrictions and the actual itinerary require separate clearance. No internal-Schengen tourist permission or nationality-wide entry ban is asserted.
policies.label: Visa and document restrictions; no routine tourist issuance

policies.n: Somali nationals require a visa, but Czechia does not recognise the Somali ordinary passport in the current EU document matrix. This is a qualified visa/document-authorisation requirement, not confirmation of a usable ordinary-passport tourist route. Any exceptional document or territorial permission must be established separately; issuance/admission is not assured. The current Somali visa measure normally permits only single-entry visas and extends processing to 45 days; 45 days is not the permitted stay.
policies.label: Visa required; ordinary passport not recognised

policies.n: Macao SAR passport: visa required under the destination’s non-exempt-visitor rule and the DSI passport-specific policy record. DSI identifies an eVisa channel but expressly warns that Macao visa-policy adjustments are under review; current electronic issuance and the residual 30-day field are not certified here. Obtain confirmation before departure. This record does not assert walk-up arrival permission or that eVisa is unavailable.
policies.label: Visa required; Macao method under official review

policies.n: Russian ordinary passport: visa required, but a Schengen tourist visa is not sufficient assurance of entry. Immigration Regulations section 19A-4b specifically permits rejection for tourism or other non-essential travel at Norway’s external Schengen border on foreign-policy grounds. The scope is external-border entry, not a nationality-wide prohibition everywhere. Eligibility for exceptions, actual visa issuance and any internal-Schengen itinerary must be determined separately; none is presumed.
policies.label: Visa required; external-border tourist restriction

policies.n: UAE ordinary passport: visa-free under the first group in Costa Rica’s published November 2025 directive, with a border-officer-granted stay up to 180 calendar days, no longer than passport validity. Carry a valid machine-readable or biometric passport, onward/return transport and funds of at least USD100 per month or fraction. This operative directive resolves the older conflicting mission table; 180 days is a ceiling, not guaranteed admission for that period.

Ordinary Macao SAR passports only. The arrival-visa concession is limited to Osvaldo Vieira International Airport, Bissau. It does not establish arrival issuance at land or sea borders, or guarantee issuance or admission. Other visa channels are not determined by this record.

Singapore ordinary-passport visitors. Passport must have at least six months validity on expected departure. Singapore MFA describes the arrival-visa facility but gives no port-specific implementation details; confirm current issuance arrangements before travel.

A visa is required for Dutch passports; passport must remain valid for at least six months on arrival. The source directs travellers to the Guinea-Bissau embassy in Brussels. Stay and electronic/arrival eligibility are not established.
Belgian nationals require a visa. The source identifies the Guinea-Bissau missions in Brussels and Dakar; it does not establish permitted stay or rule out electronic or arrival channels.
Moldovan ordinary passports require a visa. The current MFA table identifies diplomatic missions; stay and other issuance methods are unspecified, not declared unavailable.
Moldovan ordinary-passport short visitors are visa-exempt according to Moldova MFA. No permitted stay is specified in the ordinary-passport row.

For Mongolian ordinary passports, the MFA explicitly requires visas for destinations outside its exemption schedule, including Guinea-Bissau. Issuance method and permitted stay are not established; electronic issuance is not ruled out.

India MEA describes a visa-on-arrival facility and recommends obtaining advance Interior Ministry entry authorization requested by the host or employer. Its 90-day figure is visa validity; the permitted stay and port-specific implementation are not established. Confirm authorization and issuance arrangements before travel.

Taiwan nationals are instructed to obtain a visa at a Guinea-Bissau mission before travel. Passport validity of at least six months, departure ticket and yellow-fever certificate are listed. Stay and electronic eligibility are not established.

Mali’s public government lookup explicitly requires a visa for an ordinary passport with residence in the passport country. The result establishes the requirement only: permitted stay, electronic or arrival issuance, and any additional clearance remain unconfirmed. It is not a guarantee of tourist issuance or admission and does not mean eVisa is unavailable.

The Mali government lookup explicitly requires a visa for the Palestine nationality option, ordinary passport, and residence in Palestine. This establishes a permission requirement only. Acceptance of a particular Palestinian issuing authority or document variant, the competent issuance channel and stay still require confirmation; routine tourist issuance or admission is not established.
policies.label: Visa required; document handling unconfirmed

policies.n: The Mali government lookup exempts these ordinary-passport nationals and instructs them to present identity documents or passports currently valid in their own country. The recorded checks use residence in the passport country. No tourist stay length or unrestricted residence/work right is specified.
Ordinary Macao SAR passports: visa exemption for up to 90 days. This is current DSI confirmation of the concession, with a link to the 2004 agreement, not a newly enacted 2026 policy.

Taiwan nationals must obtain a visa before travel and carry a yellow-fever vaccination certificate. BOCA identifies consular submission by appointment and requires checking residence-based mission jurisdiction. Stay and electronic eligibility are unspecified.

Visa required for ordinary-passport tourism without a qualifying supporting document. Article 17 permits conditional visa-free entry with a valid multiple-entry visa or residence permit issued by a Schengen state, EU member state or the United States: no more than 30 uninterrupted days, within 90 days in any 180-day period and within document validity. No such document is assumed. Visa issuance channel and stay remain unconfirmed; eVisa is not declared unavailable.
policies.label: Visa required; foreign-document exemption conditional

policies.n: Taiwan passport holders may visit for tourism without a visa for 30 days. Passport must be valid more than six months from entry and a return/onward reservation is required. The ArriveAntigua electronic declaration is optional; a paper arrival card remains available.

Ordinary Macao SAR passports are eligible for Cameroon’s electronic visa process. Obtain the online authorization before travel and complete the applicable biometric/visa-printing formalities under the Cameroon procedure. Permitted tourist stay is not specified.

Taiwan nationals travelling for short tourism may use Cameroon’s official electronic visa process. Obtain authorization before travel and complete the applicable biometric/visa-printing formalities. BOCA advises confirming current entry requirements with a Cameroon mission; permitted stay is unspecified.

Visa required. Taiwan BOCA confirms continued conditional arrival-visa issuance: travellers from countries without a Bangladesh embassy must justify the necessity of travel, and issuance remains discretionary. The separately documented investment/business invitation procedure is not assumed for tourism. Obtain confirmation of the appropriate visa channel before travel; no tourist stay or guaranteed arrival eligibility is established.
policies.label: Visa required; arrival issuance conditional

policies.n: Sri Lanka’s current DI&E guidance requires prior entry permission for ordinary foreign visitors. For these passports, the appropriate restricted-nationality approval or referral channel is not established; ordinary direct-online ETA and arrival issuance are not certified. Confirm the necessary approval with DI&E before travel. No permitted stay is assigned, and electronic issuance is not declared unavailable.
policies.label: Prior permission required; channel unconfirmed

policies.n: Denmark explicitly requires a visa for Somali nationals. An ordinary Somali passport must not be assumed to satisfy the separate travel-document recognition rules. The acceptable original or substitute document, any limited-territorial authorization, transit permissions and a practical tourist issuance path remain unconfirmed. This records the visa obligation only, not routine issuance, admission or a nationality-wide entry ban.
policies.label: Visa required; document authorization unresolved

policies.n: Switzerland explicitly requires a visa for Somali nationals and independently requires a recognized travel document. An ordinary Somali passport must not be assumed sufficient. A competent-authority decision on the acceptable original or substitute document, territorial permission and transit routing is still needed. Tourist issuance channel and stay are not established; this is not routine admission clearance or a nationality-wide ban.
policies.label: Visa required; document authorization unresolved

policies.n: Chile’s consular nationality table explicitly lists Kosovo as visa-required and notes that Chile does not recognize Kosovo as a subject of international law. This does not establish rejection of every Kosovo document or a nationality-wide entry ban. Accepted original/substitute travel-document treatment and a practical tourist visa issuance route remain unconfirmed; no routine issuance or stay is promised.
policies.label: Visa required; document handling unconfirmed

policies.n: Ordinary short-tourist visitors are subject to the statutory visa requirement. Tourist/visit visas are issued online. Passport must have more than six months remaining at application; provide accommodation and a ticket ensuring departure, except when entering in one’s own vehicle. The issued visa determines the actual stay, within the 90-day tourist ceiling. If cumulative stays exceed 90 days, the decree requires a printed visa or passport sticker; that condition is not assumed satisfied. Residence, official-status and individually granted exemptions are outside this ordinary non-resident baseline.
policies.stay: Tourist/visit visa: up to 90 days, according to the grant; renewal for the same stay period is permitted by the decree.
policies.label: Tourist eVisa; cumulative-stay qualification

policies.n: Chinese ordinary passports: up to 30 days across one or more visits within the 90-day period counted from first entry. Passport must remain valid at least six months on first entry; enter through an officially designated international border crossing. Longer stays require compliance with Beninese stay legislation.
UAE normal passports: tourist visits up to 90 days in any 180-day period. Passport must be valid at least six months; longer stays require residence permission.

Moldovan ordinary passport holders require a Sudanese visa. The origin ministry identifies diplomatic missions; permitted stay and present electronic/arrival eligibility are unconfirmed, rather than ruled out.

Moldovan ordinary passport holders require a visa; their foreign ministry explicitly identifies the Gabon DGDI eVisa channel. No numerical stay is established by this source; approval and border admission remain subject to Gabonese processing.

Mongolian ordinary passport holders require a visa under their foreign ministry’s explicit outbound default. Issuance method, electronic eligibility and permitted stay are unconfirmed; this does not assert eVisa unavailability.

Mongolian ordinary passport holders require a visa under their foreign ministry’s explicit outbound default. Issuance method, electronic eligibility and permitted stay are unconfirmed; this does not assert eVisa unavailability.

Russian ordinary passports require a visa. The diplomatic/service waiver shown elsewhere in the source does not apply to this passport class. Visa method, electronic eligibility and stay remain unconfirmed.

Russian ordinary passports require a visa. The diplomatic/service waiver shown elsewhere in the source does not apply to this passport class. Visa method, electronic eligibility and stay remain unconfirmed.

Turkish ordinary passport holders require a visa; passport must have at least three months’ validity according to the origin ministry. The source does not establish electronic eligibility or a tourist stay. Its separate service/special/diplomatic waiver is not applied.

UAE normal passports are listed for visa on arrival. The source does not specify a stay or entry-port coverage; confirm the intended crossing and issuance arrangements before travel. Passport must be valid at least six months.
Dutch passport holders require a Sudanese visa and a passport with at least six months remaining on arrival. Visa issuance method, electronic eligibility and permitted stay are unconfirmed.

Spanish ordinary passport holders must obtain a visa before travel; the Spanish mission says it cannot be obtained at Port Sudan airport. Passport validity must be at least six months. Registration is required within three days after entry; minors require parental authorization. Stay and electronic eligibility are unconfirmed.

Taiwan ordinary passport holders must obtain a Sudanese visa before travel. Applicants resident in Japan may use the Tokyo embassy; without Japanese residence, BOCA directs them to Sudanese representation in Thailand or Malaysia. Passport must be valid six months from intended entry and must not bear Israeli visa or immigration stamps. No stay or electronic eligibility is established.

UAE normal passports are exempt from visa requirements; an entry permit is issued upon arrival. The stated permission is two months, not an invented 60-day period. Passport must be valid at least six months.
policies.stay: Two months; entry permit issued on arrival.

policies.n: Australian passport holders require a Sudanese visa; issuance is not automatic and can take months. Stay and present application-channel eligibility are unconfirmed. Australian advice says passports bearing Israeli visas or entry/exit stamps are not accepted, even with a Sudanese visa; single-entry visitors may also require an exit visa.

Macao SAR ordinary passports are explicitly listed by DSI for the destination’s electronic visa channel. No numerical stay is specified. Approval, the current issuing service and admission must be established for the actual journey; this is not a mainland-Chinese passport rule.

Macao SAR ordinary passports are explicitly listed by DSI for the destination’s electronic visa channel. No numerical stay is specified. Approval, the current issuing service and admission must be established for the actual journey; this is not a mainland-Chinese passport rule.

Taiwan passport holders need a visa. BOCA describes electronic tourist visas and physical short-stay C visas from a Ukrainian mission in a neighbouring country. Provide evidence of tourism, funds and medical insurance covering at least EUR30,000; passport must remain valid at least three months beyond departure. Visa validity dates control the electronic stay; the source’s January example is not a general 30-day allowance. Civil airspace is closed; this does not establish a usable flight or guarantee admission.
policies.stay: eVisa: within the dates granted; physical short-stay C visa: no more than 90 days, subject to the visa issued.

policies.n: Bulgarian regular passports are exempt for tourist visits up to 90 days. Passport must remain valid at least six months beyond the planned end of stay and have two blank pages; provide a return/onward ticket and sufficient funds.

A visa is required, but Finland does not recognize the ordinary Somali passport in the inspected EU document matrix. Finland’s separate acceptance of the Somali biometric diplomatic ePassport introduced in 2014 does not cover ordinary passports. An accepted alternative document and case-specific authorization would need to be established with the competent Finnish authorities; no routine tourist issuance, usable ordinary-passport-only route or admission permission is established.
policies.label: Visa required; ordinary passport not recognized

policies.n: Dutch passports require a DPRK visa. The passport must remain valid six months after departure from DPRK. This establishes a visa requirement only, not that tourist travel, visa issuance or admission is currently available. No stay is established; electronic-method availability is not determined.
policies.label: Visa required; tourist availability unconfirmed

policies.n: Czech passports require a DPRK visa; the MFA directs applicants to the DPRK mission in Prague. Tourism is described only through organised travel; that description does not confirm a presently operating tour. This establishes a visa requirement only, not that tourist travel, visa issuance or admission is currently available. No stay is established; electronic-method availability is not determined.
policies.label: Visa required; tourist availability unconfirmed

policies.n: Moldovan ordinary-passport holders require a visa for DPRK. Diplomatic and service columns were not substituted for the ordinary column. This establishes a visa requirement only, not that tourist travel, visa issuance or admission is currently available. No stay is established; electronic-method availability is not determined.
policies.label: Visa required; tourist availability unconfirmed

policies.n: Portuguese tourists require a visa, requested through the organising travel agency at least four weeks in advance. The advice limits tourists to organised groups. This establishes a visa requirement only, not that tourist travel, visa issuance or admission is currently available. No stay is established; electronic-method availability is not determined.
policies.label: Visa required; tourist availability unconfirmed

policies.n: Italian travellers require a DPRK visa; the MFA directs visa enquiries to the DPRK diplomatic-consular representation in Rome. This establishes a visa requirement only, not that tourist travel, visa issuance or admission is currently available. No stay is established; electronic-method availability is not determined.
policies.label: Visa required; tourist availability unconfirmed

policies.n: Spanish tourists require a DPRK visa and must use authorised entry points. Government-designated escorts and itinerary restrictions apply; transit-country entry rules are separate. This establishes a visa requirement only, not that tourist travel, visa issuance or admission is currently available. No stay is established; electronic-method availability is not determined.
policies.label: Visa required; tourist availability unconfirmed

policies.n: Mongolia MFA limits the DPRK exemption to diplomatic/official passports. Its explicit residual visa rule therefore applies to Mongolian ordinary passports. This establishes a visa requirement only, not that tourist travel, visa issuance or admission is currently available. No stay is established; electronic-method availability is not determined.
policies.label: Visa required; tourist availability unconfirmed

policies.n: Mongolia MFA lists Oman only for diplomatic/official passport exemption and expressly requires visas for other ordinary-passport destinations. A Mongolian ordinary traveller needs a visa unless independently qualifying for a documented Oman concession; no foreign residence, visa or accompanying-family status is assumed. Visa product, electronic eligibility and stay are unconfirmed.
policies.label: Ordinary passport: visa required

policies.n: Portuguese tourists need a visa, obtainable electronically, through a Cambodian mission or on arrival. Confirm the operating checkpoint and its accepted visa method. The common Type E long-term extension is not a tourist Type T stay.
policies.label: Tourist eVisa or visa on arrival

policies.n: Turkish ordinary passports require a tourist visa; the MFA explicitly offers border issuance and electronic issuance. Its 30-day-valid wording is not converted into an independently verified stay. Diplomatic/service/special-passport exemptions are excluded.
policies.label: Tourist eVisa or visa on arrival

policies.n: Italian tourists need a Type T visa, available electronically or on arrival at international airports; check eVisa-enabled and operating checkpoints. Tourist Type T is described as 30 days, extendable once by 30; Type E business extensions are separate. Complete Cambodia e-Arrival for air entry within the seven-day pre-arrival window.
policies.label: Tourist eVisa or visa on arrival

policies.n: Spanish tourists require a visa; electronic, border and consular methods are described. Electronic entry is limited to designated checkpoints; carry a photograph and fees for border issuance. The source describes a one-month-valid tourist visa but does not separately establish an unambiguous admitted-stay period. Cambodia e-Arrival is separate from the visa.
policies.label: Tourist eVisa or visa on arrival

policies.n: Japanese tourists require a visa. MOFA lists advance consular, arrival at major airports/land borders, and electronic tourist Type T issuance; tourist permission is at most 30 days, without work. Confirm operating/eligible checkpoints. Passport validity must be at least six months; Cambodia e-Arrival is a separate declaration.
policies.label: Tourist eVisa or visa on arrival

policies.n: Taiwan ordinary passports have a nonextendable 14-day visa waiver according to BOCA. Six-month passport validity, return ticket, confirmed hotel, health insurance and funds are required under Oman’s visitor facility. BOCA separately confirms arrival/electronic visas and unsponsored tourist visas for longer visits, and identifies Taiwan rather than mainland-China documentation. Its visa-duration paragraphs conflict, including a printed 30-month figure; no visa stay is certified from that error.
policies.stay: Waiver: up to 14 days. Electronic/arrival visa: duration must be confirmed separately.
policies.label: 14-day waiver; longer-visit visa options

policies.n: Conditional document branch: a valid ordinary passport bearing the ECOWAS logo benefits from ECOWAS’s post-withdrawal instruction to continue recognising those documents and visa-free movement for Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger citizens until further notice. Liberia’s embassy requires an ECOWAS passport for its ECOWAS exemption. This records the supported ECOWAS-logo branch only; acceptance and visa treatment of AES-branded or other replacement passports are not established, and possession of the qualifying document is not assumed. No new stay length is specified.
policies.label: Conditional: valid ECOWAS-logo passport

policies.n: Taiwan passport holders require a visa. BOCA documents a residence-dependent branch: if the country of residence has no Liberian mission, apply online at least seven days before travel for prior approval, with passport validity of at least six months and entry through Roberts International Airport; airport formalities follow that approval. The immigration officer selects 30 or 90 days for this branch. If a Liberian mission exists in the residence country, a mission-issued paper visa is required. Residence is not assumed, online approval is not an independent walk-up arrival alternative, and the consular stay is unspecified.
policies.stay: Preapproved Roberts Airport branch: 30 or 90 days as granted. Consular branch: unspecified.
policies.label: Visa required; residence-dependent channel

policies.n: PIBA’s nationality data mark both ordinary and biometric ordinary passports as requiring permission, and the current ETA eligibility interface excludes these flagged nationalities. This is a requirement-only record: the accepted travel document, special clearance/sponsor process and current tourist issuance pathway are not established, so routine visa issuance or admission must not be inferred. Berlin’s separate no-entry statement concerns German dual nationals with these citizenships and is not generalised into a nationality-wide ban. Stay and electronic-visa eligibility remain unconfirmed.
policies.label: Permission required; restricted processing unconfirmed

policies.n: Macao DSI’s ordinary SAR-passport result expressly identifies the Colombian electronic-visa channel. Colombia’s statutory visa requirement and virtual tourist-visa procedure apply; no third-country residence or visa exemption is assumed. Tourist permission is 90 days initially, extendable by 90, with at most 180 continuous or discontinuous days in 365 counted from visa issue. One-year visa validity is separate from stay.
policies.label: Macao SAR passport: electronic tourist visa

policies.n: Somali nationals are visa-required under Annex I. Separately, the EU recognition matrix marks the Somali ordinary Baasaboor passport as not recognised by Spain, without a Spanish issue-date or issuing-authority exception. The Visa Code provides a separate-sheet, limited-territorial mechanism when the issuing state does not recognise a document; it does not guarantee Spanish tourist issuance. An accepted substitute document or specific Spanish authorisation and itinerary must be established before travel. Neither an ordinary passport alone nor this requirement record establishes admission, Schengen-wide transit rights or routine visa availability. No nationality-wide prohibition or tourist stay is asserted.
policies.label: Visa required; ordinary document not recognised

policies.n: Nauru’s current legislation requires a visitor visa for this profile and explicitly names Israel for visa-fee exemption, not visa exemption. The regulations allow fee-exempt nationals to request a visitor visa on entry without an application form, while the government tourism instructions call for advance application and a printed approval letter. Confirm the operative issuance channel before travel; no unrestricted walk-up arrival entitlement or eVisa exclusion is asserted. Visitor conditions include onward admission/travel documents and means of support; the statutory maximum is three months, single entry.
policies.stay: As granted, no more than three months under Regulation 12(7).
policies.label: Visa required; fee exempt, channel conflict

policies.n: Visitor visa required before entry under the ordinary statutory rule. Nauru’s amendment notified 7 May 2024 expressly removed Republic of China (Taiwan) from Schedule 3’s visitor-visa fee exemptions and substituted People’s Republic of China; the prior Taiwan fee-exempt label is therefore withdrawn. This fee change is not a visa waiver or entry ban. The grant, accepted documents and current application channel must be confirmed; electronic issuance is not declared unavailable.
policies.stay: As granted, no more than three months under Regulation 12(7).
policies.label: Prior visitor visa; no Taiwan Schedule 3 fee exemption

policies.n: The origin foreign ministry explicitly requires a visa for this ordinary passport. Diplomatic/service exemptions are not applied. Permitted tourist stay and present electronic or arrival issuance eligibility are not established by this source; a visa requirement is not a claim that eVisa is unavailable or issuance guaranteed.

The origin foreign ministry explicitly requires a visa for this ordinary passport. Diplomatic/service exemptions are not applied. Permitted tourist stay and present electronic or arrival issuance eligibility are not established by this source; a visa requirement is not a claim that eVisa is unavailable or issuance guaranteed.

The origin foreign ministry explicitly requires a visa for this ordinary passport. Diplomatic/service exemptions are not applied. Permitted tourist stay and present electronic or arrival issuance eligibility are not established by this source; a visa requirement is not a claim that eVisa is unavailable or issuance guaranteed.

The origin foreign ministry explicitly requires a visa for this ordinary passport. Diplomatic/service exemptions are not applied. Permitted tourist stay and present electronic or arrival issuance eligibility are not established by this source; a visa requirement is not a claim that eVisa is unavailable or issuance guaranteed.
Russian ordinary passport: visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day period. The Russian MFA expressly covers ordinary passports; employment is outside this short-visit rule.

UAE MFA specifically lists visa on arrival for normal UAE passports. Passport validity at least six months. Its 90-day statement describes visa validity; an independently established permitted stay and entry-port scope are not supplied, so no 90-day stay is asserted.

Japan MOFA requires a visa regardless of travel purpose and gives advance consular instructions. Passport, visa, entry card and yellow-fever certificate are required. Stay and current electronic eligibility are unspecified here; this does not establish that eVisa is unavailable.

Valid ordinary passport of an EU Member State covered by the treaty: visa-free for 90 days in any rolling 180-day period, for visits not involving paid employment. Ireland and EFTA states are not included in this treaty rule. National-law extensions beyond 90 days remain possible; a visitor permit and other border-entry conditions still apply. Treaty signed in 2015 and entered into force on 1 May 2023, not a newly enacted 2026 policy.

Ordinary French passport is visa-exempt. The EU treaty establishes 90 days in any 180-day period and preserves national extensions; French MFA guidance describes an initial 30-day visitor permit renewable up to six months. Obtain the appropriate visitor permission rather than assuming an automatic six-month grant. Passport must remain valid at least six months after intended return; return ticket required.
policies.stay: Treaty entitlement: 90 days in any 180 days; French guidance: initial 30-day visitor permit, renewable up to six months.

policies.n: Ordinary Dutch passport is covered by the EU–SVG treaty waiver for 90 days in any 180-day period. Dutch MFA separately confirms exemption for stays shorter than 90 days but does not address the exact 90-day boundary; the treaty supplies that legal period. Passport at least six months valid on arrival; national visitor-permit and extension rules remain applicable.
Moldova MFA ordinary-passport table expressly provides a visa exemption for visits up to 30 days. No longer stay or rolling aggregate limit is inferred.

Applies to Taiwan ordinary passports bearing a national identification number and valid for at least six months. Return/onward ticket and sufficient funds required. The source does not establish the same treatment for passports without that ID number.
policies.stay: Up to six months.

policies.n: Japanese nationals visiting for tourism or other short purposes excluding work are visa-exempt. A visitor permit is issued for the intended stay; passport must have six months remaining validity, with departure ticket, adequate funds and confirmed accommodation. Extensions require Immigration approval.
policies.stay: Up to three months.

policies.n: UAE MFA expressly provides a 90-day tourist visa waiver for normal UAE passports. Passport validity at least six months. Accommodation registration is required for stays exceeding 14 days according to this origin guidance. Medical-treatment extensions are not general tourist extensions.

Serbian national passports are visa-exempt for stays up to 90 days. The current Serbian guidance limits entry to air travel because land borders are closed. Stays over 15 days must be registered with the State Migration Service; restricted territories require separate permission.

Macao SAR ordinary passport waiver applies only from 2 February 2026 through 2 February 2027, for at most three entries cumulatively within that entire period, each stay up to 30 days. No unused quota is assumed. A fourth entry or travel outside that period is not covered; the appropriate visa/permission must be established separately. This is not an unrestricted Chinese-passport waiver.
policies.label: Visa-free within three-entry quota

policies.n: A visa is required for normal UAE passports. UAE authorities separately prohibit travel to Afghanistan except stated diplomatic, emergency-treatment and pre-authorized delegation cases; ordinary tourism is not one of those exceptions. This outbound restriction is not described as an Afghan nationality ban. Afghan tourist issuance method and stay remain unestablished.

UAE MFA expressly lists normal UAE passports as visa-free for tourism up to 90 days. Treatment, study and work require separate advance visas. This UAE-only evidence does not establish the other GCC nationalities; passport must have six months remaining validity.

Advance consular visa required. Taiwan BOCA identifies only visit, business and journalist/media categories for Taiwan passport holders; a routine unrestricted tourist product is not established. Hong Kong consular instructions require the original passport, invitation, funds and itinerary; the mission explicitly excludes Taiwan passports from its normal online-application direction. Stay and electronic issuance eligibility remain unestablished; no invitation or qualifying category is assumed.
policies.label: Prior visa; restricted application categories

policies.n: Taiwan BOCA expressly confirms arrival visa and advance electronic visa via Irembo. Yellow-fever proof applies after recent travel/transit in affected countries. A Kenya/Uganda-issued East Africa Tourist Visa is a separate conditional option and is not assumed.
policies.stay: Arrival visa: up to 30 days. Electronic visa: normally up to 30 days, subject to the issued grant.

policies.n: Macao SAR ordinary passports qualify for arrival visas at Kigali International Airport and all land ports. DSI also explicitly lists the Irembo electronic alternative. The arrival duration is not assigned to the electronic method without separate evidence.
policies.stay: Arrival visa: up to 30 days. Electronic visa: stay not specified in this source.

policies.n: Taiwan BOCA expressly permits electronic visas. A separate airport-issuance branch requires an advance immigration permission number, local invitation and approved application before travel; it is not an unarranged walk-up visa. Passport over six months valid and return/onward ticket required for the airport branch. GBAO travel needs an additional permit. No approval or invitation is assumed.
policies.stay: Electronic visa: up to 60 days. Pre-approved airport visa: stay assigned by immigration, not specified in the source.

policies.n: Visa and acceptable travel-document authorization are required. The EU document matrix (checked 7 October 2026) records Somali ordinary passports as recognized by Germany only for exit to return to Somalia, not ordinary tourist entry. The July 2026 embassy notice describes single-entry processing for Somali applicants, but does not establish routine tourist issuance or approval of an alternative document/exception. Neither a visa application nor the passport alone establishes permission to travel. The 45-day processing period is not permitted stay.
policies.label: Visa and exceptional document authorization required

policies.n: Moldovan ordinary passports require a visa. The MFA identifies diplomatic missions as a channel; current electronic eligibility and permitted stay are not established. This is a visa requirement, not confirmation of admission through any particular Syrian border.
Ordinary Moldovan passport: up to 30 days visa-free. Submit the Malaysia Digital Arrival Card within the three days before arrival; diplomatic and service passport periods are separate.
Mongolian passports of all types are exempt for up to 30 days under the current outbound table. Ordinary tourism only; other-purpose entry conditions remain separate.

Mongolia MFA explicitly requires visas for destinations outside its listed concessions; Syria has no concession in that table. Issuance channel and permitted stay are unconfirmed, including electronic eligibility. This does not establish an operational route through every Syrian border.

Dutch passport holders require a visa; passport must be valid for at least six months on arrival. Issuance method and stay are unconfirmed. Israeli visas, entry/exit stamps and specified Israel-related border records may cause refusal. A visa does not establish access through every border or territory.

Belgian travellers require a visa, normally requested through the Syrian embassy in their country of residence. Stay and current electronic eligibility are unconfirmed. Israeli visas or stamps evidencing travel to Israel or the Palestinian territories can prevent admission; border operation is not guaranteed.

Estonian citizens require a visa for Syria. The source does not establish the issuance method or permitted stay; electronic eligibility remains unconfirmed, and a visa requirement is not confirmation of a usable border route.

Normal UAE passports: visa obtainable on arrival at the airport, with a stated USD 100 fee. Passport validity at least six months. The UAE MFA separately warns its nationals against travel; the airport provision does not establish land-border access.
policies.stay: Tourism: three months; extension requires permission

policies.n: Malaysian citizens holding a valid passport need neither a visa nor a tourist card for a visit of up to 90 days. The embassy expressly describes the bilateral agreement as in force indefinitely; online visa availability does not displace this exemption.

Czech tourists must obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel and complete DViajeros. Travel medical insurance is required. The initial stay is up to 90 days; a further 90 days requires immigration approval. One-year visa validity is not the permitted stay.

Portuguese citizens require a visa. The tourist eVisa permits a single entry for up to 90 days, extendable once by approval. Passport validity at least six months on arrival, DViajeros and medical insurance are required. The former paper-visa concession is expired and is not an alternative.

Estonian citizens require a visa; the MFA says the tourist-card system has been replaced by electronic visa processing. Complete the traveller declaration and carry insurance covering the whole stay. The source does not establish the permitted stay.

Japanese visitors require entry permission; the current MOFA notice directs tourist applicants to the electronic visa system. DViajeros and medical insurance are required. Its older 30-day tourist-card paragraph is not treated as the current eVisa stay or an available paper-card alternative.

Italian tourists must obtain a visa before departure; the current guidance specifies electronic issuance, including direct online application. Complete DViajeros. The initial tourist stay is up to 90 days, with a separately approved further 90 days. Expired paper-visa acceptance is excluded; travel via the United States is subject to separate US restrictions.

Swedish citizens require a visa to visit Cuba. This source does not establish the current issuance channel; electronic issuance is not ruled out. Its 90-day visa wording is not used to infer a method-specific stay. Traveller-declaration and applicable US-routing conditions remain separate.

Hungarian travellers require a Cuban electronic visa. The permitted stay is 90 days; one further 90-day extension must be requested in person from the competent immigration office. Non-tourist purposes require the appropriate visa category.
Estonian citizens may stay visa-free for up to 90 days. Passport and Malaysia Digital Arrival Card requirements remain applicable.

Mexican passport holders need no visa for tourism or business for up to 30 days. Passport must be valid for at least six months from entry and sufficient funds are required. This explicit Mexican rule is separate from the conflicting Central America table and footnotes on the same page.
Spanish citizens may enter without a visa under the bilateral agreement. Immigration determines the period granted, which must not be exceeded.
policies.stay: Up to three months, subject to the entry stamp

policies.n: Slovenian citizens do not require a visa for up to 90 days. Submit the Malaysia Digital Arrival Card within three days before arrival.

Portuguese citizens do not require a visa for the source-defined short visit; passport must be valid for at least six months on arrival. The source says less than 90 days, not an inclusive 90-day entitlement.
policies.stay: Less than 90 days

policies.n: These ordinary passports require a visa; their MFAs identify the electronic route. Obtain approved online pre-enrolment before boarding, then present it for biometric enrolment and visa printing at Abidjan airport. These are sequential steps, not independent walk-up arrival visas. Three-month approval validity does not establish permitted stay. Consular issuance is a separate option subject to mission requirements.

Taiwanese travellers must arrange a visa through a Senegalese mission, including the mission in Japan. Mission processing requires Senegal Interior Ministry approval. The removal of visa fees is not a visa exemption. Stay and electronic eligibility are not established; approval is case-specific.

Taiwanese travellers must obtain a separate Visa Confirmation Letter before travel. BOCA reports tourist and business applications reopened on 21 September 2026 following the July suspension. The airport police stamp determines the permitted stay, commonly 14 or 15 days. Keep the letter for exit inspection and collection; no ordinary passport-sticker or eVisa entitlement is implied.
policies.label: Visa confirmation letter required

policies.n: Somali nationals are subject to the EU visa requirement. Greece does not recognise the ordinary Somali passport in the EU recognition matrix dated 2 October 2026. A routine tourist visa or admission on that passport is not established; any exceptional permission and acceptable substitute document require confirmation from the Greek authorities. This is not a nationality-wide entry ban.
policies.label: Visa required; ordinary passport unrecognised

policies.n: A visa is required for an ordinary-passport short visit under the embassy’s explicit entry default. The diplomatic/service exemptions do not apply to ordinary tourism. A valid passport, application documents and yellow-fever certificate are required. This establishes the visa obligation, not assured issuance or admission. Current electronic/arrival eligibility and the permitted stay are not established; eVisa unavailability is not inferred.

Taiwan’s consular authority explicitly requires a visa before travel and identifies the Niger Embassy in France for applications. Carry a valid ROC passport and yellow-fever certificate. The five working days mentioned are processing time, not stay. Permitted stay and any alternative issuance channel remain unestablished.

A visa is required for an ordinary-passport short visit under the embassy’s explicit entry default. The diplomatic/service exemptions do not apply to ordinary tourism. A valid passport, application documents and yellow-fever certificate are required. This establishes the visa obligation, not assured issuance or admission. Current electronic/arrival eligibility and the permitted stay are not established; eVisa unavailability is not inferred. In particular, this legal-requirement record does not establish current visa issuance or admission availability for US passport holders.

The embassy expressly lists this nationality among short-stay visa-suppression agreements, separately from diplomatic/service-only exceptions. The permitted short-stay duration is not stated. A prior expulsion, refusal of residence or withdrawal of residence carrying an entry/residence prohibition restores the visa requirement; no such history is assumed.

An entry visa is required for Austrian ordinary passports. The passport must be valid for at least six months on entry; proof of yellow-fever vaccination, onward/return travel and sufficient funds is required. Tourist stay and electronic/arrival channels are not established by this advice.

Türkiye’s MFA explicitly requires a visa for ordinary Turkish passports. Its separate diplomatic-passport waiver is not an ordinary-tourist exemption. Stay and current electronic/arrival issuance eligibility are unspecified.

Türkiye’s MFA explicitly requires a visa for ordinary Turkish passports. Stay and current issuance channel are unspecified. Cabo Verde’s residence-dependent border-issuance conditions are not assumed satisfied; electronic or arrival issuance is not declared unavailable.

Serbia’s MFA expressly requires a visa for national passports. The permitted stay and current application channel are not established. Border issuance depends on additional conditions that are not assumed, and the visa requirement is separate from EASE registration and the airport security tax.

For an ordinary Macao SAR passport, not the Macao travel permit: DSI explicitly confirms visa-free access for 90 days. Complete Cabo Verde’s EASE pre-registration and applicable airport security tax procedure; those obligations are separate from the visa exemption.

Taiwan’s consular authority describes a visa requirement and advance application, with EASE registration at least five days before departure. It also describes an airport visa option, while Cabo Verde’s consular rules make border applications residence-dependent. No residence or arrival eligibility is presumed. The common visa requirement is established; the applicable channel and stay remain uncertain. TSA payment is not a visa fee waiver.

Australian ordinary-passport holders may receive a tourist visa on arrival at Abu Dhabi or Dubai. The passport must have more than six months’ validity and show a complete date of birth and both first and last names; passports with XX birthdate/gender and emergency passports are not accepted. Stay duration is not specified in this advice. Entry screening and current border/airspace operation remain separate.

Mongolia’s outbound consular table explicitly covers all Mongolian passports for up to 30 days in the UAE and records entry into force on 28 December 2023. This historical commencement date is not a new 2026 policy. No rolling aggregate period is specified.

A visa/entry authorization is required, but General Security currently publishes a suspension of all new work and visit entry visas for DR Congo and Uganda nationals because of Ebola. No ordinary tourist issuance channel is established during that suspension. Treatment of existing permissions and exceptions is not established. This is an issuance restriction, not proof of a nationality-wide admission ban.
policies.label: Visa required; new visit issuance suspended

policies.n: Palestinian passports are subject to visa/entry-authorization procedures. General Security explicitly requires prior authorization for Palestinian-passport holders arriving from Jordan; its residual rule requires an embassy visa or prior General Security authorization outside concessions. The documented Lebanese-spouse and GCC-spouse branches have distinct marriage-document and approval conditions, none assumed here. Issuing authority, travel-document class and itinerary need individual confirmation; no routine tourist issuance or unrestricted border clearance is established.
policies.label: Visa / prior approval; document and routing conditions

policies.n: For the Macao SAR passport, DSI explicitly records no visa-free access and identifies an electronic visa channel. Angola’s statutory visa requirement is therefore retained. The researched waiver-agreement lead does not establish commencement. Destination portal instructions conflict on completing issuance electronically versus consular attendance, so the exact currently usable channel and stay remain uncertain; this is not a claim that eVisa is unavailable.

Angola’s statutory visa requirement is supported by Taiwan BOCA’s explicit tourist electronic-visa instructions for ROC passports: passport validity at least six months, return/onward ticket, vaccination certificate, accommodation and funds of at least USD100 per day. The documented electronic pathway does not reconcile the destination portal’s conflicting completion instructions; current end-to-end channel and permitted stay remain uncertain. No routine issuance or admission is implied.

Somali nationals require a visa. Austria’s notified ordinary-passport recognition is restricted to documents issued before 31 January 1991; it excludes passports/documents issued or extended by a Somali diplomatic or consular authority/post after that date. This does not make an old passport valid for present travel. A recognised valid alternative document and any exceptional visa/territorial authorization require competent-authority confirmation. No routine tourist issuance path or nationality-wide entry ban is established.
policies.label: Visa required; Somali-document restriction

policies.n: Somali nationals are visa-required under the EU nationality rule. Sweden does not recognise the Somali ordinary passport in the Commission’s current document matrix; its separate acceptance of a biometric diplomatic passport issued in 2014 or later does not apply to ordinary tourism. A recognised valid alternative document and any exceptional territorial visa need competent-authority confirmation. The available evidence does not establish routine tourist issuance, usable transit authorization or a nationality-wide admission ban.
policies.label: Visa required; ordinary passport not recognised

policies.n: Mongolia’s MFA expressly states that countries outside its documented concessions require visas. Scoped only to Mongolian ordinary passports. The permitted stay and precise issuance channel are not established by this source; this requirement does not imply that electronic or arrival issuance is unavailable.

The Russian MFA explicitly requires a visa for Russian ordinary passports; the diplomatic/service exemption is not applicable. The permitted stay and precise issuance channel are not established by this source; this requirement does not imply that electronic or arrival issuance is unavailable.

The Korean MFA’s September 2026 table explicitly marks the ordinary-passport visa-exemption cell X, separately from diplomatic and official passports, against its stated visa-required default. The permitted stay and precise issuance channel are not established by this source; this requirement does not imply that electronic or arrival issuance is unavailable.

Mongolia’s MFA expressly states that countries outside its documented concessions require visas. Scoped only to Mongolian ordinary passports. The permitted stay and precise issuance channel are not established by this source; this requirement does not imply that electronic or arrival issuance is unavailable.

The Russian MFA explicitly requires a visa for Russian ordinary passports; the diplomatic/service exemption is not applicable. The permitted stay and precise issuance channel are not established by this source; this requirement does not imply that electronic or arrival issuance is unavailable.

The Korean MFA’s September 2026 table explicitly marks the ordinary-passport visa-exemption cell X, separately from diplomatic and official passports, against its stated visa-required default. The permitted stay and precise issuance channel are not established by this source; this requirement does not imply that electronic or arrival issuance is unavailable.
Moldova’s ordinary-passport column requires a visa and directs applicants to diplomatic missions. No stay is stated; no claim is made that other issuance methods are unavailable.
Moldova’s MFA expressly requires a visa and identifies eVisa for ordinary passports. Stay is not specified.

Taiwan ordinary-passport travellers must obtain a visa before departure. BOCA directs tourist applicants through a specialist travel agency or an authorised agent in Japan and to the Algerian embassy in Japan for its agent list. The source does not specify a stay or establish an electronic/arrival entitlement.

The Netherlands MFA expressly requires a visa for Dutch passports and directs applicants to the Algerian embassy. The permitted stay and precise issuance channel are not established by this source; this requirement does not imply that electronic or arrival issuance is unavailable.

Portuguese ordinary-passport holders need a prior visa. The stated diplomatic, special and service passport exemption does not apply. Stay is unspecified; exceptional tourist arrangements are not assumed.

Czech MFA requires a visa and identifies the Algerian embassy in Prague for applications. Scoped to Czech ordinary passports. The permitted stay and precise issuance channel are not established by this source; this requirement does not imply that electronic or arrival issuance is unavailable.

Australian travellers need a visa before arrival. DFAT describes an arrival-visa exception only for tourists arriving and departing by cruise ship; that itinerary is not assumed. Stay is not specified and the record does not promise routine border issuance.
policies.label: Prior visa; cruise exception

policies.n: German nationals need an online visa before travel. The Foreign Office says embassy applications are no longer available and arrival applications are considered only in substantiated urgent exceptions; arrival issuance is not a routine alternative. Stay is unspecified.

Dutch-passport holders need a visa; the Netherlands MFA directs them to the official online application. A separate fiche de voyage must be completed within 72 hours before arrival and its QR code presented; forms older than three days are rejected. The inspected source does not state a permitted stay.
Applies to Macao SAR ordinary passports, not travel permits. DSI explicitly classifies this passport as non-exempt and eligible for the official Burkina Faso electronic visa. No stay is stated.
Czech citizens need a visa and may apply through the official Burkina Faso eVisa portal. Stay is unspecified.

Portuguese travellers require a visa and may obtain it through Visa Burkina; print the electronic visa for arrival. Portuguese advice also mentions Ouagadougou arrival issuance, while current German guidance describes urgent exceptions only. Advance eVisa is supported; an unrestricted arrival alternative and duration are not established.

Turkish ordinary passports are expressly visa-required. The permitted stay and precise issuance channel are not established by this source; this requirement does not imply that electronic or arrival issuance is unavailable.

Moldova’s ordinary-passport table confirms a visa-free allowance up to 90 days. An approved eTA is required before travel in addition to the underlying visa exemption. The eTA’s 90-day validity is not the permitted stay; admission and the granted stay remain subject to immigration approval.

Serbian ordinary passports have a visa-free allowance of up to 90 days during 180 days from entry. An approved eTA is required before travel in addition to the underlying visa exemption. The eTA’s 90-day validity is not the permitted stay; admission and the granted stay remain subject to immigration approval.

UAE MFA’s normal-passport entry is Electronic Visa eTA, with a tourist allowance of three months. This is an electronic travel authorisation. An approved eTA is required before travel in addition to the underlying visa exemption. The eTA’s 90-day validity is not the permitted stay; admission and the granted stay remain subject to immigration approval.
policies.stay: Up to 3 months

policies.n: Requires a Taiwan ordinary passport containing a national ID number, with more than six months validity, and return tickets. Obtain eTA before departure. BOCA describes an initial one-month stay permit, extendable by application to a maximum of 90 days; 90 days is not an automatic initial grant.
policies.stay: Initially 1 month; extension may be requested, maximum 90 days

policies.n: The September 2026 Korean MFA table states 90 days for ordinary Korean passports. An approved eTA is required before travel in addition to the underlying visa exemption. The eTA’s 90-day validity is not the permitted stay; admission and the granted stay remain subject to immigration approval.

The current Russian MFA table expressly requires a visa for ordinary passports; the diplomatic/service waiver is separate. The permitted stay and precise issuance channel are not established by this source; this requirement does not imply that electronic or arrival issuance is unavailable. Gambia’s chartered-tour concessions must not be presumed for independent travel.

The Korean MFA September 2026 table explicitly marks Gambia X for ordinary passports under its visa-required default. The permitted stay and precise issuance channel are not established by this source; this requirement does not imply that electronic or arrival issuance is unavailable. Gambia’s chartered-tour concessions are not assumed for independent travel.
Korean MFA’s September 2026 table expressly permits ordinary Korean passports visa-free for 30 days. The 90-day diplomatic/official allowance is separate; no aggregate period is specified.

The Georgian MFA confirms that the bilateral ordinary-passport waiver entered into force on 3 February 2023, covering tourist travel. This is a live official commencement notice published 4 February 2023, not a new 2026 policy. The notice does not establish a stay duration.

Taiwan passport holders need a visa. First obtain an invitation from a travel agency recognised by the Turkmen migration service, then apply with the required documents at a Turkmen embassy. BOCA recommends applying at least one month before departure; this is lead time, not stay. Stay is grant-specific; electronic eligibility is not established.

Taiwan travellers must obtain an eTA through the official Kenyan portal before travel; BOCA advises applying at least three days ahead. Carry a printed approval and passport valid over six months. BOCA specifies single entry and maximum 90-day stay, subject to immigration admission.

Applies to Macao SAR ordinary passports, not travel permits. The DSI passport-specific record states 90 days and expressly requires advance Kenyan eTA for tourism/business. The visaFree flag does not remove the eTA requirement.

Entry permission is legally required under Article 10 for persons of the Mainland Area, defined by mainland household registration; Article 3 also covers such persons residing abroad. A PRC passport alone does not confer entry permission. Article 16 permits tourism applications subject to implementing rules. This record establishes the permission requirement only: current tourist issuance, residence/group branches, application channel and stay remain unverified. No third-country residence or entitlement to issuance is assumed.
policies.label: Mainland-Area entry permission required

policies.n: Somali nationals are subject to the Schengen visa obligation.
