The European Commission travel-document matrix dated 2 October 2026 records Hungary as not recognising the Somali ordinary passport. A visa obligation does not establish an accepted passport, routine tourist issuance or permission to travel. Any exceptional separate-sheet or limited-territorial permission would need specific consular authorisation and compatible transit documents; no such tourist pathway is established here.
policies.label: Visa required; ordinary passport not recognised

policies.n: Evidence limited to this origin government’s own ordinary passport. Obtain electronic approval before departure through ANRPTS and carry it for boarding. Border payment/biometrics are subsequent steps, not an independent walk-up visa-on-arrival option. No single tourist stay is established; follow the granted authorization.

Its explicit later product-specific stay controls over the 2025 training deck’s 90-day F5A table. Advance approval and separate landing/exit cards required. Local-objection checks remain; issuance is not guaranteed.

The embassy’s public single-entry tourist checker explicitly maps this nationality to airport visa issuance, with a passport valid at least six months. Advance consular application is a genuine alternative, through the mission competent for residence. Its one-month wording is visa validity, not a verified stay, so no stay is inferred. This general-entry visa route does not require assumed foreign residence, Egyptian family ties or organized-group participation.

A tourist visa is required for general entry: the embassy’s nationality-specific single-entry result expressly requires a pre-entry visa independently of German residence status. Apply through the mission competent for actual residence; German or Australian residence is not assumed. Missions differ on pre-clearance handling for some of these nationalities. Electronic, sponsored or arrival-method eligibility and stay are not conclusively established here and are not declared unavailable.
policies.label: Visa required; method and clearance details uncertain

policies.n: Sydney expressly names this nationality for pre-approval before visa issuance. Berlin also requires a visa but differs on the North Korean arrival method. Preserve the common visa requirement, with clearance, electronic/arrival eligibility and stay uncertain. Sydney’s visa service currently reports a technical suspension, so do not assume immediate issuance there or Australian residence.
policies.label: Visa required; issuance method uncertain

policies.n: Ordinary Macao SAR passport only. DSI explicitly marks visaFree=1, visaOnArrival=0 and a 90-day stay. This passport-specific evidence takes precedence over Berlin’s contradictory generic arrival-visa branch; it is not generalized to mainland Chinese or Hong Kong passports.

Conditional waiver for an organized tourist group of at least five people, with valid travel documents, prepaid hotel accommodation voucher and round-trip air tickets. Ordinary Macao SAR passport only. Group membership and these documents are not assumed. Independent-traveller treatment outside this concession remains unestablished.
policies.label: Visa-free only for qualifying groups of 5+

policies.n: Latvian citizen passport: no visa for tourism not exceeding six months. Latvian non-citizen passports are expressly referred for separate consular advice and are not covered. The source asks for six months passport validity beyond the planned journey. Calendar months are not converted to days.
policies.stay: Up to 6 months

policies.n: Taiwan ordinary-passport tourist: apply online to PAFE for entry authorization before departure; after approval, present the documents at the Burundian airport for visa issuance and fee payment. These are sequential steps, not a separate eVisa alternative. Initial stay 30 days; extensions depend on individual approval. Register with PAFE after arrival.

The national portal explicitly requires an entry visa from every nationality except Kuwait, Oman, UAE, Saudi Arabia and Qatar. This establishes the requirement for the named ordinary nationality only. The retrieved tourist roster does not establish a usable electronic, arrival or sponsored issuance route for this nationality; no routine issuance, eVisa ineligibility, stay or admission prohibition is inferred.
policies.label: Visa required; tourist issuance unresolved

policies.n: Taiwan BOCA describes required Georgian visa/entry permission but reports only case-specific permission for invited international conferences or sports events. Those exceptions are not ordinary tourism. It expressly reports that Taiwan applicants cannot use the nationality selector of the ordinary eVisa system. A functioning ordinary-tourist authorization route and stay remain unestablished; this is not a nationality-wide entry ban or an assurance of routine consular issuance.
policies.label: Entry permission required; tourist issuance unestablished

policies.n: Somali nationality is subject to the Schengen visa requirement. The EU travel-document matrix dated 2 October 2026 records Icelandic non-recognition of the Somali ordinary passport (Somalia ordinary-passport row, IS cell); a visa alone therefore does not establish usable travel authorization. An accepted substitute document and any specifically authorized territorial/visa arrangement would need competent Icelandic confirmation. No ordinary-tourist issuance or transit route is established; no routine admission or nationality-wide ban is asserted.
policies.label: Visa and accepted document required; passport not recognized

policies.n: Visitor visa required; Schedule 3 exempts this nationality from the visitor-visa fee, not from the visa. Regulations 12(2)(a) and 16(4) permit an application on entry, but current Tourism instructions require an advance application and a printed approval letter. Practical arrival-versus-advance issuance remains unreconciled: confirm with Nauru Immigration before travel; no unconditional walk-up visa or electronic-visa availability is asserted. Tourism accepts emailed documents: passport, photograph, return itinerary, accommodation and employment/support evidence; carry the printed approval for that advance process. Confirm current passport/document validity requirements. Regulation 12 requires onward admission documents and means of support; the grant is single-entry, no more than three months, with its actual conditions controlling.
policies.stay: As granted; single entry, no more than 3 months under Regulation 12(7)
policies.label: Visitor visa required; fee exemption / channel conflict

Air entry only: visa-free
policies.n: Incoming air entry only, valid ordinary passports and short tourism. Land and sea entry are not established by this evidence; crew, airside transit, employment and residence are excluded. No third-country visa or residence status is assumed. Explicit ordinary-passport exemptions for Mali, Niger, Morocco, Tunisia and Saint Kitts and Nevis. Valid passport. No numeric ordinary-tourist duration is stated; the separate CEN-SAD 30-day period is diplomatic/service-only. Apply only to incoming air passengers on this evidence. The governing pages are dated 2 October 2025 (AMDT 10/25) and individually retained in the full AMDT 10/26 register effective 1 October 2026; the January 2026 HTML title is not a visa enactment date.

policies.label: Air entry only: prior eVisa
policies.n: Incoming air entry only, valid ordinary passports and short tourism. Land and sea entry are not established by this evidence; crew, airside transit, employment and residence are excluded. No third-country visa or residence status is assumed. Visa required under the express entry default, after excluding the full ordinary-passport AIP exemption schedule, independently supported UAE waiver and unresolved newer-agreement/document/restriction cases. Apply through Visa Burkina before travel; obtain electronic approval before boarding. Source supports electronic issuance but not guaranteed approval or a uniform authorized stay. Air-entry scope only. Review: Rwanda is also excluded because its immigration authority publishes an explicit ordinary-passport exemption that conflicts with this residual rule. The retained 156 cases are scoped default proposals after known exclusions, not certification of a universally complete live exemption register. The governing pages are dated 2 October 2025 (AMDT 10/25) and individually retained in the full AMDT 10/26 register effective 1 October 2026; the January 2026 HTML title is not a visa enactment date.

policies.label: Air entry only: visa-free
policies.n: Incoming air entry only, valid ordinary passports and short tourism. Land and sea entry are not established by this evidence; crew, airside transit, employment and residence are excluded. No third-country visa or residence status is assumed. Mali explicitly included for valid ordinary passports, visa-free for a stay not exceeding three months. Retain the source unit; do not convert to 90 days. Applies to incoming air passengers, not inferred solely from AES membership. The incoming-passenger pages are dated 11 June 2026 (AMDT 06/26) and individually retained in the full October 2026 register; neither the July HTML title nor the October package date establishes a new waiver commencement.
policies.stay: Up to 3 months (air entry only)

policies.label: Air entry only: visa-free
policies.n: Incoming air entry only, valid ordinary passports and short tourism. Land and sea entry are not established by this evidence; crew, airside transit, employment and residence are excluded. No third-country visa or residence status is assumed. Both paragraph 7 and paragraph 9 expressly waive visas for valid Burkina ordinary passports. The same section gives three months in paragraph 7 and 60 days in paragraph 9; visa-free status is supported, but the tourist duration remains unresolved. Do not select the longer or silently convert months to days. The incoming-passenger pages are dated 11 June 2026 (AMDT 06/26) and individually retained in the full October 2026 register; neither the July HTML title nor the October package date establishes a new waiver commencement.

policies.label: Air entry only: visa-free
policies.n: Incoming air entry only, valid ordinary passports and short tourism. Land and sea entry are not established by this evidence; crew, airside transit, employment and residence are excluded. No third-country visa or residence status is assumed. Named incoming-passenger exemptions in the CAR authorities’ still-published permanent AIC 17/A/22FC. The annex is unqualified by diplomatic/service passport class; ordinary passports are within its nationality statement. No waiver stay is specified. Restrict this proposal to air entry and valid ordinary passports. No expired-passport entitlement or CEMAC-wide extrapolation. The separate less-than-one-month exceptional visa provision is not the waiver duration. Re-read both actual PDF pages: ten names total, nine retained because US remains held. Current Rwanda immigration additionally corroborates RW ordinary passport. No unnamed origin receives a requirement from the annex omission. AIC 17/A/22FC is dated 25 March 2022 and remains listed PERM in the current October 2026 AIC index. Its continuing specific entry provisions, not the old generic GEN page or package date alone, support this scoped record.

Japanese ordinary-passport tourists are visa-exempt for visits of up to 30 days but must obtain eTA before travel, including for children and infants. Carry a valid passport, departure ticket, sufficient funds and confirmed accommodation. The immigration officer determines admission and the permitted stay; eTA validity is not a stay allowance.

Brazilian national-passport holders may visit for tourism/social or business purposes without a visa for up to 90 days. Longer stays or other purposes require a visa. Submit MDAC within three days before arrival unless a published exemption applies; MDAC is an arrival declaration.

Surinamese national-passport holders may visit for tourism/social or business purposes without a visa for up to 30 days. Longer stays or other purposes require a visa. Submit MDAC within three days before arrival unless a published exemption applies; MDAC is an arrival declaration.

The current Paraguayan MFA list expressly includes this nationality among those not requiring a visa, without restricting the entry to diplomatic or official passports. The source does not establish the allowed tourist stay.

policies.label: Visa required
policies.n: The Paraguayan MFA expressly limits the Saudi exemption to diplomatic, official and service passports and states that ordinary passports require a visa. This establishes visa duty; the precise tourist issuance channel and permitted stay are not established.

The bilateral ordinary-passport exemption entered into force on 28 August 2024. The embassy announcement expressly extends the same visa-free stay privileges of up to 90 days to Azerbaijani nationals visiting Morocco. Additional passport-validity and admission conditions must be checked separately.

policies.label: Visa required; mission conditions apply
policies.n: A visa and valid travel document are required under the statutory default and current ordinary-passport exemption schedule. Amman publishes Palestinian-specific tourist-document requirements for residents of Gaza and the West Bank, including a passport valid for at least six months from arrival and supporting identity, employment, funds, ticket and accommodation evidence. Its multiple-entry branch additionally requires Jordanian residence. Current electronic versus paper processing, competent mission for other residence profiles and actual stay must be established separately; routine issuance is not assured.

Italian ordinary passport: a visa is required before travel. Italian guidance directs applicants to the DRC embassy; the DGM separately describes electronic pre-approval followed by border issuance. Current electronic eligibility and the applicable issuance channel for this nationality are not established here; no consular-only claim or fixed stay is made. Passport must be valid at least six months on entry with two free pages.
policies.label: Visa required; method unconfirmed

policies.n: Czech ordinary passport: obtain a visa before travel. The live Czech page directs Czech applicants to Prague, but its older procedural and pandemic content does not establish present exclusive issuance arrangements. Electronic eligibility and permitted stay remain unconfirmed; this is a requirement-only record.
policies.label: Visa required; method unconfirmed

policies.n: Croatia MFA explicitly marks a visa required for Croatian ordinary passports and refers enquiries to the DRC mission in Prague. The source does not establish the issuance channel, electronic eligibility or permitted stay.
policies.label: Visa required; method unconfirmed

policies.n: UAE MFA identifies a visa-on-arrival rule for normal passports and reports 30 days. The DGM separately describes advance electronic approval before border issuance; the applicable pre-approval, port and issuance conditions for UAE tourists are not reconciled. Only the visa requirement is established here. Do not assume walk-up issuance, a usable electronic channel or a confirmed stay.
policies.label: Visa required; arrival conditions unconfirmed

policies.n: Dutch passport: up to 90 tourist days in the 365-day year beginning on first tourist entry, not a fresh allowance on each visit. Passport must have six months validity on arrival. Adults entering across land or river borders from Peru or Colombia need the criminal-record documentation described by the source, or the immigration-system check where available. Galapagos entry has separate controls.

Czech ordinary passport: tourist visits up to 90 days are visa-exempt. The live MFA guidance describes the exemption introduced in June 2008; this is not a new 2026 enactment. No per-visit reset or additional annual allowance is established by this source.

UAE normal passport: tourist visa exemption up to 90 days. Passport must have at least six months validity. The checker does not establish a rolling-period reset or a fresh allowance on repeated visits.
Armenia MFA outbound checker explicitly reports visa not required for Ecuador with ordinary passport selected (docutype=1). No stay duration or aggregate limit is established by this result.

Croatia MFA explicitly marks no visa required for Croatian ordinary passports entering Ecuador. No duration is given for this outbound rule; the page’s separate Schengen 90/180 text concerns entry into Croatia and is not applied to Ecuador.

Danish passport: visa-exempt tourist stay up to 90 days; no repeated-entry reset is established. Passport must have six months validity and be undamaged. Obtain an entry stamp. The Danish page additionally instructs purchase of a tourist card on entry; Galapagos travel requires its separate transit-control card, return ticket and insurance, and the source states a 60-day Galapagos tourist limit.

Hungarian ordinary passport: tourism is visa-exempt for a maximum of 90 days annually, counted from first entry. Passport must remain valid for six months after entry. Galapagos travel has separate pre-registration and entry charges.
Slovenian citizens do not need a visa to enter Ecuador. This source establishes the exemption but supplies no tourist stay duration; other entry conditions remain applicable.

Russian ordinary passport: treaty exemption for up to 90 days in each 180-day period from first entry. Employment or commercial activity requires a visa. Enter through a checkpoint open to international passenger traffic. This specific bilateral period is supported by treaty Article 1 and the current MFA table, rather than inferred from the general Ecuador tourist allowance.

Russian ordinary passport: up to 60 days per visit under treaty Article 2, excluding work, study and residence. Any aggregate limit remains subject to national rules and is not inferred here. Use international passenger checkpoints. EASE pre-registration and the airport security charge apply unless separately exempt; they are not a visa.

Japanese ordinary passport: visa required. Japanese advice mentions consular and airport issuance but calls EASE a visa site; Cabo Verde identifies EASE as pre-registration and makes border-visa applications conditional on residence in a country without its diplomatic representation. This record does not assume that condition, establish an electronic visa or guarantee airport issuance. Applicable channel and stay remain unconfirmed; pre-registration and TSA are separate.
policies.label: Visa required; issuance conditions apply

policies.n: UAE normal passport: a visa is required. UAE MFA describes arrival issuance, while Cabo Verde conditions border applications on residence in a country without diplomatic representation. Residence and eligibility are not assumed. The applicable issuance channel and stay are not confirmed by this record; no unconditional arrival or electronic method is claimed. EASE pre-registration and TSA remain separate requirements.
policies.label: Visa required; issuance conditions apply
Visa required; stay unconfirmed
policies.n: EU citizens need a visa before entry. Portuguese official guidance directs applications to South Sudan diplomatic missions. This establishes visa duty; electronic eligibility and permitted tourist stay are not established by this source.

Belgian official advice requires a valid visa and permits online or embassy applications; the official portal issues an eVisa PDF to present on arrival. Passport must remain valid for six months on arrival. Tourist stay is unspecified; approval and admission are not automatic.

policies.label: Visa required before entry
policies.n: Swedish citizens need a visa before entry; official advice directs applications to the South Sudan embassy in Oslo. Yellow-fever vaccination proof and a passport valid six months beyond planned departure are required. Stay and electronic eligibility are unconfirmed.

policies.label: Visa required; method unconfirmed

policies.n: Korean MFA explicitly marks ordinary Korean passports X for visa exemption in its September 2026 table; diplomatic and official exemptions are separate. Stay and the practical issuance channel are unconfirmed.

policies.label: Advance visa; conditional exemptions
policies.n: BOCA requires Taiwanese travellers to obtain a visa before entry through a Sao Tome mission. Tourist passports should remain valid at least six months beyond the intended stay. The visa stay is unspecified. The general US/Schengen-visa waiver and documented Sao Tome family exemption are conditional; neither is assumed. Where the residence/no-mission advance-authorisation procedure applies, approval precedes border visa affixing; it is not an unconditional arrival entitlement.

policies.label: Advance visa required; stay unconfirmed
policies.n: BOCA expressly requires Taiwanese passport holders to apply for a Guyana visa in advance. Its mission/postal directions do not establish an unrestricted electronic or walk-up arrival entitlement. Current practical processing and permitted stay remain unconfirmed.

policies.label: Federal visa required; KRI separate
policies.n: A federal Iraqi visa is required; BOCA directs Taiwanese travellers to Iraqi missions. Federal Law 76/2017 preserves applicable personal/treaty exceptions, including Iraqis and their children holding foreign passports; none is assumed. Electronic/arrival eligibility, stay and routine tourist issuance are not confirmed. A Kurdistan-only visa does not authorise federal territory; regional permission must be assessed separately.

policies.label: Visa required; arrival/eVisa channel qualified
policies.n: Visa duty is established. The Kuala Lumpur mission notice of 21 January 2025 permits Malaysian Visit visas at airport and land entry points from 11 September 2024; it does not announce visa freedom or specify a stay. Later/current general mission instructions direct foreign-passport applicants to the federal eVisa portal, so this record does not promise operational walk-up issuance or universal electronic eligibility. Confirm the applicable channel before travel. Kurdistan permission is separate.

policies.label: Tourist visa required; mission assessment
policies.n: The public nationality-specific navigator returns C-3-9 Ordinary Tourist with an overseas-mission process for holiday/leisure travel. A valid acceptable passport and visa are required. Single-entry and double-entry stays differ; issuance remains subject to document and consular assessment. HiKorea expressly excludes these nationalities from the direct-Jeju and specified transit visa waivers. The navigator’s older Palestine transit text is not used as current permission. An electronic application form is not an eVisa.
policies.stay: C-3-9: up to 90 days for a single-entry visa; 30 days for a double-entry visa

policies.label: Visa required; conditional exemptions
policies.n: The official Immigration Regulations impose a visitor visa requirement outside specified exemptions. Neither South Sudan nor Timor-Leste has a nationality exemption in the reviewed regulations, later immigration instruments or current schedule. No third-country document, same-vessel cruise visit or qualifying transit is assumed. Qualifying US/Canadian visa or permanent-resident documents and Schengen documents can change the requirement; the current page and older Schengen instruments differ on scope/stay. Standard visa guidance states a maximum 30-day initial visit, but conditional branches and the actual grant must be checked.

policies.n: Visa required, with restricted processing: Lithuania suspends Russian-national Schengen visa applications except where mediated by its Foreign Ministry. Russian nationals crossing the external EU border into Lithuania face additional individual screening. This is a qualified duty/document-restriction record: it does not establish a routine tourist issuance route, eligibility for an exception, or permission to enter via either an external or internal Schengen route. Stay is unconfirmed.

policies.label: Visa required; issuance conditions apply

This establishes visa duty, not that tourism is open, a visa will be issued, or admission is assured. Stay and currently available issuance arrangements are unconfirmed.

policies.label: eVisa; Phu Quoc exception
policies.n: For ordinary tourism beyond the separate Phu Quoc island-only exemption, obtain a visa; the government makes eVisas available to citizens of all countries and territories. The existing diplomatic/official exemption does not cover ordinary tourism.
